notes.content:
Commanders!

Max von Krieger is back, and he hasn't given up on his far-reaching plans. notes.title: Play the Biggest Update and Claim the Biggest Gift!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="ZJ8eNee4PZU;full"][/previewyoutube]
Commanders!


The long-awaited Update 2.0 has arrived! This massive release brings a wave of game-changing features and new ways to experience World of Tanks. Here are the most important ones.

Tier XI: Meet the New Top-Tier Titans! We are about to enter a bold new era of tactical power. Tier XI brings 16 new vehicles, each with unique mechanics and a special Upgrade system that replaces Field Modifications.

Garage and UX Improvements. Get ready for the redesigned Garage, a unified tank factory where your vehicles are assembled, equipped, and always battle-ready.

Hundreds of Vehicles Rebalanced and Reforged. This historic rework reshapes hundreds of vehicles across all nations, refining the progression through Tech Tree branches and making gameplay fairer and funner at every tier.

A More Intelligent Matchmaking System. The new matchmaker will be smarter than ever. Expect significantly improved role-aware team compositions, more battles with tighter tier spreads, and limits on light tanks and tank destroyers on top of SPGs for more balanced battles.

Personal Missions 3.0. The third Personal Missions campaign will test your battlefield prowess in three Operations of skill-based, role-focused missions without nation or class limits. Fair and achievable conditions will steadily bring you closer to the Tier VIII Windhund, the Tier X Dravec, and ultimately the Black Rock, a prestige Tier XI tank with a unique firing mechanic.

notes.title: Update 2.0: Vehicle Rebalance and Matchmaker Overhaul
notes.content:
Commanders!  Update 2.0 is the biggest update in World of Tanks history. It brings the biggest vehicle rebalance yet and a completely reworked matchmaking system—two massive changes that reshape how battles are played. Let's take a look at each.
Biggest Vehicle Rebalance Ever[previewyoutube="rRed4clK3MI;full"][/previewyoutube]
This is more than just a rebalance patch—it's a complete overhaul!

Hundreds of vehicles across all tiers and nations have been fine-tuned to offer a smoother, more exciting experience.

Stock vehicles are stronger from the get-go, while revamped modules make early progression smoother.

Light tanks now pack more survivability without sacrificing stealth or speed.

Even some Premium vehicles are being refreshed, with improved stats and battlefield performance that breathe new life into old favorites.



FULL DETAILS
EU NA ASIA


Matchmaker 2.0: Reforged for Fairer Battles
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9696974b7ca8fe783c2ac3f184b0c610e0a0ef69.jpg"]

Matchmaker 2.0 introduces a smarter way to build battles—designed for balance, fairness, and tactical depth.

Smarter team composition. The matchmaker balances not just by vehicle type, but by combat roles for more even sides.

Class limits. Light tanks, TDs, and SPGs have capped numbers per team to ensure tactical variety and reduce frustration.

Closer tiers. Expect more ±1-tier battles, reducing extreme tier spreads and making matches feel tighter and fairer.

Fewer duplicate vehicles. The system now limits how many identical tanks can appear on the same team.

Unified queue logic. Expect faster matches and smarter queue handling, especially during off-peak hours.

notes.title: Tankfest 2025
notes.content:
World of Tanks is proud to once again be the principal sponsor of Tankfest!  From June 27 to 29, 2025, we’ll be at The Tank Museum in Bovington, UK, and you can watch all the action on Twitch with Drops to see historic vehicles—like the King Tiger on Sunday’s special Tankfest Online Historical Stream, live commentary, and earn both guaranteed and mystery rewards. There’s so much more! Keep reading to get all of the Tankfest 2025 details.

On Sunday, June 29, Richard Cutland, Nik Wyness, and David Baggley host the Tankfest Online Historical Stream produced in association with The Tank Museum. Big News: This year, the world's only running King Tiger (Tiger II) will be making a guest appearance courtesy of the  King Tiger's home, the Musée des Blindés in France!   




Twitch Drops: Earn Valuable Rewards by Watching

Don’t miss out on exclusive Twitch Drops rewards during Tankfest 2025! Catch guaranteed rewards on Friday and Saturday, and get ready for Sunday, which is packed with the biggest drops! Potential rewards include 360 days of WoT Premium, 3D styles, and Premium vehicles! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8108f5f3dd43ca6b626ea9599d933ef0729b051a.png"]
Make sure to link your World of Tanks and Twitch accounts to receive Twitch Drops. You will be compensated in credits if you already own a vehicle or a 3D style. Players who receive mystery drops have until July 8 at 09:00 UTC to reveal and claim them. Plus, don't forget to use the Tokens you earn in Drops in the Tankfest token store where you can get one of three Premium vehicles (Cromwell B, Tiger 131, or TOG II*), the UK-themed “Union Jack” 2D style, or add David Baggley, WoT’s head of community and one of the hosts of Tankfest 2025, as a crew member to your garage. 

How to Receive Twitch Drops
[expand type=details expanded=false]In order to receive Twitch Drops, you need to have an account linked to your email. If you haven't completed this process yet, you'll need to do so first to participate in the activity. After that, make sure to link your World of Tanks and Twitch accounts to receive your prize. Check our official Twitch Drops guide to learn more.[/expand]
Discounts, Missions, and More!
 There are discounts on in-game items like tech tree vehicles and consumables on top of missions for Tankfest-themed customizations both in the run-up to Tankfest (June 23 to 27) and throughout the weekend (June 27 to 29) leading up to the big Tankfest Online Historical Stream on Sunday, June 29. Plus, ×5XP for first victories with all of your vehicles, making this an ideal time to battle for any tech tree tank you want to add to your garage.


Join us live at The Tank Museum in Bovington, UK, from wherever you might be for Tankfest 2025 from June 27 to June 29, and pay special attention to the Tankfest Online Historical Stream on Sunday! It’s one of the best events in the world for fans of both World of Tanks and historic moving armor, so don’t miss it.

Roll Out!

notes.title: Raumfalte Unsealed: Discover What's Within!
notes.content:
Commanders!

During the recent clashes in Mirium subspace, we captured quite a few Raumfalte from the enemy lab. These compact devices use dimensional bubbles to store and transport resources, tanks, and even other nested Raumfalte devices full of cargo. You can obtain a lot of Raumfalte for yourself, and in various ways, including taking part in Operation Pandora!

[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/30230f2d6c431acff307c62590fdc7c5742704c9.png[/td]
[/tr]

[td]With a 20% chance, any Raumfalte will include another device, often of a greater rarity. This may result in a chain of Raumfalte within Raumfalte—or even a cycle, when a device of the rarest kind produces a basic one. Raumfalte Proto are the only starting point for getting the advanced Raumfalte Alpha and Raumfalte Prime.[/td]

notes.title: Assemble Your Legend: The Object 780 and Lion Return!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Have you ever wanted a second chance to assemble iconic vehicles from previous Assembly Shop events? The wait is over!

The Object 780 and the Lion return for a limited-time event. With only 25,000 of each tank available in the EU and 3,000 of each in NA and APAC, act fast to secure your preferred vehicle. Both tanks come without a numbered 3D style, so you can focus purely on assembling the one that best fits your playstyle. Start with your favorite, then decide if you want to go for both—it's all up to you!

[previewyoutube=DdGt87H1-Ts;full][/previewyoutube]
EU: From April 24, 2025 at 19:00 CEST (UTC+2) until May 1, 2025 at 23:00 CEST (UTC+2)*
NA: From April 24, 2025 at 18:00 PT / 20:00 CT / until May 1, 2025 at 22:00 PT / May 2 at 00:00 CT / 01:00 ET*
ASIA: From April 24, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC+8) until May 1, 2025 at 23:59 (UTC+8)*
*Note: The event may end early if all tanks are assembled before the deadline.

The Assembly Shop: How It Works

 Invest blueprint fragments, Free XP, credits, gold, and bonds to assemble the Object 780 or the Lion—or both!
 A total of 50,000 (EU) / 6,000 (NA) / 6,000 (ASIA) tanks are available: 25,000 (EU) / 3,000 (NA) / 3,000 (ASIA) per vehicle.
 No numbered 3D styles—just pure firepower. 

Combine and Invest Resources in Different Ratios
You decide how to allocate resources to reach 100% progress—mix and match what you have available. If you don't complete the assembly, all resources will be refunded automatically.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/338344b1be1e73f0f0253b2fe3c6d428602534f4.png

Object 780: Versatile Heavy Assault Tank
A well-armored and mobile heavy tank with a unique hull shape that enhances protection. With 530 HP of damage per shot, solid gun handling, and strong glacis plates, it's built for medium-range duels. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/95e155109aad1beb3bee79df036a144e5dca1395.png
Gameplay Tips:

 Use terrain wisely: Its good gun depression lets you fire while staying in cover.
 Support your team: Stick with allies and absorb damage strategically.
 Avoid close-range combat: With a limited HP pool, avoid prolonged close-quarters battles; instead, focus on medium to long-range engagements.

Lion: Master of Precision and Mobility
A fast-moving, auto-reloading medium tank with a 105 mm gun and a unique four-shell autoreloading system. It fires three shells normally, saving the fourth for emergencies. With a top speed of 60 km/h and solid DPM of 3,150 HP, it's built for hit-and-run tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/004e03470acc039335762fecc25f80098e468b55.png
Gameplay Tips:

 Manage your shells: Fire three, save one—maximize your DPM.
 Flank and reposition: Use its speed to outmaneuver opponents.
 Watch your retreat: Its reverse speed is only 15 km/h, so position carefully and avoid overexposing yourself.

Pick the Object 780, the Lion, or both—but don't miss out, Commanders!

notes.title: Battle Pass Special: Peaky Blinders
notes.content:
Commanders!

Characters from the renowned "Peaky Blinders" TV series descend upon World of Tanks as voiced crew members in an epic Battle Pass Special. Take part in this undertaking to recruit them and procure the brand-new Char Murat, a fast French autoloader medium with a Birmingham soul, in the assertive "Tommy" 3D style!
[previewyoutube=Ys1nlYFK54o;full][/previewyoutube]
Meet the Shelby Family
The Shelby family enters the world of large caliber guns, bringing their guile, cunning, and grit. Tommy, Arthur, and John know a thing or two about humble beginnings and are no strangers to fighting in the mud. Employ these rough, streetwise characters as voiced crew members—you won’t regret it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/476fa767d4bde2cb48057a3d8ad86ecf60e58c11.jpg

Procure the Char Murat in the "Tommy" 3D Style
“You don’t get what you deserve. You get what you take.” This fast medium tank with an autoloader is for those who live by the words of Tommy Shelby. It can offer you overwhelming firepower, unleashed in just a few seconds. Be as calculating and decisive as Tommy: Shape the moment when the risks you take will pay the biggest dividends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/199474d72916918b77670ccbb22e7b18abe7bd2f.png
Much like the lives of many characters from Peaky Blinders, the “Tommy” 3D style for the Char Murat is also defined by the Great War. And though the war has ended, its memory lingers in every man's mind, and every soldier carries it home in his heart.

The details of the style speak volumes about the things the Shelby boys hold dear. It is a symbol of their resilience and refusal to be broken. So, while the steel might be from France, the heart of this style was forged in the streets of Small Heath, Birmingham.

Meet the Prototipo 6, the Object 168 German, and the Lätt Stridsfordon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b80f3afc7ff754901346922568043ee1bdbce1bb.jpg

The Prototipo 6 is a Tier VIII Italian Premium medium tank with a 105-mm gun that deals 300 HP of damage per shot and is equipped with a three-shell autoreloader. The full reload time is 35 seconds, and time between shots is 2.5 seconds. The tank has a top speed of 50 km/h but offers very good acceleration and overall dynamics.
While the Prototipo’s armor is not impressive, it excels as a support vehicle. Stay close to your heavies, provide covering fire, and try to maximize your magazine. Switch flanks when necessary, avoid direct close-quarters duels, and utilize the tank’s decent mobility to stay out of danger!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/faa16ba482c83ebec7c0381313b3801adccafbe8.jpg

The Object 168 German is a Tier VIII Soviet Premium medium tank with a limited maximum gun depression (–5°) and some frontal turret armor (150 mm), but the rest of its parameters make it Leopard-like: 2.1 s aiming time, 0.34 accuracy, fast special APCR rounds, 60 km/h forward top speed, and decent concealment values. For a Tier VIII medium, 340 HP of damage with a single shot is good, but 9.7 s reload time may prevent you from beating enemies one-on-one. So snipe and avoid enemy fire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/732791dced1caccd8abf1a3396731b9a08d6518f.jpg

The Lätt Stridsfordon 120 is a Tier IX Swedish Premium tank destroyer which has a lot in common with other TDs of this nation: an excellent gun, a Siege mode for shooting, good mobility in the Travel mode, and a wedge-like low-profile hull giving the vehicle excellent camouflage values. The distinctive feature of the Lätt is its (120 mm) gun with a hefty single-shot damage of 420 HP. This sniper will appeal both to Swedish TD enthusiasts and high DPM vehicle enjoyers.

notes.title: Account Update: Steam and WGC Access Expanded
notes.content:
Commanders!

We appreciate our Steam community and are excited to introduce an update that expands how you access World of Tanks. Starting from March 6, World of Tanks gives you total freedom to play on your terms. Thanks to major improvements in our account infrastructure, you can link an existing Wargaming.net account to Steam and continue playing with its game progress.

If you previously started fresh on Steam but still have an old Wargaming account, you now have the option to reconnect and pick up where you left off.

This update is part of our ongoing effort to enhance flexibility and unify the player experience between Steam and the Wargaming Game Center (WGC). No matter which platform you prefer, you'll enjoy the same content, progress, and features.

Earn a Premium Vehicle
To celebrate this update, all players—including our valued Steam commanders—can take on a simple mission and earn the brand-new FCM 2C, a Tier III Premium heavy tank, and the "Steamroller" 2D style!

notes.title: Update 1.28: Polished Steel
notes.content:
Commanders!

Update 1.28: Polished Steel introduces the new Quick Service feature, which lets you fully equip your vehicles using preset configurations in a few clicks from a single window. Explore the latest crew quality-of-life improvements and test the updated Equipment Assistant feature in the WoT Plus subscription, offering new insights. And that’s not all—read on for more details! 

[previewyoutube=y0gBgjrLCEk;full][/previewyoutube]
World of Tanks servers for Update 1.28 will be available from:  
EU: March 5, 2025, at 10:30 CET (UTC+1)  
NA: March 4, 2025, at 05:00 PT | 07:00 CT | 08:00 ET  
ASIA: March 4, 2025, at 08:00 (UTC+8)  
Quick Service  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/06817ee50d00d20f4726075bf4ed4fab76e27e9f.jpg
Make your vehicle battle-ready in just a few clicks! Perfect for new or unfamiliar tanks, this feature simplifies equipment, ammo, consumable, and even style selection. Choose from popular or optimized equipment setups, assign experienced or rookie crew, and adjust your ammo and consumables with ease!  

Crew Improvements  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d734f8b91a4351003d521a42e051e1903f795dde.jpg
Welcome quality-of-life upgrades for your crew! Enhanced Practicality and Reliable Placement perks offer greater performance, while the Auto-Return Crew setting automatically assigns crew to vehicles before battles. The Mentoring License lets you transfer experience between crew members—and with the update, you already get three of them! Finally, improved filter memory keeps your preferences in Barracks even after logging off.  

Battle Pass Season XVI  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e2a2c79bd09917f8538a482bf244f5a5129b91f7.jpg
The first of three consecutive Battle Pass Seasons is just around the corner! Prepare to earn Tokens to exchange for exclusive vehicles (including two brand-new ones) and a bunch of other rewards.  

Battle Pass Season XVI introduces:  
  
 Vault Shop with a wide selection of valuable items.  
 Chips, a new currency, to purchase items from the Vault Shop.  
 The Elite Circuit, offering extra rewards after completing the main Chapters.  
 Vouchers to exchange for credits, Free XP, and components for Experimental Equipment.  
 
Maneuvers Event Returns!  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/398a6d4bc8b03061dfeceac1e9865b3e764f1874.jpg
Starting March 10, the clans-exclusive Maneuvers event is back in World of Tanks! Get ready for heated 7v7 Encounter Battles in Tier X vehicles, following the familiar rules. Once again, you’ll have the chance to earn a powerful Tier X reward vehicle, including the recently introduced ST-62 Version 2. This time, Maneuvers bring new 2D styles and some other fresh additions to the reward pool, alongside a selection of popular prizes from previous events.

Play Your Way: Steam for Everyone  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/370e9ce742ddb9f10c53f6b34feccb438637cd79.jpg  
Starting from March 6, World of Tanks gives you total freedom to play on your terms. Whether you're a long-time player or just getting started, you can now seamlessly switch between platforms—play on Steam or through the Wargaming Game Center (WGC) with the same account. Your progress and all in-game belongings stay with you wherever you play.  

Already playing via Steam? Great news! If you’ve been playing World of Tanks on Steam before, you’ll receive an exclusive veteran reward:

 The “Steam Veteran” badge  
 3 “eSTEAMed Player” projection decals  

For those with an old WGC-associated account, you can now take advantage of the Steam experience too!  

As our special reward to mark this occasion, all players—whether on Steam or the Wargaming Game Center—will have the opportunity to earn the FCM 2C Tier III Premium French heavy tank and the new "Steamroller" 2D style by completing a special mission. Visit the dedicated news page for all the details!  

FIND OUT MORE 

WoT Plus: Smarter Equipment Assistant  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a8fe4da4ae08fd6eaf051b922194b10d963530a8.jpg
Update 1.28 upgrades the WoT Plus Equipment Assistant, making it more practical and adaptable to different playstyles. Now this feature includes:  
  
 Onslaught Support: Recommendations for Onslaught battles.  
 Loadout Options: Popular setups from all players and Legendary setups from top Commanders (WTR > 8,000).  
 Experimental Gear: Now includes suggestions for Experimental Equipment.

notes.title: Assemble the DBV-152: A Mobile Sniper TD!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Assemble the DBV-152, a brand-new Tier X Czechoslovak turreted tank destroyer! Only a limited number of these exclusive vehicles will be available to build, and even fewer will come with the exquisite "Moravian Bombard" 3D style bearing a unique number on the gun and the turret. Act quickly to obtain your mobile sniper with a 152 mm gun causing 800 HP of damage!
[previewyoutube=uaXt4J6wHfY;full][/previewyoutube]
EU: From February 20, 2025 at 18:00 CET (UTC+1) through February 27, 2025 at 23:59 CET (UTC+1)*
NA: From February 20, 2025 at 17:00 PT / 19:00 CT / 20:00 ET through February 27, 2025 at 21:00 PT / 23:00 CT / 23:59 ET*
ASIA: From February 20, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC+8) through February 27, 2025 at 23:59 (UTC+8)*
*Note: The event may finish early if all vehicles are assembled before the end of the event.

The Assembly Shop: How It Works

 Invest various game resources—blueprint fragments, Free XP, credits, gold, and bonds—to build the brand-new DBV-152. How much of each resource to invest is up to you.
 Just 100,000 (EU) / 15,000 (NA) / 15,000 (ASIA) DBV-152 tank destroyers will be available for assembly. On top of a fine vehicle, the first 50,000 (EU) / 7,500 (NA) / 7,500 (ASIA) players will get the exclusive "Moravian Bombard" 3D style with an individual number. The numbers will be assigned to tanks sequentially, from smallest to largest.
 Once all 50,000 (EU) / 7,500 (NA) / 7,500 (ASIA) numbered styles and accompanying vehicles have been claimed, another 50,000 (EU) / 7,500 (NA) / 7,500 (ASIA) tank destroyers will still be available. They will come in their standard configuration—without the 3D style and individual style number—and will be up for assembly until the event ends or until they run out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5a615573a37dcc30c1b8008c8ba4143d452808d1.png

Combine and Invest Resources in Different Ratios
Remember that you can invest various resources to craft your DBV-152. There are plenty of combinations to make the progress bar reach 100%. It all depends on what you have at your disposal.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9e188cd43c8f5b63801835c5d1843ea2b8c786d3.png

Resources are deducted as soon as you add them to the Assembly Shop, but you can reclaim or redistribute them at any time by clicking the Return Resources button. If you don't craft the DBV-152 by the end of the event, all the resources you invested will return to your account automatically.

The DBV-152: A Mobile Sniper
The vehicle you are about to craft offers exciting gameplay. The DBV-152 packs quite a punch, being able to cause 800 HP of damage with a single shot. Its gun handling, mobility, and camo values allow you to roam the battlefield and take your shots with convenience—at long range and from cover, enjoying excellent precision and a short aiming time.

Gameplay Features

 Gun—One-Time Damage, Good Handling, and More. The 152 mm D-20SM gun of the DBV-152 has a lot of interesting features besides its solid one-time damage, its mushroom-shaped muzzle brake, and the fact that it sits in a full-rotation turret. The base dispersion (0.32 m) and aiming time (1.6 s) are enviable, plus basic AP rounds fly fast (at 1,160 m/s) and the penetration of HE shells is higher than usual (76 mm).
 Mobility—Speed, Acceleration, and More. While the base top speed of the DBV-152 is very good (52 km/h) and the specific power is excellent (20.6 h.p./ton), there is more to the vehicle's mobility: Weighing just 37 tons, it is good at crossing difficult terrain.
 Survivability—Concealment Boosted by Armor. The DBV-152's good camo values, compact size, low silhouette, and mobility are not the only features that help it avoid harm. Though modest, the armor of this sniper can make a difference: 140 mm at the front of its round-shaped turret means that it cannot be penetrated by HE shells and will even produce some ricochets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/421620cbdeb10e3039dd2bebd0d71fbe77e628e3.jpg

Gameplay Tips for Success

 Snipe. The gun of the DBV-152 was made for this, and the vehicle's concealment will often make you an invisible menace, putting additional pressure on your opponents.
 Move a Lot. Use one of the many advantages of your DBV-152 to the fullest! On maps with lots of greenery, take it to the best places you can take precise shots from. On city maps, keep a distance between you and the enemy.
 Use Your Subtler Strengths. These are the vehicle's full-rotation turret and its frontal turret armor, which can matter; its knack for crossing difficult terrain; its maximum gun depression of 7°; and the increased penetration of HE rounds.

Hurry to claim your DBV-152 and ride it into battle, Commanders!

Dynamic Battle Scenarios
Episode 4 once again features the familiar dynamic battle scenarios system. Each battle kicks off with one of three rule sets for Combat Reserves, randomly selected and displayed on the loading screen. Here's a quick reminder of them:

 Standard Battle (34% chance): Combat Reserves are used as per the regular Frontline rules.
 Operational Support (33% chance): The cooldown time for Combat Reserves is decreased by 50% after the start of a battle or when you unlock a new Reserve, and by 30% when you respawn.
 Twist of Fate (33% chance): Upon reaching certain ranks in this scenario, choose between two randomly selected Combat Reserves. Combat Reserves placed in slots in the Garage before battle have a better chance of being offered for selection, and the level of Reserves purchased with Combat Reserve Points will increase by 1 in battle (meaning they will have four levels).

 Experimental Equipment: exclusive equipment to enhance your vehicle's performance. This Episode introduces the Accuracy Improvement System T1, first featured during Holiday Ops 2025, as a new reward. Now available in Frontline, this Experimental Equipment can be unlocked and selected as a reward at stages 5, 10, 15, and 20 of the Progression.

 Bonds: a currency for acquiring advanced equipment and unique items.
 Universal Manual: provides experience for all vehicle crew members, helping them reach new proficiency levels.
 Directives: useful boosters to enhance vehicle and crew effectiveness.
 Retraining Orders: items to respec your crew members and tailor them to your preferred playstyle.

notes.content:
Commanders!

The festive season may be behind us, but the fun in World of Tanks never ends! Jump back into the traditional winter excitement with the familiar Snowballs and Ice Age submodes.

Both submodes are available simultaneously in the Arcade Cabinet via the mode selector across two consecutive launches. Enjoy single-tier, 15v15 battles with Tier VIII or Tier X vehicles across six snowy maps featuring winter-themed mechanics.

Maps
Snowballs and Ice Age require snowy locations, so Mannerheim Line, Erlenberg, and Glacier are in play. Plus, both submodes can take place on special winter versions of Karelia, Prokhorovka, and Malinovka.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/81aaa8d35699f63b4bd6066093657903a23d1115.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4c5c60515027883eea17272af63881cb1cc7e27c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cf2b51ad2bb3d2dbc6611d2bb7c4f95d2237d6f9.jpg

Snowballs
Inspired by real-life snowball fights, this submode is fast, fun, and unpredictable. Shells become snowballs with curved trajectories, reload times are shorter, and engine power is boosted for all vehicles. Plus, HE shells deal extra splash damage, adding to the chaos!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1213db5be7672882c6c4c1ad7daab65bf4877c7f.png

Ice Age
In Ice Age, the extra-slippery ground turns battles into epic slo-mo shootouts. Enjoy smooth drifting as rounds fly faster and dispersion during movement and traverse is reduced. Add boosted engine power and top speeds, and you're in for a wild ride!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8e71161a0b91bce10dbf1170b5f2245c617adb92.png

Rules
Except for different modifiers, Snowballs and Ice Age have the same set of basic rules:
[expand type=details expanded=false] 

    Battles are single-tier, fought in either Tier VIII or Tier X vehicles. Any vehicles of these tiers can be used in the mode.
    You earn XP and credits in battles, and you can use all types of Personal and clan Reserves.
    XP multipliers for the first victory of the day work in the submodes.
    Snowballs and Ice Age battles do not contribute to daily missions or personal missions, but they count toward the mode Progression.
    Snowballs and Ice Age battles do not bring you Battle Pass Points. Gold and credits are not put into the Gold Reserve and the Credit Reserve.
    Snowballs and Ice Age battles do not yield bonds, except for the event Progression rewards (see below).
    You may play in Platoons (and are eligible for the bonuses if you do).

[/expand]

Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3f19a14548042caaef1c6d4ca014d703e4780f19.jpg

Get ready for frosty fun, Commanders!

notes.title: Meet the Twin-Barreled British Heavies!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Update 1.27.1 introduces a line of four British twin-barreled heavy tanks, featuring an innovative mechanic that combines firepower, versatility, and style. These formidable tanks boast strong frontal armor, decent mobility, and tactical flexibility, enabling you to switch between firing modes at any time. By letting you deliver precise long-range shots or unleash a powerful double attack in close combat, these tanks provide a versatile new approach to the battlefield.
[previewyoutube=cLOpCGfd_cU;full]YOUTUBE_PLACEHOLDER[/previewyoutube]
Selective Fire Modes Mechanic
The new British heavies feature two firing modes: Single Fire and Salvo Fire. You can switch between modes anytime by pressing X. Switching does not pause or reset your reloads and can even be done on the move.

Single Fire Mode. The guns fire alternately (starting with the left one). This mode offers excellent stabilization, accuracy, and aiming time, ideal for mid-to-long range combat.
Salvo Fire Mode. Both guns fire simultaneously for a powerful double shot. While this delivers huge burst damage, it comes at the cost of lower mobility, turret traverse speed, and accuracy, and a longer aiming time. The reload time in Salvo Fire mode is double that of Single Fire mode.
Meet the New British Heavies
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width="80%"]FV224 ChopperThis Tier VII combines solid frontal armor with dependable firepower, making it a reliable frontline brawler. It holds its ground effectively and supports your team's advances.

 Twin 20-Pdr Guns. In Single Fire mode, the Chopper boasts solid accuracy and a fast 2.2-second aiming time. In Salvo Fire mode, it delivers 460 HP of average damage with excellent stabilization.
 Hull-Down Master. Thanks to its 10° of gun depression, the Chopper excels in hull-down positions, using its strong armor and reliable firepower to outlast opponents.
[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/58becd349b63afd6d4a3f47b278021a4150cde63.png[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td width="80%"]FV227 ConceiverAt Tier VIII, this tank ramps up the protection and firepower. With thick, well-angled armor (280 mm on the turret and 120 mm on the hull), this tank can shrug off incoming fire while dishing out punishment of its own.

 Twin 32-Pdr Guns: In Single Fire mode, you enjoy impressive accuracy and aiming time. Salvo Fire mode unleashes 560 HP of average burst damage with remarkable stabilization.
 Mobility and Gun Depression. Despite its heavy armor, the Conceiver keeps pace with its 34 km/h top speed. Its 10° of gun depression makes it deadly on uneven terrain.
[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ade72da8c13701d70a4435671552b7edccdf99b.png[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td width="80%"]FV229 ContenderThis Tier IX is the perfect warm-up for the apex predator of this line. With enhanced frontal protection (280 mm on the turret and 165 mm on the hull) and good side armor for angling, it blends survivability and firepower into a dangerous package.

 Twin 105 mm Guns. Single Fire mode offers good accuracy and aiming time for mid-range sharpshooting. Switch to Salvo Fire mode to cause 780 HP of double-shot burst damage with improved stabilization.
 Flexibility in Battle. From sniping to pushing aggressively, the FV229 adapts to any combat scenario. Its combination of protection, firepower, and mobility ensures it's always a threat.
[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7f15c3e00e76dfc8533fba041f008ce8836b6d52.png[/td]
[/tr]

[td width="80%"]FV230 CanopenerSitting at the top of the branch, this Tier X is the crown jewel of the British twin-barreled heavies. Its thick armor, good mobility, and devastating firepower make it one of the most versatile heavies at Tier X.

 Impressive Armor. The Canopener boasts 260 mm turret armor, 200 mm hull armor, and solid 100 mm side armor for effective angling. It's tough enough to withstand even the heaviest hits.
 Twin 120 mm Guns. In Single Fire mode, the Canopener delivers accurate, reliable shots. Salvo Fire mode unleashes a massive 840 HP of burst damage, supported by excellent stabilization.
 Mobility. Despite its heavy armor, the Canopener is surprisingly mobile with a base top speed of 32 km/h, allowing it to reposition or push when needed.
[/td]

notes.title: Frontline 2024 – Episode 3: Dive Into Epic 30v30 Battles
notes.content:
Mark your calendars, Commanders!

Frontline returns for its third and final Episode of 2024. Prepare your vehicles for a thrilling 30v30 battlefield experience with evolving dynamic scenarios and strategic opportunities to claim victory!

Event Schedule:
EU: Start: November 18, 2024 at 06:00 CET (UTC+1) / End: November 25, 2024 at 03:00 CET (UTC+1)
NA: Start: November 18, 2024 at 04:00 PT | 06:00 CT | 07:00 ET / End: November 25, 2024 at 01:00 PT | 03:00 CT | 04:00 ET
ASIA: Start: November 18, 2024 at 07:00 UTC+8 / End: November 25, 2024 at 04:00 UTC+8

Available Maps
In Episode 3, the following maps will be available for epic confrontations:

 Normandie: Classic battlefields that combine open fields and strategic structures, ideal for both offensive breakthroughs and defensive strongholds.
 Kraftwerk: A heavily industrial setting featuring tight corridors and exposed flanks that demand a mix of firepower and tactical prowess.
 Fata Morgana: A desert map with challenging visibility and ambush opportunities, perfect for tactical maneuvers and long-range engagements.

[table noborder=1]
[tr]

[td width="12%"][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Dynamic Battle Scenarios
Each battle in Frontline brings new surprises with three unique dynamic scenarios, ensuring no two matches feel the same:

 Standard Battle (34% chance): Combat Reserves are used as per the regular Frontline rules.
 Operational Support (33% chance): The cooldown time for Combat Reserves is decreased by 50% after the start of a battle or when you unlock a new Reserve, and by 30% when you respawn.
 Twist of Fate (33% chance): Upon reaching certain ranks in this scenario, choose between two randomly selected Combat Reserves. Combat Reserves placed in slots in the Garage before battle have a better chance of being offered for selection, and the level of Reserves purchased with Combat Reserve Points will increase by 1 in battle (meaning they will have four levels).

[center]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4a6c87980912e1cca903c4c4fbcb219a261e2b24.png[/center]

Rewards
As always, participating in Frontline yields valuable rewards. Here are some of the most precious ones up for grabs:

 Combat Reserve Points: Unlock and upgrade powerful abilities to gain an edge in battle.
 Experimental Equipment: Exclusive equipment to enhance your tank's performance.
 Battle Pass Points: Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock additional rewards.
 Bonds: A currency for acquiring advanced equipment and unique items.
 Universal Manual: Provides experience for all vehicle crew members, helping them reach new proficiency levels.
 Directives: Useful boosters to enhance vehicle and crew effectiveness.
 Retraining Orders: Items to respec your crew members and tailor them to your preferred playstyle.

[hr][/hr]
Rally your team and dive into the action! Frontline Episode 3 is your last chance this year to experience the epic 30v30 battles and secure top-tier rewards. Assemble your crew, strategize, and conquer the battlefield before the event concludes on November 25!

notes.title: Tech Tree Trade-In
notes.content:
Commanders!

The Tech Tree Trade-In option debuts in World of Tanks on October 24 and allows you to obtain a new vehicle branch (Tiers VI to X) without needing to do any additional research, just trade in one of your existing researched branches! This is the perfect opportunity to get some new vehicles if there's a line sitting in your garage that you just don't use anymore, so read on for more details.

[previewyoutube=kVJgey4F23c;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are the main things you need to know:

You “de-research” Tiers VI–X of any single completely researched vehicle branch of your choice—to instantly research Tiers VI–X of a single unresearched vehicle branch from those available for the trade-in. Every owned vehicle of Tiers VI to X from the branch you give away will be replaced by its counterpart from the target branch. 
A Tech Tree Trade-In fee applies. The base price is in gold, but you can add bonds, blueprints, and Free XP to bring the gold expenses down to zero. All the calculations will be shown in the Tech Tree Trade-In interface in the game client before you confirm the trade-in. 
The Tech Tree Trade-In operation is irreversible and can only be made once. Before making your decision, please explore in detail the target branch, the final resource cost of the operation, and the effect it will have on your vehicles, crews, equipment, etc. 
Recently introduced branches are not available for trade-in.
You can only make one trade-in. The operation is time-limited and cannot be undone, so choose wisely!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c726e99b0069c52abe18e30c40b73f19a4a2b280.jpg


For full information on Tech Tree Trade-in, be sure to visit the news article.

LEARN MORE

notes.content:

Commanders!

We want to inform you of an upcoming maintenance period that will impact the accessibility of most World of Tank services, including the game.
Scheduled Downtime
EU: From October 22, 2024, at 09:00 CEST through October 22, 2024, at 10:30 CEST (UTC+2)

NA: From October 22, 2024, at 00:00 PT through October 22, 2024, at 01:30 PT (UTC-7)

ASIA: From October 22, 2024, at 15:00 UTC+8 through October 22, 2024, at 16:30 UTC+8

Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours
Following the maintenance period, we will require several additional hours to restore the full functionality of all services. We kindly ask for your patience and understanding while the work is being carried out. Your game account and progress will not be impacted.

Linked Accounts Across All Regions
We are excited to announce a major update aimed at streamlining your gaming experience: the implementation of a linked account system across all regions. If you have multiple regional accounts registered to the same email address, these will now be managed under a single, unified system. This change is purely technical and will not affect your progress, items, or any other account assets.

Who Is Affected
This change will impact only players with multiple accounts in different regions registered to the same email address or those who use the same social network account to access multiple accounts in different regions. This update will let you consolidate them into one.
For further information and updates read the full article.

notes.title: Babylon Project: Mechanics of the Halloween Special
notes.content:
Commanders! 

The Babylon Project is the beginning of a new chapter in the Mirium saga. Prove your mettle in the classic mode, where you go deeper into the subspace layers or take on the new Last Stand mode with incoming waves of enemies to repel.

Complete the event progression to learn more about the rich story behind the events and to collect valuable rewards, including the Nergal, a unique Tier VIII Premium heavy risen out of the deep.

Game Modes

        [th]Classic Mode[/th]
        [th]Last Stand Mode[/th]

        [td]
 Teams of five dive into the subspace, battling enemies and confronting a boss on the fourth layer.
 No need to deliver Mirium; defeat enemies to automatically progress through levels.
 Collect Mirium to power up tank abilities.

 Tank abilities are determined by your pre-battle consumable loadout.

The deeper you go, the more mysteries you reveal and rewards you’ll collect—keep pushing forward to dominate this Halloween event!

The next chapter of the Mirium saga begins! After the demise of Mirny-13, the research of the enigmatic substance was taken over by the international team of Babylon Project. It's time to battle echo tanks spawned by Mirium, uncover new secrets, and earn new rewards!

notes.title: Introducing: Czechoslovakian Autocannon Light Tanks!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Update 1.26 introduces a brand-new Czechoslovakian light tank line into the game. These vehicles have great potential for bold and exciting gameplay due to the twin autocannons that most of them are wielding.
[previewyoutube=3TGfT4JdYuI;full][/previewyoutube]
Spot and Shoot in Bursts
Starting from Tier VIII, all light tanks in the new Czechoslovakian line have twin autocannons as their main armament. Autocannons have medium calibers and a rapid rate of fire: up to 3,000 shots per minute. You can empty the guns' clip in one go, which takes just a few seconds. All of this gives a unique appeal to the gameplay of vehicles from the new branch.

 Aim for vulnerable spots: Medium caliber means medium armor penetration.
 Mind your dispersion: Due to the physics of rapid-fire guns, dispersion steadily increases during a burst. For your convenience, there’s a shooting efficiency indicator.
 Do damage at close range: Accuracy also decreases as the distance to the target grows.
 Choose the ammo type wisely: Opt for higher pen and lower damage, average pen and average damage, or lower pen and higher damage.
 Flank enemies for phenomenal burst damage: If you load HE rounds and your target is not well-armored, you can literally rip it apart.
 Plan your retreat: Firing autocannons lowers your camo values; luckily, your mobility is enough to escape (especially if you think about your options in advance).
 Spot for the team: The new Czechoslovaks have decent base view ranges, so besides ripping enemies apart, they are good at the common light tanks' specialty: reconnaissance.
 Take notice: Twin-barreled tank mechanics don't apply to twin autocannons, as their extremely high rate of fire negates consecutive/salvo shot mechanics. Plus, your rounds from both guns will be headed to a single point on the enemy vehicle rather than to two separate points.

Meet the New Czechoslovaks
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width="80%"]Škoda T 17: This Tier VII light tank is the only one in the new branch without the signature twin autocannons, but it is sort of a transition vehicle. Its single autoloader gun has a clip of 5 rounds and a very short intra-clip reloading time.[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/90bdd8181dca65967a9b91e36eb8d478ce8ad101.png[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td width="80%"]Vz. 64 Blesk: This Tier VIII predator is the first in the line with the twin autocannons and the new and unusual things they drag in—like firing in controlled bursts (minding your increasing dispersion) and the shooting efficiency indicator.[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c1d508a58c6327c44bd0b25db3098000287f76ca.png[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td width="80%"]LPT-67 Šelma: Sitting (most likely, prowling) at Tier IX, this light tank has the same gameplay formula as its predecessor. It's a decent scout, an absolute scourge of thin-armored foes, and a menace to those who have at least one medium-sized weak spot.[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fcb66f8a4c9b4c2b7046451f926315d4a95229c6.png[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td width="80%"]Vz. 71 Tesák: This tank at the top of the branch wields a pair of powerful 57-mm autocannons and by virtue of its tier, is the most dangerous enemy-shredder in the family. Its introduction will surely make waves in the meta. Try to ride them![/td]

notes.title: Crew Perks Update: A Revolutionary New System
notes.content:
Commanders!

Update 1.26 brings about a major revision of the Crew Perk System. It introduces new perks, rebalances existing ones, and provides flexible perk management options.
[previewyoutube=yABtHIGIvjM;full][/previewyoutube]
Main Changes in the Crew Perk System

 Maximum Six Perks per Crew Member: Each crew member can now have a maximum of six perks (including zero perks). Directives will not effectively grant you a seventh perk under any circumstances.
 Bonus Perks: Crew members with multiple roles benefit from the "bonus perk" system. This allows the perks of additional qualifications to be trained alongside the main perks without requiring extra XP or increasing training time.
 Shared Perk Effectiveness: In crews where multiple members share the same role, such as two loaders, the effectiveness of their perks is now shared between them. To achieve 100% effectiveness of a perk, both crew members must fully train it.
 Rebalanced and New Perks: Over a dozen new perks have been introduced. Additionally, existing perks, such as "Sound Detection" and "Firefighting", have been rebalanced.
 Post-Progression System: Half of the Crew XP earned by six-perk crews in battles will contribute to a single Post-Progression, rewarding players with a Universal Training Guide after reaching 100,000 XP milestones.
 Perk Reset Options: Resetting a crew member will also affect Zero Perks, allowing you to choose an entirely new perk setup. Two new buttons in the Barracks enable players to simultaneously reset and assign perks for all crew members.

Implementation of Changes: Key Outtakes

 Players with crew members exceeding the six-perk limit will receive compensation in the form of National Crew Books.
 For the first 30 days after Update 1.26, players can reset perks as many times as they like, for any crew. Afterward, each crew member will have one free reset.

Get the details on the changes to the Crew Perk System and their implementation!
LEARN MORE

notes.title: Onslaught: Season of the Azure Manticore Is Coming Your Way!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Year of the Manticore, Commanders! 

Prepare for another challenging battle journey as we kick off the 2024-2025 Onslaught annual cycle! It will feature three dynamic seasons with a shared progression system, starting with the Season of the Azure Manticore with the release of Update 1.26. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b44aabf8b8210bb9a44f872b768cee6f83eeb5a.jpg
Annual Rewards: Introducing the Stinger 

The Onslaught 2024-2025 Annual Reward includes the Stinger, a Tier X heavy tank that is a stunning replica of the T57 Heavy Tank. This unique vehicle features a striking 3D style and comes with a special crew that adds to its exclusivity. Collect 9 or more Onslaught Colors (special mode’s currency) across the Seasons to earn this exceptional tank, along with other valuable rewards. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/58be482f13fc59dc6a9b94e617f877507e775aa1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/50d8a8dd14e05b6a34810f7a59f7b308ae2581a7.jpg
In addition to the Annual Reward, you will also be able to earn various seasonal customization rewards, including the fresh "Hybrid Beast" progressive 2D style.

Changes in the Ranking System: Rebalanced Progression
We’ve streamlined the ranking system to make it more balanced and accessible: 

 Iron Rank: Major adjustments to make progression easier. 
 Bronze Rank: Moderate changes to facilitate smoother advancement. 
 Silver Rank: Minor tweaks to enhance the ease of moving up. 

Lucky Chips Missions
Onslaught will feature weekly Lucky Chips missions that must be completed consecutively and are exclusive to the mode. Each mission brings you some valuables, like days of WoT Premium Account, bonds, or credits. On top of that, completing a week’s set of five missions gives you a Lucky Chip. Every additional Lucky Chip will automatically bring you a new reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4cafbb591e2921475dcc74910f6578203a7dd9d0.png

Updated Modifiers for Battles 
For the first time in Onslaught (and World of Tanks), we’re rolling out a change to one of the essential gameplay mechanics:

 Range of Potential Damage: Reduced from +/-25% to a more predictable +/-12%.  

Given the competitive spirit of Onslaught, this adjustment makes damage outcomes in the mode more predictable and reliable. 

We've also updated several other modifiers and introduced additional changes—find out more details from our portal article.

notes.title: Overwhelming Fire Returns with Even More Rewards!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e1f7b793b7ebd195d3fca3c30cc78bb6d47f1df9.jpg

The Overwhelming Fire mode returns to World of Tanks, Commanders! 

There will be two launches of this unique mode this August. It will feature the eight familiar special vehicles with autocannons, so prepare for an unforgettable experience and great reward earnings!
First Launch
EU: From August 9 at 08:00 through August 11 at 22:00 (UTC)
NA: From August 9 at 14:00 through August 12 at 05:00 (UTC)
ASIA: From August 9 at 05:00 through August 11 at 20:00 (UTC)

Second Launch
EU: From August 16 at 08:00 through August 18 at 22:00 (UTC)
NA: From August 16 at 14:00 through August 19 at 05:00 (UTC)
ASIA: From August 16 at 05:00 through August 18 at 20:00 (UTC)
What's New?
Get ready for dynamic battles with the same eight fast-firing vehicles, now enhanced with a new animated Progression system. Enjoy clearer combat statistics in our revamped post-battle screen.

Extensive Animated Progression With Stage Rewards:

 6 Rewarding Stages: Each stage offers valuable rewards like credits, bonds, directives, days of WoT Premium Account, and random rewards from a predetermined list.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b41dde39be93c688f06df4f14b34425bed3a2b60.png
 Complete Special Missions: Earn Progression Points by completing three base missions in Overwhelming Fire to advance through the stages.
 Unlimited Post-Progression: Unlock unlimited stages after the Main Progression, granting credits and some random rewards from a predetermined list.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d5a20b5da0114e4f1351a35d1e07451a490c5314.png
Dedicated Post-Battle Screen:

 Detailed Combat Statistics: Displaying all your combat statistics, such as destroyed enemies and assisted/blocked damage.
 No Cost Gameplay: You won't receive credits or XP, but you also won't spend anything. The mode's zero economy is clearly explained.

Battle Pass Points Earning

 When you reach certain Stages of the Main Progression, you will earn Battle Pass Points, which will increase with each new Stage. 

Rewards
Play in unique vehicles with automatic cannons to earn bonds, directives, days of WoT Premium Account, Personal Reserves, Free XP, and more! Tons of rewards await you both in the Main Progression and during your Post-Progression journey.

The Vehicles
Overwhelming Fire features eight familiar Tier X vehicles, each with unique automatic cannon sub-mechanics.

[expand type=details]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8bbe2a54bf0e47ebfff3437433df599d413fd297.jpg
[/expand]

Rules

 Only the eight special vehicles created for the mode can participate in Overwhelming Fire battles. They are all of the same tier.
 The matchmaker will limit the maximum number of B-C CS 59s (rocket arty) and EBR 40s on a team to two of each. The rest of the vehicles can be mixed and matched without limits.
 Random Battles rules apply: 15v15, with Standard Battles, Assault, and Encounter Battles possible.
 Battles can occur on any maps used for Tier X Random Battles (except Grand Battles maps).
 You don't earn credits or XP in the Overwhelming Fire mode, but you don't spend credits on repairs, ammo, etc.
 Credits earned by completing Stages are not added to the respective Reserve.
 You cannot complete missions except those created specifically for the mode.
 Platoons are available, but Platoon bonuses don't apply.

Prepare to unleash rapid-fire chaos in the updated Overwhelming Fire mode, Commanders!

notes.title: Assemble the Brand-New Vickers MBT Mk. 3!
notes.content:
The Assembly Shop returns, Commanders!

From July 25, 2024 through July 28, 2024, you can construct the brand-new Vickers MBT Mk. 3, a Tier X British medium tank. Only 80,000 (EU) / 10,000 (NA) / 10,000 (ASIA) of these exclusive vehicles will be assembled, and the initial 40,000 (EU) / 5,000 (NA) / 5,000 (ASIA) will feature the mindblowing 3D style with a unique serial number. Get ready to build a mobile fighter that carries one of the best guns on Tier X and can excel at mid and long-range damage dealing! 
EU: From July 25, 2024 at 19:00 CEST (UTC+2) through July 29 at 01:00 CEST (UTC+2)*
NA: From July 25, 2024 at 18:00 PT (UTC-7) through July 28, 2024 at 22:00 PT (UTC-7)*
ASIA: From July 25 at 12:00 (UTC) through July 28 at 16:00 (UTC)*

*Please note that the event may finish early if all vehicles are assembled before the end of the event.
The Assembly Shop: How it Works

Invest various game resources—blueprint fragments, Free XP, credits, gold, and bonds—to build the brand-new Vickers MBT Mk. 3. What amount of each resource to invest, is up to you.  
Just 80,000 (EU) / 10,000 (NA) / 10,000 (ASIA) Vickers MBT Mk. 3s will be available for assembly. On top of a fine vehicle, the first 40,000 (EU) / 5,000 (NA) / 5,000 (ASIA) players will get the magnificent 3D style with an individual number. The numbers will be assigned to tanks sequentially, from smallest to largest. 
Once all 40,000 (EU) / 5,000 (NA) / 5,000 (ASIA) numbered styles and accompanying vehicles have been claimed, another 40,000 (EU) / 5,000 (NA) / 5,000 (ASIA) tanks will still be available. They will come in their standard configuration—without the 3D style and individual style number—and will be up for assembly until the end of the event or until they run out.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/078566f0fa714753990a462b5af47dda158cfeaf.jpg

Combine and Invest Resources in Different Ratios!
Remember that you can invest various resources to craft your Vickers MBT Mk. 3. There are plenty of combinations to make the progress bar reach 100%; everything depends on what you have at your disposal. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/19f49960ff305fd1696424f75bd0c2e01fb1480a.png

Resources are deducted as soon as you add them to the Assembly Shop, but you can reclaim or redistribute them at any time by clicking the Return Resources button. If you don’t craft the Vickers MBT Mk. 3 by the end of the event, all the resources you invested will return to your account automatically. 
The Vickers MBT Mk. 3: A Versatile Damage Dealer
You have an opportunity to craft a swift medium tank tailored for sniping and also very good at dealing damage from mid-range. The Vickers MBT Mk. 3 is able to take both precision and snap shots, and this makes its tactics highly flexible. Playing it requires concentration and tactical awareness (especially at mid-range) but can be highly rewarding. Also, the vehicle has undeniably British looks which is very definitely a plus. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2799ea8be753fecbfbe4855d4a87cd7f59ab41b8.jpg

Gameplay Features

Gun—Precision and DPM: The Vickers MBT Mk. 3's 105-mm L7 gun is one of the best at Tier X: the most precise, with outstanding aiming time and stabilization, and a maximum depression angle of −10°. The DPM can exceed 3,400 points with crew perks and equipment. On top of that, shells of every type travel really fast and have good armor penetration values. 
Mobility—Tactical and Strategic:The Vickers MBT Mk. 3's very decent base top speed (which can be improved to 60 km/h with a Turbocharger) is complemented by excellent specific power, giving it good acceleration. This enables you to quickly leave positions once spotted, change directions multiple times during a battle, and have plenty of flanking opportunities.
View Range—A Clear Advantage:With a base value of 410 m, the Vickers MBT Mk. 3's excellent sight gives you a good chance to notice enemies before they spot you. Together with the tank’s mobility, this can keep you out of trouble as its armor shouldn’t be relied on.

Learn more about the Assembly Shop and the versatile The Vickers MBT Mk. 3 from the article on our portal. 
FIND OUT MORE


Prepare to claim your Vickers MBT Mk. 3 and cross your fingers for interesting numbers, Commanders!

notes.title: Onslaught Light: Play With No Ranks in Tier VIII Vehicles!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8031063871672c9b3f32fbc6f53cdfb2536cc201.jpg

Commanders,

From July 10 to July 24, join the Onslaught Light experimental mode via the mode selector! Play 7v7 in Tier VIII vehicles by the familiar Onslaught rules in a more relaxed, yet also more lucrative way: You never lose your progress and can bring along your Tier VIII Premium vehicles.

How Is Onslaught Light Different?

 Tier VIII only, except for SPGs and a few excluded vehicles of other types.
 No Ranks or Qualification: with lower stakes, play for fun (and profit)!
 Standalone event: not part of the Onslaught Year/Season cycles.
 Credit and XP gain: as in Tier VIII Random Battles.
 Premium vehicles allowed: all respective bonuses apply.
 Event Progression: play well, earn Progression points (with no loss), and receive extra rewards!How Is Onslaught Light Similar to the "Heavy" Mode?

 7v7 battles: more room to shine.
 All Onslaught modifiers apply:

 ↑ vehicle hit points ↑
 ↓ consumables cooldown time ↓
 ↓ dispersion at 100 m ↓
 ↓ time remaining visible ↓
 ↓ proximity spotting radius ↓ Platoons and Super Platoons: play with a friend or in a pre-made team of seven commanders.
 Fog of War: no info on the enemy team until their vehicles are spotted.
 Pre-battle preparation: select your vehicle and its configuration during the countdown.
 Points of Interest: capture to use Tactical Skills (Divisional Radar, Artillery Strike).
 Role Skills: these depend on your vehicle type and role. Accumulate Prestige Points in battle to build up their charge level.Learn more about the Onslaught gameplay rules and mechanics in the game client.
Excluded Vehicles
Onslaught Light is an experimental mode, and some vehicles are unsuitable for this new format due to their combat roles. Plus, some tanks overperform at Tier VIII under the special battle conditions in the Onslaught format and can decide the outcome of battles, so we've excluded them from the mode:

[expand] BZ-176 
 Löwe 
 T34 and T34B
 FCM 50t
 Gonsalo
 AAT60[/expand]
Also excluded are all Tier VIII SPGs—as per the general Onslaught rules.
Event Progression
Onslaught Light has a 15-Stage event Progression with nice rewards, including Experimental Equipment and components, bonds, credits, Personal Reserves, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/05c87d5af531c1039472bf4e3e3a3f22e108b772.png

The Progression rewards also include the unique "Enlightenment" 2D style and decals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e604d18538e91a37b4a059c779d8d938bd6927b8.jpg
Earning Progression points is simple: everyone gets some (except the last player by Prestige Points on the losing team). Also you never lose points.

[expand]
Progression Points Distribution
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3c75285c02756569f1abd674defd54c45edb6355.png

You can score even more Progression points by completing daily Battle Missions in the mode.

[expand]
Daily Battle Missions

Continue doing missions after you max out the mode Progression. Completing each mission will yield you 20 bonds.

Prepare your favorite Tier VIIIs for the fun and lucrative mode, Commanders!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/04000a92d20edcae257204b18053490638371397.png

Commanders!

Prepare to experience the refreshed Darkness of the Night Arcade Cabinet mode, featuring night battles with several gameplay changes! Running from June 28 through June 30 and from July 5 through July 7, it will engage you in intense combat under the cover of darkness with limited visibility. Access this exciting mode via the mode selector and become the unseen threat on the battlefield!
Available from June 28 through June 30, 2024, and from July 5 through July 7, 2024
What's New?
Compared to the previous launch back in 2023, Darkness of the Night has several gameplay and visual changes. Check them out:

New map: special version of Fjords shrouded in darkness. It features dimmed lighting and rain. The precipitation does not affect the gameplay but adds to the mood. It won't impact the performance of your system significantly.
Jamming modifier removed due to feedback. Signal range is no longer cut in half.

Maps
Night battles will unfold on the following transformed maps:

NEW! Fjords.
Glacier.
Sand River.
Lakeville. 

All maps will feature a pale moon glowing in the sky and a few other light sources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/270e0a142beccc527e9fd11ac74325d6516284ea.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/64fb96ef0bc1619ef9e30f9e3433db2d770623a2.jpg

Battle Rules

You can play in any Tier VIII or Tier X vehicle.
Battles are 15v15 and single-tiered.
Platoons are available, and all Platoon bonuses apply.
You cannot complete missions except those created specifically for the mode.
Credits and XP can be earned.
Battle Pass Points and bonds cannot be earned.
All types of Reserves (Personal and Clan) can be used.
XP multipliers for the first victory of the day do apply.
Credits are added to the Credit Reserve.
Gold is not added to the Gold Reserve.

Battle Modifiers
In this mode, players can expect a special set of battle modifiers that will change the familiar game rules.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4831dc3fe72bb2e2bb6b7794adcc646e90a0ff58.png

Rewards

[/tr]
[/table]

notes.title: Frontline Is Back: Fight Epic 30v30 Battles & Earn D-Day Tokens!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8dfd36b87a3e71001ed8558e27f0d2fa849fbf22.png

Commanders!

Frontline returns to the game with Episode 1! Available from June 10 through June 17, it offers intense 30v30 action on three gigantic maps and rich rewards.

Maps
All Frontline maps have three lines. The first two lines consist of 1×1 km sectors which the attackers must capture. The undivided third line houses the main objectives of the attacking side: massive gun turrets.
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width="12%"][/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c687c17f1a06f35e570b4954ffb1e3415043533a.png[/td]
[td width="12%"][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
The set of colossal (9 km² each) locations is the same as usual: you can find yourself on green Normandie, snow-covered Kraftwerk, or sandy Fata Morgana.

Dynamic Battle Scenarios
The dynamic battle scenarios system from the last Episode is in place, offering three different sets of rules regarding Combat Reserves. You play by one of the three scenarios selected randomly before a battle begins (the scenario type will be shown on the loading screen).
[center]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4a6c87980912e1cca903c4c4fbcb219a261e2b24.png[/center]

 Standard Battle (34% chance): Combat Reserves are used as per the regular Frontline rules.
 Operational Support (33% chance): Combat Reserves' cooldown time is decreased by 50% (after the start of a battle, respawning, or unlocking a new Reserve).
 Twist of Fate (33% chance): Upon reaching certain Ranks in this scenario, choose between two randomly selected Combat Reserves. Combat Reserves placed in slots in the Garage before battle have a better chance of being offered for selection, and the Level of Reserves purchased with Combat Reserve Points will increase by 1 in battle (so they will have 4 Levels).


Rewards
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width="75%"]In Episode 1 of Frontline, you can get plenty of rewards. Along with Combat Reserve Points, they include Experimental Equipment, Battle Pass Points, bonds, a Universal Manual, Directives, and Retraining Orders.
On top of these regular rewards, this time you can earn D-Day Tokens in Frontline. Go to the Command Center, accept "Into the Frontline!" Personal Battle Mission, and participate in three Frontline battles to receive 5 D-Day Tokens. These can get you awesome prizes from the D-Day Store that include Premium vehicles.[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/83de4f0ed424d95b466812ec1910a04a2acdfbfb.png[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

LEARN MORE

Join the Frontline mode for large battles and nice rewards!

Join our esteemed hosts Richard “The Challenger” Cutland and David “eekeeboo” Baggley as they broadcast live from the deck of the only known surviving Landing Craft Tank in the UK that participated in D-Day. Built to carry tanks directly onto the beaches of Normandy, these unique machines played a crucial role in the success of Operation Overlord.

 Richard is our Head of Military Relations and served for almost 30 years in The Royal Tank Regiment of the British Army.
 David, World of Tanks’ Head of Community, is well-versed in World War II history and excellent at flipping virtual tanks.

Together, they will take you on a two-hour journey through history, exploring significant sights, exceptional museums, and key locations connected to the Normandy Landings and Operation Overlord. 
Please note that the stream will only be available in English.

Twitch Drops
Available on June 8, 2024  from 16:00 UTC through 18:00 UTC

Exclusive Twitch Drops will be available during the stream, including a Mystery Drop with Premium Vehicles. Tune in for a chance to get these rewards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/37477e2fd8e8054a267414fdfd2bf48692c608e3.jpg
How to Receive Twitch Drops
In order to receive Twitch Drops, you need to have a completed account linked to your email. If you haven't completed this process yet, you'll need to do so first to participate in the activity. After that, make sure to link your World of Tanks and Twitch accounts to receive your prize. You can check our official Twitch Drops guide to learn more.

[hr][/hr]
We look forward to having you join us for this special livestream as we honor the bravery and sacrifice of those who took part in the Normandy landings. Set your reminders and tune in to our official World of Tanks Twitch channel on June 8!

notes.title: Operation Overlord: Join a New PvE Mode!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d7a17668ff68902876f44386afe668a5642c09bd.jpg

From June 6 through July 4, experience the historically inspired Operation Overlord PvE mode and join the iconic Normandy landings. Dedicated to the 80th anniversary of D-Day, the largest amphibious operation in military history, this single-player combat scenario immerses you in the pivotal events of June 6, 1944. 

Available from June 6, 2024, at 02:00 UTC through July 4, 2024 at 02:00

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/46190338d5a2381ac2d1bceeeefe5cbe3c73ae8d.png
Mode Objectives
Operation Overlord is a single-player battle scenario inspired by the real historical events of D-Day during World War II. As part of a team of AI-driven allies, you fight against computer-controlled enemies.

Your first objective is to break through the coastal defenses and minefields. Secure the beachhead by targeting and destroying coastal bunkers, suppressing enemy positions, and breaching fortified defenses.
Work with your AI-driven allies to ensure mission success.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/47f5179bca3b33c432507f8a4523de2787dd0655.png
Difficulty Levels and Missions
The mode has two difficulty levels: Regular and Rigorous, with missions providing different rewards for each level. Both levels are available from the start.
Each difficulty has three missions: The first is available on June 6, while the other two remain locked until June 13, when all three become available. The second and third missions mirror the first one but with added challenges to enhance your gameplay experience.

Core Gameplay

 Each operation is intuitive: Rush forward, follow navigation markers, and destroy enemies and coastal bunkers on sight. Here are some highlights and unique play mechanics of the mode:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a155029c5e1d436c4eab2e6bd623a61486f5f841.png
 Event Map: Battles will unfold on the special Overlord map, enriched with many details and interactive objects to replicate the atmosphere of the Normandy landings.
 Combat Vehicle: You will head into battle in the legendary M4A3E8 Sherman.

Unique Features

 Battleship Support: Surprise enemies by using your shell tracers to help the USS Frankford target enemy bunkers on the fog-covered beach.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/46786b99afd9be4d19c3545a1e71e27492ada219.png

 Smoke Signals: Available after disabling enemy anti-aircraft defenses, use these to mark targets like enemy fortifications and vehicles for allied battleships.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/eecdf80b470358d2af4346c3ffc5415533059ba8.png

 Minefields: The coastline area is littered with mines, so move carefully! You have a unique support vehicle on your side, however. The Sherman Crab will help you and your allies to navigate the buried explosives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ae4a45e8c046b22d97c76e3354aa30eba4e55a71.png
Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/24bf368f7740734de992b29057fa0c5e969287e0.png
Each difficulty level only has one mission available at the start of the event, with additional missions and extra rewards active from June 13. The reward pool includes:

 Credits
 Bonds
 Free XP
 Battle Pass Points

2D Styles and Camos
Rewards also include two stunning all-season 2D styles and two cool camos inspired by the events of D-Day.
Once you complete all missions for Rigorous difficulty, you will also receive the commemorative "Overlord Veteran" medal.

Good luck on the sandy beaches of Normandy, Commanders! Complete historically inspired missions and earn unique styles alongside other rewards!

notes.title: Steel Hunter Returns!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Steel Hunter, the much-loved battle royale mode, is back with us again. From May 20 through June 2, prepare for free-for-all survival on ever-shrinking maps in eight mode-specific vehicles upgraded as the battle goes on. Expect intense rivalry and nice rewards, enhanced visual effects for multiple abilities, plus brand-new features making survival more social, including Platoon voice chat and Random Platoons.

Team up with a stranger and become survival mates with them!

[previewyoutube=JlqxLcxpWVg;full][/previewyoutube]

What's New?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5f0d0d1d6dd75c24fdf907a3a456529b0a2b1c79.jpg

Random Platoons 

 Activate this option in the Steel Hunter Garage.
 You will be assigned a mate with the best suitable skill level (as measured by Steel Hunter performance)*.
 If you enjoy your random co-survivor's company, you may offer to convert your Random Platoon to a regular Steel Hunter Platoon. This option is available on the battle results screen. 


Steel Hunter Platoon voice chat** 

 Use it while in a Random or a regular Steel Hunter Platoon.
 If your Steel Hunter Platoon is a regular one, you can also use the voice chat in the Garage.


Chat Wheel 

 Familiar to you from Random Battles and activated by the "T" key by default, it can improve communication with Platoon mates if you cannot use the voice chat for some reason.


VFX changes to Combat Abilities 

 Apply to multiple vehicles, upscale the visuals, and help tell whether an Ability is being used by an enemy or your ally. 


*In case finding a Platoon partner takes longer than usual, the skill requirements may be eased.
**Voice chat must be enabled in the game settings. It's activated by pressing a key designated in the key bindings menu.

Progression Rewards
Collect Progression Points and Steel Seals in Steel Hunter by playing well and also by completing event-specific daily missions. The Points will advance your Progression, with every Stage giving various rewards. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ea789e65d9a8b956d6793f43a3109246e4f4de9.jpg

Items for Steel Seals
Exchange Steel Seals you receive in the mode into unique vehicle customization items! You can do this in the in-game Store until June 10. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/12485602c423bfa0158ce03b00822c24a0831634.jpg

Changes to VFX and Combat Abilites 

 Arlequin: the Airstrike Combat Ability now ignores armor; damage dealt and stun efficiency is maximal in the center of the blast zone and diminishes to its edges.
 The drops’ and all vehicles’ visual effects interact with the terrain better.
 The respawn visual effects have been enhanced for all vehicles.
 The visual effects have been upgraded for several Combat Abilities: Minefield (Varyag), Trap and Target Tracking (Raven), Acid Shell (Bái Láng), Surging Fervor and Electric Discharge (Huragan); for the latter Ability, your own or your ally’s zone of effect is now visually distinct from those of the enemies.


Learn everything about Steel Hunter in the complete guide.

LEARN MORE

Prepare for the big hunt and remember that hunting in packs is now more convenient than ever!

The AAT60 is the first of the two new stars of the show. Single-shot damage, DPM, handling, accuracy, shell velocity and penetration values, elevation and depression angles—the AAT60 has it all. Just don’t expose it to enemy fire, and you’ll truly shine.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4a2981ef19e997e1e63f48e0ccb19d1cd5df54f7.png
The Nemesis is the second newcomer, and it’s the embodiment of hull-down play. This tank has excellent frontal turret armor, and its gun has a great maximum depression angle. While its reload time is a little long, the single-shot damage is worth the wait.

notes.title: Call to the Final Frontier
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/30ba184bf9de6f58b08a971763ad787461fe82d8.png
To the final frontier, Commanders!
A mysterious alien Object stole the antimatter straight from the warp core of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Use your vehicle combat skills while competing with other crewmates to recover the antimatter and research the alien Object. Help the iconic flagship resume her five-year mission!
CALL TO THE FINAL FRONTIER
Available from May 2, 2024 at 08:00 UTC through May 13, 2024 at 04:00 UTC

[previewyoutube=N4CY4YlCg8o;full][/previewyoutube]
Recruit Iconic Characters
Free Mission Progress rewards include three iconic Star Trek characters: Captain James T. Kirk, Commander Spock, and comms specialist Nyota Uhura, all with custom voiceovers. Put them in charge of your vehicles in Random Battles!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/55c6da28b5f081718cbade942d9eac2aff7273f3.png
Ride Your Rover Into the Mission Area
The mysterious alien Object is placing Antimatter Fragments in strange patterns on the asteroid’s surface. Use a remote-controlled Rover to collect Fragments before your U.S.S. Enterprise crewmates beat you to it, guided by Mr. Scott. Captain Kirk encourages healthy competition and wants to test the vehicles’ performance, so use your Rover’s abilities and power-ups!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/039f2f9a85bef3be4f834f1f73d65115e286a571.png
Get Rewarded by Starfleet
Free Mission Progress rewards include unique Star Trek-themed content. Complete daily event missions and earn a 2D style, decals, and inscriptions, as well as three Commanders with unique voiceovers and an Orion Lockbox!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0b6eb0879a3352687ce7ad446993e12b83515a9c.png
Get More Orion Lockboxes 
Some precious items ended up in the hands of Orion merchants who sell them in lockboxes. The possible loot (a merchant word indeed!) includes ten armored vehicles from Earth’s past. Two of them were previously unknown: the AAT60 and the Nemesis.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/effac763689cec07a6dd7c9e4ffb4cce09b26c08.jpg
Meet New Armored Vehicles
The two newcomers from Orion Lockboxes are both Tier VIII Premium medium tanks with very good gun depression values. The AAT60 combines great gun handling with solid DPM, and can sport the fascinating Emissary 3D style. The Nemesis has a very sturdy turret and excellent single-shot damage.
Scan the Emissary 3D Style
"Found this one when we were looking for that T95 we lost during field trials. The ground 'round the thing was...strange, wrinkled. Like it had been fried or something. And what a remarkable piece of equipment, this tank. Looks a bit like one of ours, right? But I heard Doc getting all excited about the 'improbable alloy' it's made of—after he managed to chip a bit off the lower plate. Hope his ravings can stir up some of the top brass to get the tank outta our depot and into some fancy top-secret lab. Because I’m telling you, it looks like it can fly—or even more. You know, the little green men that built it—just for fun, inspired by our exotic designs—they might find its remote control and press some buttons."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/71bb6280a66bf076030a2d326d6e558c2b96366f.jpg

To the Final Frontier!

notes.title: Update 1.24.1: Polish TDs, Crew Updates & More!
notes.content:
Attention Commanders! We're expanding the Polish tech tree with a new branch of tank destroyers. We're also fine-tuning the performance of four Tier X vehicles, improving five Random Battles maps, and introducing the new Postmortem Mode feature. That's not all—watch our detailed video or scroll down for more!

[previewyoutube=c602cGZ0AfU;full][/previewyoutube]

World of Tanks servers for Update 1.24.1 will be available from April 10

POLISH TD LINE
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/05d968373ffaafd28b474f6f014f0cab594b3941.jpg
The game’s first branch of Polish tank destroyers includes six researchable vehicles from Tier V to Tier X. Tiers V–VII showcase classic turretless TDs with traditional gameplay. Meanwhile, vehicles of Tiers VIII–X have deep-rifled guns with innovative shell mechanics. This enables them to unleash maximum damage in close combat. Check out the lineup!

DISCOVER TD DOMINANCE

ALL CREWS ARE NOW 100%!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b2d6e69674f97a887ba725ec1706d56580e87ee1.jpg
We're constantly enhancing the crew system. Here’s what's new this time:

 All crews now operate at 100% efficiency.
 The "major qualification level" has been renamed to "crew efficiency" for clarity.
 Perk efficiency penalty when retraining for free or for credits—gradually decreases with experience.
 Special retraining bonuses for newcomers.
 Option to switch tanker qualification when retraining for credits.
GET FULL DETAILS

TIER X VEHICLE REBALANCING
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5ec5267ad43ac5f33f98c006a5e3b31a8b264a23.jpg
Based on your feedback and our statistics, we identified four Tier X vehicles that required fine-tuning. The Pz.Kpfw. VII and AMX 50 Foch B receive performance boosts, while the Super Conqueror and Controcarro 3 Minotauro get slight adjustments to make them less formidable opponents.

To ensure consistency with the vehicles mentioned above, we're also tweaking the performance of surrounding Tier VIII-IX French and Italian TDs in their branches.

DISCOVER CHANGES

MAP REBALANCING
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4c404122be92911a0ae7bd6d2c6ce0e5e52092a0.jpg
We've revamped five Random Battle maps to enhance gameplay comfort. Mountain Pass has undergone more substantial changes. We've also made slight adjustments to various positions on the following maps: Karelia, Mines, El Halluf, and Outpost.

ONSLAUGHT: FIGHT FOR YOUR ANNUAL REWARD!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1e4025ca17bac6a40811989adb3135835ead0eb7.jpg
Prepare for the Season of the Jade Pegasus, the culmination of the Year of the Pegasus! Push yourself to the limit on the battlefield to earn a better Annual Reward. It might include the Hurricane Tier X medium tank and a variety of other valuable items. The closing Season of Onslaught 2023-2024 also brings:

 A brand-new piece of Improved Equipment: Innovative Targeting.
 Team Training with Onslaught maps.
 Fresh customization rewards.
DISCOVER ONSLAUGHT UPDATES

REFINE YOUR SKILLS WITH POSTMORTEM MODE!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1ade988e1d08fc5ad8f9a15407dd10d5823c83ab.jpg
Discover the new Postmortem Mode feature to boost your mastery on the battlefield! The feature provides vital insights into enemy positioning, shell trajectory, and penetration mechanics. It includes Last Moment—functionality that unveils crucial details of the shot that destroyed your vehicle. This offers both Detailed and Short versions.

The Postmortem Mode deepens your understanding of gameplay and helps you learn from every battle.
