{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png

Map Rebalancing and Two New Battlefields

During the Update 1.20.1 Common Tests, we will be adjusting the positioning of Points of Interest on Onslaught’s maps to determine their optimal location. We've also added two new locales to the set of maps available for the Onslaught mode: Glacier and Airfield. 

[quote=]The locations of Points of Interest on all maps may change and will be finalized after the Update 1.20.1 Common Tests.
Super Platoons Limits

In the Season of Crimson Griffin, we’ll remove the limits on the difference between the highest and lowest Rating Points value when creating Super Platoons. You can now join your friends in Super Platoons without restrictions, regardless of the ranks and divisions in which you play. For example, if you fight in the Debutant rank, you can join a Super Platoon in the Gold rank.

We’re also aiming to adjust the matchmaker so that Super Platoons get matched against opposing Super Platoons in battle.

Minimap Pings and Voice Chat

Here’s another improvement based on your feedback: We are removing the limits on the number of pings on the minimap to make it easier for players in Super Platoons to coordinate their actions in battle. It will be more convenient for you to interact with the team. Solo Commanders will also receive an increased number of pings on the minimap.

We’ve also made a slight improvement to the voice chat. If you were in voice chat as a solo player at the end of a battle, you will remain in voice chat in the next battle.

Rental Vehicles and Battle Pass Points

You will be awarded rental vehicles (the WZ-111 model 5A, the E 50 Ausf. M, and the T110E4) at the start of the Season. They will remain on your account until the end of the Season and will be removed when it’s over.

These rental vehicles will be available only for the Onslaught mode. It will be impossible to enter Random Battles or other modes using these tanks.

[quote=]You’ll also be able to earn Battle Pass Points when playing Onslaught.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png

Enjoy the Season of the Crimson Griffin, Commanders! And we’d love to hear your feedback to help us decide which changes Onslaught will feature in the next Season!

notes.title: Update 1.20.1: WoT Plus and Crew System Revision
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/964348838da8a4509fd147e9914fe7dae525c3f8.png

Commanders!

We would like to thank all those who participated in the Common Tests of the update, as your involvement has been instrumental in shaping the game’s future. Conducting public testing of updates before introducing them to the live game is a crucial step in this process, allowing us to collect reactions and gather feedback to create a better game for everyone.

Although Update 1.20.1 has introduced many new features and improvements, we have faced some challenges with two specific aspects of the update. WoT Plus will require some additional minor adjustments, while the Crew system will undergo more extensive changes. We are committed to addressing the issues raised by the community and ensuring that these features meet our high standards. Let’s dive into how we plan to accomplish this.

Changes to WoT Plus

Free demounting of “Improved Equipment,” the equipment type purchasable with bonds, was perceived as a bonus that would give subscribers an advantage. Our intention with WoT Plus is to provide subscribers comfort and convenience, not an upper hand in battles. Therefore, “Improved Equipment” will be excluded from the list of equipment that can be demounted for free with a WoT Plus subscription.

Changes to Crew Perks

The crew system has been an essential part of World of Tanks since its early days. It allows for fine-tuning a vehicle, boosting its best features, and mitigating shortcomings. These benefits stay with players as they advance through the tech tree, taking crews with them.

New perks and adjusting existing ones were meant to add more flexibility and diversity to the crew perks selection and make it more useful. However, this was negatively perceived as an increase in the disparity among the player base between competitive players, veterans with experienced crews, and new players. We do not intend to raise the number of perks needed to ensure that players can remain competitive during a battle in terms of vehicle performance.

As a result, we have made the decision not to introduce the new perks in their current state or proceed with the rebalancing of existing ones tested during the Common Tests.

[quote=]Please note, there is no need for a 30-day promotion that allows you to reset crew perks for free or to credit 12 retraining orders to all players.
Quality-of-Life Improvements to the Crew System

The revamped Crew System introduces several quality-of-life updates that were well-received by the community due to their usefulness. Additionally, these updates provide us with a solid foundation for future enhancements to crew perks and crew progressions. Thus, Update 1.20.1 will implement the following changes:

 Unifying perks and skills into perks that work from the start and become more effective as the level of major qualification increases. For example, the “Brothers in Arms” perk will start taking effect at 1%, even if only one crew member is trained in it.
 Removing experience penalties for injured crew members.
 Adding a battle interface for situational perks.
 Providing clear descriptions of perks and their effects.
 Displaying the effects of all perks in the vehicle characteristics widget.
We want to extend our appreciation for your continuous support and valuable feedback, which has empowered us to take an exciting next step with World of Tanks in Update 1.20.1. With a host of new features and enhancements, we believe that the game will be even more enjoyable for all players. Stay tuned to the portal for further details on the update's contents and our upcoming roadmap announcement outlining the planned content for later in 2023.

Thank you for being an integral part of the World of Tanks community, and we hope to see you soon on the battlefield!

Roll Out!

notes.title: Introducing the TSUU: Totally Serious Unbreakable Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0bdad9457ea8a546ebbf0813692de9e53f37f9c2.png

Commanders! 

Did you know that after every single Random Battle, we need to restore the battle map to its original look? A dedicated team of people (we call them the Map Docs) will spend a couple of hours rebuilding all of the destroyed structures, cleaning up debris, dragging away wrecked vehicles, and returning all those fallen trees back to their upright positions. 

But the real problem has always been the terrain. Tracks and wheels completely destroy all strategically placed grass, mess up our snow and sand placements, and absolutely obliterate city sidewalks. To understand the effort that our Map Docs put into restoring all that ruined terrain, we asked Greg, our Chief Terrain Specialist, to give us a special comment:

[quote=]Not an easy job, that. I mean, just imagine replanting grass across the whole of Malinovka after a heated battle. A lot of work, for sure. 

Greg, Chief Terrain Specialist from the Map Restoration Team
For years, we’ve been trying to overcome the problem. And today, we are proud to announce that Greg’s life—and the lives of the hundreds of other Map Docs—will now be much easier, as we’ve finally found the solution!

The Great Solution

Starting from April 1, the material of all vehicles’ tracks will be changed to Vibranium. Wheeled vehicles, in turn, will receive new-and-improved tires made with the addition of Adamantium powder. Both metals interact with the environment in a much better way than usual steel, so we expect to reduce the wear of our in-game maps by a whopping 25%!

Additionally, our analysts have estimated that this update will have the following additional positive effects on the game:

 The mechanics who repair tanks after battle should become happier by approximately 57%.
 All vehicles should look cooler by 0.001%.
Time to Test It Out!

Even though we are pretty sure about our calculations, we need you to prove them. We have created a special battle mission for you: Travel 5,000 meters in Random Battles on these new tracks (or wheels) and see how it feels! Of course, you will also receive a reward of a handful of crew skins for your contribution to our research.

Keep in mind that this special mission will be available only until April 3, 2023, at 08:00 UTC.

You can find the mission and track your progress (pun intended) in the “Missions” section of your Garage. Good luck!

Suggest More Ideas and Get a Reward!

At first, we thought adding Vibranium and Adamantium to the game was an absolutely crazy idea. However, it may really make a huge difference (especially for Greg). So we’ve decided to collect more unusual ideas. To do that, we are launching a special giveaway: Exchange your crazy idea for one Community Token!

To take part in the Giveaway, just do the following:

 Press the “Rate Up” button under this article.
 In the comments, write what you think we should add to the game to make it even more fun.
That’s it! If you complete these steps, you will receive your Community Token within a few days after the giveaway ends on April 2, 2023.

Steam Community Shop and Community Tokens: How It Works

[expand]
Community Tokens are a special currency that you earn by being an active member of the World of Tanks Steam Community and by participating in various events and activities. 

You can spend your Tokens in the Steam Community Shop in-game to select the rewards you need (rather than a predetermined reward, as it used to be). 

To find the Steam Community Shop, log in to the game, enter the Depot from your Garage and open the “Homefront Supplies” tab. There, you will find the Steam Community Shop with all available rewards and their cost in Community Tokens. 
[/expand]
Have Fun!

This extremely important update will probably (not) change the game forever. Complete the mission to test out the changes, get your rewards, participate in our giveaway, and enjoy April Fool’s Day!

[hr][/hr]
Important note: Unfortunately, the cargo ship with our supplies of Vibranium and Adamantium was hijacked by some bad guys, so the information above is just an April Fool’s joke. However, the special mission and the giveaway are real!

notes.title: New Crew Perk System Briefing
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/964348838da8a4509fd147e9914fe7dae525c3f8.png

Commanders!

Thank you to everyone who already participated in the Common test and shared their feedback. The new Crew Perk System is a significant update that will affect everyone, and we intend to make the transition to the new system as comfortable as possible. We believe the old system needed an update to provide more value for everyone.
 
The new system aims for:
[olist]
 Competitiveness of every perk. Moving away from the current situation where all players choose the same perks and creating an environment where diverse and thoughtful decision-making is encouraged.
 Solidifying the perk system. The same easily understandable rules apply to every player and crew, supported by game interfaces.
 Fair perk distribution. A roughly equal number of perks should be available for all qualifications, and the mechanics should work smoothly and fairly across the board.
 Easy implementation of future improvements. Establishing a foundation that easily allows the implementation of future improvements, such as:


 removal of 50% and 75% trained crew members,
 allowing a single crew to operate multiple vehicles,
 implementing mechanics to transfer unused crew experience from one crew to another
[/olist]Monetization was never part of these goals. We recognize that adjusting to these changes may not be simple, so we are introducing a special promotion to help you get comfortable with the new system, experiment with different configurations, and settle on your preferred setup. From the release of Update 1.20.1 until the end of 2023, this promotion allows you to reset crew perks for free for 30 days. When you log in to the game for the first time after the update, you’ll have one month to experiment with crew perks without any penalties. Additionally, we will credit 12 retraining orders to all players.

[quote=]You will receive the free crew perk reset from the release of Update 1.20.1 until the end of the year. The 30-day period starts immediately after the first login following the update.
FAQ

Several concerns were already raised during the Common test, and we would like to address them directly.

If all perks in the new system are useful, doesn’t this force players to get them all?

We’ve added more perks to the game and balanced them against each other to ensure their value depends on your playstyle and vehicles. However, we have not changed the experience progression system, as we are sure that having the ability to learn all perks shouldn’t be reachable. We also believe it’s important to have a sense of progression and to learn the perks gradually. Additionally, we’ve found that after the fifth or sixth perk, the resources required to progress outweigh the benefits gained. With more perks available now, players must decide which perks to choose and what final setup to get.

While perks can influence battles, it’s important to remember that factors such as map knowledge, driving skills, and tactical decision-making also play a crucial role. We’ve opted to maintain the experience system as it is to ensure that new players aren’t immediately outmatched by highly-trained opponents. It’s important to us to preserve the basics of crew training while encouraging players to think more deeply about their choices.

Why is the number of available perks per crew not limited?

Developing a few favorite crews is an important part of this and future changes. We have already announced that you will be able to train one crew for multiple vehicles. Also, we will let you transfer experience from unused tankers to crews you are using, and we don’t want to limit this system. We conducted experiments with perk limitations in Crew 2.0 on sandboxes, and these changes, among others, received negative feedback, which dissuaded us from implementing them in the game. As a result, we have focused on a more consistent approach to improving the current system.
Implementing such restrictions would also raise certain issues where no easy solutions are apparent, particularly for crews with already more perks than the limit which will have no chance to progress further or may even be scaled down.

Does the new Crew Perk System potentially create imbalanced or overpowered crews?

To avoid imbalances, we invested effort into simulating various scenarios, including applying the maximum possible bonus to specific performance characteristics and considering all consumables, perks, equipment, and more. We also conducted practical tests. Nonetheless, we will closely monitor the situation after the release to quickly address any imbalances if they arise.

[hr][/hr]
Once again, we want to express our gratitude for your comments, opinions, and concerns. We believe the new system will benefit all players by adding more variety and depth to the game. The crew is an important mechanic of our game, and we assure you that we will continue improving it.

Roll Out!

How to Suggest Tags for World of Tanks

Steam Community Shop and Community Tokens: How It Works

[expand]
Community Tokens are a special currency that you earn by being an active member of the World of Tanks Steam Community and by participating in various events and activities. 

You can spend your Tokens in the Steam Community Shop in-game to select the rewards you need (rather than a predetermined reward, as it used to be). 

To find the Steam Community Shop, log in to the game, enter the Depot from your Garage and open the “Homefront Supplies” tab. There, you will find the Steam Community Shop with all available rewards and their cost in Community Tokens. 
[/expand]
Make tag suggestions, receive Tokens, and grab useful rewards from the Steam Community Shop—sounds like a good deal to us!

notes.title: Triathlon Missions. Make Your Way!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/285ef7a84b6c9a33e02a0821736ec9bca16cc5a2.png

Commanders!  
 
Get ready to build your own path to the rewards with Triathlon Missions! This event gives you a lot of flexibility: you choose what mission you want to complete and what rewards you want to get. Do it just the way you want!  
 
Triathlon Missions 

March 20, 2023, through April 10, 2023 
 
Step One: Choose Your Challenge 
 
The Triathlon Missions event will go on for three weeks. Each week you will have an opportunity to pick one mission out of four which you want to complete.  
 
To choose your challenge for the week, open your DEPOT and go to the HOMEFRONT SUPPLIES tab. There, you will see an option named “Triathlon missions”: click on it to pick a mission out of four available variants.  
 
If you don’t see this option in your HOMEFRONT SUPPLIES tab but you want to participate in Triathlon missions, activate this Bonus code: TRIATHLONSTEAM. After activation, you will receive access to the selection of your first mission.  
 
Click on the expand button below to learn more information about the Bonus code. 

[expand type=details]
[olist] 
 This code works for Steam players only.  

 Make sure that your Steam account remains associated with your Wargaming account. If you unbind it during the event, you will not be able to choose missions anymore. 

 If you already have access to the first mission selection, you don’t need to activate the code. It will not grant you any additional benefits. 

 The code works only until the end of week one.  
[/olist][/expand]
[quote=]IMPORTANT: If you do not pick your first mission, you will not be able to participate in the event and you will lose the chance to pick your second and third missions. Make sure to choose the mission until March 27, 2023! 
Step Two: Complete the Chosen Challenge Until the End of the Week 
 
Once you choose your mission, you will need to complete it by a certain date in order to get the rewards. Below you can see the exact dates of all three weeks of the event. 
 
Week 1: March 20, 2023, through March 27, 2023 
 
Week 2: March 27, 2023, through April 3, 2023 
 
Week 3: April 3, 2023, through April 10, 2023 
 
If you don’t complete the mission in time, it will expire, and you will not get any rewards. 
 
Step Three: Collect Triathlon Tokens 
 
All missions have Triathlon Tokens as rewards. Easy missions will grant you one Token upon completion, and if you want a slightly more difficult challenge, go for the medium one: it lets you get two Triathlon Tokens if you finish it in time. 
 
Additionally, every week you will get one free Token as a gift from us!  
 
Step Four: Spend Your Triathlon Tokens on Rewards in the Triathlon Shop 
 
So, what do you do with these Tokens once you get them? You can exchange them for various rewards, of course!  
 
As soon as you have at least one Token, you will see the Triathlon Shop in the game. Head to DEPOT, click on HOMEFRONT SUPPLIES tab and find the “Triathlon Shop” option.  
 
You can save up the Tokens to grab the most valuable rewards or spend them right away as soon as you earn them: it is completely up to you! 
 
Triathlon Shop will remain available for players until April 30, 2023. Remember to spend all your hard-earned Tokens by that date, or they will disappear!  
 
Enjoy the Event! 
 
With Triathlon Missions, we tried to create an event which you can calibrate to your liking: pick missions you want to complete, earn Triathlon Tokens by finishing them in time, and choose the rewards you need the most. 
 
Make it your way, Commanders!

notes.title: Arcade Cabinet Is Back With Two Familiar Modes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9f216c80f9cbd432a69d8d690d4420a4f36b25d0.png

Greetings, Commanders!

Arcade Cabinet is back, offering two tried and tested game modes: Element of Surprise and Railgun. Each will be live for one weekend, followed by a third weekend when both will be available at the same time.

Element of Surprise will increase the randomness of every shot, adding more unpredictability and excitement to your gameplay. In Railgun, you'll experience a significant boost in gun precision, spotting capability, and mobility for your vehicle, making battles more thrilling and fast paced.

Players will also have the opportunity to earn up to 1,200 bonds while Arcade Cabinet is live. So, get ready for a wild ride and mark your calendars for the upcoming weekends!

How to Find Arcade Cabinet

Select Arcade Cabinet from the menu to the right of the “Battle!” button in your Garage. When hovering over the mode button, you’ll see a description of the combat modifiers to be applied in battle. Prepare for something completely different!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9ce7c597b3ec1e7fa5f6dc2cc3df1ecd46bcd35a.jpg

Element of Surprise

From March 17 at 10:00 CET through March 19 at 23:59 CET

From March 31 at 10:00 CEST through April 2 at 23:59 CEST

The damage spread in the standard rules of World of Tanks is a modest ±30%, which is certainly enough to stir up some powerful emotions. But what if we crank it up (or down) a bit? In Element of Surprise, the damage spread is ±75%, and there’s a much bigger chance of extremely low or extremely high damage values. Prepare for a ride on a swinging rollercoaster with some insane loops! (We are speaking figuratively here, of course.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5e34f8ba6bcee794236654045746e00ca8f683c2.png

Railgun 

From March 24 at 10:00 CET through March 26 at 23:59 CEST

This mode lives up to its name, and makes you feel like you’ve landed in a sci-fi novel! The vehicles all keep their looks, but their guns become super-precise, with extremely low dispersion and fast aiming. Dispersion from vehicle movement and traverse is halved, so almost all shots get “snappy.” The proximity spotting distance goes up to 445 meters, meaning enemies won't be able to hide from you (or you from them). With a solid chance of hitting any opponent in plain sight, your tactical options become fantastic!

The Rules

Although Element of Surprise and Railgun have different battle modifiers, their key rules are the same:

 Battles are single-tiered and fought in either Tier VIII or Tier X vehicles.
 You’ll receive XP and credits for battles, and you can use all types of regular reserves (both Personal and Clan).
 XP multipliers for the first victory of the day work in the modes, and credits are put into the vault.
 Element of Surprise and Railgun battles do not contribute to daily missions or Personal Missions, but they do count towards the mode progression.
 Element of Surprise and Railgun battles do not give you bonds, except for the event progression rewards—see below.
 You may play in Platoons if you wish (you’ll be eligible for the bonuses if you do).
The Rewards

While each of the modes is active, you can complete a short chain of battle missions and earn some bonds (up to 1,200 in total).

*You have to complete the previous mission to unlock this one.

Prepare for two more ways to play, Commanders!

notes.title: Shamrock Days Are Coming!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8a2bd348555462c74ca65bcdf532fe259d65ffdf.jpg

Shamrock Days are now available for players and everyone can enjoy the Emerald Boxes and Hidden Treasures. We apologize for the delay, and we will keep monitoring the event closely to make sure everything goes as smoothly as possible from now.

Commanders,

During Shamrock Days (from March 16 through March 22), World of Tanks will celebrate St. Patrick’s Day in a threefold way: with the Hidden Treasures web event, special battle missions, and the Green Light in-game event. During the latter, Emerald Boxes will be available from the in-game Store, giving you a chance to obtain rare vehicles. Every 50th opening guarantees you one.

[previewyoutube=_vEoK1d0etQ;full][/previewyoutube]

From March 16 to March 20, the ×5 bonus to XP for the first win of the day will be active, and lots of discounts will be offered on researchable and Premium vehicles, equipment, consumables, customization elements, and conversion to Free XP.

Happy Hours will be in effect every day from March 16 to March 20, from 18:00 to 22:00 CET (UTC+1), granting an additional bonus (+200% to Crew XP on the first and the third day or +50% to XP on the second and the fourth day).

Hidden Treasures

[expand type=details]
Hidden Treasures will run from March 16 through March 22. To participate, just log in to the event page with your World of Tanks credentials and play a treasure hunt game. Every day, flip five tiles on a 25-tile field to receive a special bonus code. You'll receive different prizes depending on the tiles you flip. However, you are guaranteed a day of WoT Premium Account on the first day of the event, a Training Guide on the second, and a new 2D style on the third.

How to activate the bonus code: 
[olist] 
 Launch the game from Steam and open the Wargaming.net Game Center. 
 Click your account’s avatar in the upper-left corner. 
 Choose the “Activate Wargaming Code” option. 
 Enter the bonus code in the required field. 
 Log in to the game and enjoy! 
[/olist] [quote=]NOTE: To activate the bonus code, you must have an email address attached to your account. To do this, complete the following steps: 

In the game 
[olist]  
 Click your username in the upper-left corner. 
 Click the “Add Email” button under your username. 
 Add and confirm your email address. 
[/olist] In the Wargaming.net Game Center 
[olist] 
 Click your username in the upper-left corner. 
 Click the “Complete Account” button under your username. 
 Add and confirm your email address. 
[/olist][/expand]
Battle Missions

 The repeatable Good Luck missions, available during Happy Hours (every day from March 16 to March 20, from 18:00 to 22:00 CET (UTC+1) every day of the event), will reward you with extra XP or Crew XP.
 The Four-Leaf Clover missions can be completed up to 7 times per day and will be available all day long from March 16 through March 22. The WoT-branded stamps you earn from these missions can be exchanged for styles, decals, emblems, Personal Reserves, consumables, and more in the Homefront Supplies section of the Depot.
Green Light and Emerald Boxes

During the Green Light event (from March 16 at 05:30 CET through March 22 at 05:30 CET (UTC+1)), you can purchase Emerald Boxes from the in-game Store, with a daily limit of 500 boxes. These boxes come in bundles with 5, 15, 50, or 75 boxes and an equal number of battle missions for ×5 XP.

 One of 9 rare Premium vehicles (Probability: 2%)
 One of 10 rare 2D styles (Probability: 10%)
 A Crew Book or a male crew member with Brothers in Arms as a zero perk (Probability: 25%)

notes.title: Introducing: The BZ-58-2 and the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/da137311361170549592593bff3bd2029586926d.jpg

Commanders!

Season X of Battle Pass has an expanded roster of reward vehicles for Tokens, with two Tier IX newcomers: the BZ-58-2 and the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK. Each of these fine rides will make an exciting addition to your Garage, so check out the video and article below to see what makes them so special.

[previewyoutube=jlFKCvLpHOE;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote=]Both the BZ-58-2 and the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK are equipped with a permanent Standard Large Repair Kit (costing you no credits) that provides +15% to module repair speed (compared to +10% for common Large Repair Kits).
BZ-58-2

While this Tier IX tank is a “classic” Chinese heavy, it has a few peculiar traits. The “classic” ones include high single-shot damage (520 HP), a sturdy turret with up to 380 mm of effective armor at the front, and a top forward speed that allows it to keep up with other heavies (35 km/h). Its more unusual features include its –8° of gun depression and accuracy of 0.37 at base, which make terrain-based play a viable option.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a551cb6abe265c046c509a3b4e1d18231579f081.png

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/426e5326dbb65bc84294e7570d14c751180db35b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5727b1fb0ca0a10e1f0c5939f0467e005c0b00d8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6117aff8b8e02ee6a3eeb3b09058d02751c7c2f8.png
[/expand]
Thanks to its good accuracy, the BZ-58-2 can aim at vulnerable spots of enemy armor where the penetration of the basic AP rounds (250 mm) should be enough to do the job. If not, the special APCR rounds with 303 mm of penetration can help. Travelling at 1,250 m/s, these rounds further increase your chances of scoring a damaging hit.

Of course, damage mitigation is the bread and butter of any breakthrough heavy tank, and this is where the BZ-58-2 dominates. The upper glacis plate has only 70 mm of nominal armor, but it’s very sloped and quite bouncy. The sides of the hull have enough armor to make angling possible, but remember to have the lower plate covered to prevent a well-placed enemy shell from sparking a fire. The two cupolas on the turret are also vulnerable, but some wiggling can disrupt enemy aiming, and you can always use a terrain fold to your advantage to ensure that the cupolas aren’t visible to enemies in front of you. When trading damage becomes unavoidable, your 1,900 HP will also come in handy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ab412182d59464606d22ef30ef64292e1649ee3d.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f08500e531abf1ffd7aeb968414e60c4533899b1.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b5f2d0a94faa841fb5fdc4d74f01576b6ab186ab.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/97055fe756e514757b02d8f685c71125afc15f35.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ca93cf6811e79ba7a64eaad7a1f18b90e02925d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/98b047531532d2e54871330512d843060e94efea.jpg
[/expand]
When it comes to your choice of equipment, consumables, and Field Modifications, you may want to increase the top speed of your tank with a Turbocharger and Power Supply Rewiring. And it’s not a bad idea to lower the risk of being set ablaze with Modified Configuration and/or a Fire Extinguisher. A Gun Rammer can also improve your base loading time of 15.1 seconds. Fine-tuning the BZ-58-2 can bring out the best in this simple and effective tank. Of course, if you’re looking for more tactical diversity and finesse, check out the next vehicle.

KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK 

At first glance, this Tier IX German TD with a Siege mode and wedge-shaped hull resembles a high-tier Swedish TD. However, the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK plays very differently: Unlike the Swedes, it can reliably damage opponents in Travel mode, and is quite mobile in Siege mode. This provides you with a broad range of tactical opportunities, and if you learn to use them, you will unlock the full potential of this unique vehicle.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4835465b3975cd8ac07d46c94a8633a82f2e2bf9.png

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/be55685cbd85c9b9c1ecdc928ccbc371a2e35000.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/64f82136292638486aa1bc34b0fa3b41ac9f28f0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f5e5f02ab28b0aff899971ccfbe71fc042a5f7f2.png
[/expand]
In Siege mode, the base accuracy of the KPz 3 is 0.25, and the base aiming time is 1.5 seconds. That spells a sniper, especially considering that the basic APCR round of its 105 mm gun travels at 1,480 m/s, and the camo values of the vehicle are excellent. Plus, this ambusher can change its position with ease. In Siege mode, its forward and reverse top speeds are 20 km/h and 18 km/h, respectively, and those are just base values.

In Travel mode, the gun of the KPz 3 is less accurate (0.35), but it can fire faster, reloading in 6.8 seconds compared to 9.5 seconds in Siege mode. The top speeds increase to 65 km/h and 25 km/h when moving forward and in reverse, respectively.

This TD is like a toolbox filled with handy instruments for every task you might face. There are special HEAT rounds with a penetration of 320 mm for breaking thick armor plates. And for softer sides, apply HE shells that inflict 460 HP of damage and can pierce 120 mm, which is outstanding for this shell type. Although just 45 mm thick, the frontal armor is extremely sloped to make enemy shots bounce. But don’t forget the “three calibers” rule: The ricochet trick won’t work against guns with a caliber of 150 mm and up. Finally, in Siege mode, the maximum gun depression is –12°, which allows you to shoot from positions that almost no one else can use.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f32430f6f90a4c7c7cac3998ec8a15e485bf35bc.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/59e7ab1b3e0e4fd684ae18776543bd14b31ff843.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7d07bc5e5bc6aac7eed846deaf8ae9d2c2e917f6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fed3e10c304bbff560a107f7d4409430fa20cfc1.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/364263d9df042d054d663c15a0002d57687de0fc.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9143826165ab35e87e366b364bf82ea6e74759b9.jpg
[/expand]
You have complete say on how to utilize this multi-functional vehicle with two efficient combat modes. Conventional wisdom suggests going into Siege mode while at a distance and using your mobility in Travel mode at the end of battle to finish off opponents at close range (possibly using Auto-Aim). However, with some adjustments to your equipment and Field Modification setup, you can switch and use the high DPM in Travel mode at mid range, and the extreme gun depression of Siege mode for terrain-based play. The KPz 3 is all about interesting choices that can be made both in the Garage and on the battlefield.

Plan Your Acquisitions!

While the BZ-58-2 will cost you 24 Tokens, you’ll need 27 Tokens to acquire the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK. But that’s no reason to worry: You can earn 21 Tokens as Base and Improved Rewards in the Season X progression, and earn 3 more Tokens by gathering the Collection. So, you can definitely make the BZ-58-2 your goal for the Season. Or, since Tokens accumulate over the course of the year, you can save up all your Tokens and grab the KPz 3 right after the next Season starts.

Set your sights on the new Tier IX reward vehicles, Commanders!

notes.title: Steam Community Shop: Choose Your Rewards!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ec5a321af64deccfc841f537a75b8359777d3104.png

Commanders!  
 
Our Steam Community unites tens of thousands of passionate tankers from all over the world. We are proud to see it grow and evolve every day, with new people joining, new discussion threads created, new artwork shared, and new guides published. We always try our best to keep this amazing Community entertained, even outside the game, through various Steam events and activities, and we never stop thinking of how we can make them even better and more rewarding.
 
We are excited to share our first big step in reimagining our Community activities on Steam: the introduction of Community Tokens and the Steam Community Shop! 
 
Steam Community Shop: First Stage 
March 6, 2023 through April 30, 2023 
 
What are Community Events? 
 
First of all, let’s clarify which events and activities we’re talking about. World of Tanks Steam regularly launches various giveaways and perk events that require you to perform certain actions on the World of Tanks Steam Hub in order to receive a reward (e.g., “Like” and leave a comment).  
 
You can see examples of past Community events below (keep in mind that these events have already ended and you can no longer participate in them):  
 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3673284490063097927
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3635002625424278970
Usually, you can expect at least one subscription event, one tag suggestion event, and one giveaway event per month. Some months, there may be even more, and in the future, we plan to add additional event types.  
 
Now that you understand what kind of events we are redesigning, it’s time to look at the actual changes.  
 
What are the Steam Community Shop and Community Tokens? 
 
The Steam Community Shop is a new addition to the game. Here, you can choose your own rewards and purchase them for Community Tokens.  
 
Previously, all Community events had a pre-determined reward that all participants received at the end of the event. It was a good and simple system, but it lacked flexibility. For example, our monthly reward for following us on Steam was a bunch of Personal Reserves. Of course, if a player already has plenty of Personal Reserves on their account, they’d rather get something else instead. The introduction of Community Tokens and the Steam Community Shop lets you do exactly that! 
 
From March 6, 2023, all regular Community activities will have universal rewards: a certain amount of Community Tokens. You can spend these Tokens in the Community Shop to get the reward that you need most. You can save up your Tokens throughout the month to purchase better rewards, or you can spend them as soon as you get them: the choice is yours! 
 
The Steam Community Shop will work in stages. Each stage will last approximately 2 months, and then we will refresh the available rewards. Please note that we will carefully monitor your feedback and adjust the Steam Community Shop mechanics if needed (e.g., the length of stages might change in the future, etc.).   
 
[quote=]NOTE: Earned Community Tokens DO NOT transfer between stages. When a stage ends, all unused Tokens will disappear, so make sure to spend all your Tokens in time! 
You can expect various useful rewards in the Steam Community Shop, including consumables, Personal Reserves, credits, WoT Premium Account, Garage slots, and customization elements. Some rewards can be claimed an unlimited number of times, while others are limited to 1-2 times per account. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0f20d1affe5108b7da504bcaee52d514bffe7058.jpg
 
How to Find the Steam Community Shop 
[olist]
 To find the Steam Community Shop, launch the game and open the DEPOT section.  

 Then, find the HOMEFRONT SUPPLIES tab inside your Depot. 

 Find the “Steam Community Shop” option in the HOMEFRONT SUPPLIES tab and click on it to view all of the available rewards and prices.  
[/olist]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9dce7ae6155527cf0f94ee3d63a0cba2afdf864a.png

Earn Your First Community Tokens Right Now! 
 
To celebrate the redesign of Community events and the introduction of the Community Shop to the game, we are launching a special giveaway: “Like” this post and write a comment to get 1 Community Token!  
 
In order to participate and receive a guaranteed prize, you need to complete a couple of easy steps: 
[olist] 
 Press the “Rate Up” button under this article 
 Write in the comments which Community events you would like to see in the future (e.g., screenshot competitions, art contests, etc.)  
[/olist] That’s it! If you complete these steps, you will receive your Token within a few days after the giveaway ends on March 13, 2023. 
 
Participate in our events and activities, earn Tokens, choose your prizes, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Oyster Bay Enters Random Battles!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0c2dd99e7a48debbfbc45e28c915b35be686d698.jpg

Commanders!

Oyster Bay was the second most popular location of Recon Mission 2021, and now, it’s hitting Random Battles several months after the first-place map, Outpost. Oyster Bay offers a drastically different setting: a tropical island with a lush jungle and scenic beaches. Sadly, this once tranquil paradise has strategic value, and two mighty countries are fighting for control of it.

[previewyoutube=6POCg9c1_7I;full][/previewyoutube]
Enjoy the Views (And History)

For decades, the island was held by one of the adversaries, who had constructed an airbase on the land. However, several years ago, the other side drove their troops out and entrenched, building multiple coastal bunkers. Now, the first power is back for revenge. The locals to whom the island rightfully belongs haven’t benefited from the presence of either occupying force: the landscape is littered with various military structures, and it is not easy to find a place to grow food or set up an oyster farm. Adding to their woes, a massive volcano is about to erupt, sending billowing smoke into the beautiful blue sky.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7785cc61dd6bae76f5256bde3107e7bd4e9c1d6c.jpg

Play in Various Ways

Oyster Bay is the first map set on a tropical island, and the battlefield is completely surrounded by water. However, that’s not the only feature that makes this map special. It is also very large: At 1,300x1,300 meters, it is 69% more spacious than a standard 1 km² map. In fact, the extra size was one of the most requested features by players. There are also additional bypass routes behind the bases and in the middle of the map, prompting you to be mobile and tactically aware. Here, smart maneuvering pays off even more than usual.

Vehicle Rebalancing: A New Iteration

We're updating the characteristics of 27 vehicles from different nations, tiers, and types, including seven Tier X tanks—the Centurion Action X, the Т57 Heavy, the Rinoceronte, among others. notes.title: Rebalancing Changes in Update 1.20
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c3ded804cbe5c1ac8a201cf138ad91fdfcc5985e.jpg

Commanders!

In Update 1.18, we adjusted the technical characteristics of many vehicles. In the several months since these changes were applied to the live server, we've been closely monitoring the outcomes and are now ready to take the next step.

In Update 1.20, we’ll change the combat parameters of 27 vehicles in the British, German, French, and other branches. These various balance tweaks should adjust the performance of these tanks while preserving their key gameplay features. Some of these targeted changes will affect the surrounding vehicles in their branches, so we’ll also correct their combat parameters for consistency. Let’s take a look at each group of vehicles individually.

Tier IX–X Vehicles: Subtle but Effective Improvements

The characteristics of the following top-tier vehicles will change, allowing them to fight more effectively:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7d9e0efd9440e4fb0bd799989588a7f73391ff18.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/dc50deba09bbbd8acf910b115251f5d68e10454e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c812c250a5046c0cf6fa27ce3222ff9a7279a972.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c04b433488fa57d5a6bafc85c424ed3768710498.png

British Vehicles

Based on your feedback and our statistics, the Centurion Action X is not very competitive on the battlefield and needs a slight enhancement to its combat performance. As a result, we’ll improve its reload time (8 s instead of 8.6 s) and dispersion during movement on hull and turret traverse. The forward speed will also be slightly increased, from 53 to 55 km/h.

[quote=]To keep these changes consistent, the two surrounding tanks in the branch, the Centurion Mk. I and the Centurion Mk. 7/1 will have reduced dispersion during movement and on hull traverse.
German Vehicles

The Rheinmetall Panzerwagen also doesn’t perform as well as its same-tier opponents and is, therefore, not very popular. An improved gun could make it more effective in combat. Accordingly, the Panzerwagen’s reload and aiming times will be reduced from 9 to 8 s and from 1.6 to 1.4 s, respectively. We’ll also improve the dispersion at 100 m from 0.36 to 0.33 m, as well as the dispersion during movement and on hull and turret traverse (from 0.14 to 0.10).

[quote=]The HWK 12, sitting at Tier VIII, will also receive similar improvements to dispersion during movement and on hull traverse to be more competitive.
American Branch

Although the T57 Heavy Tank  is pretty tough and can confidently take on Random Battles and Onslaught, a slight mobility buff and increased shooting comfort might do it some good. The vehicle’s reverse speed will be increased from 12 to 14 km/h, and the aiming time will be improved from 2.9 to 2.7 s. We’ll also slightly reduce its dispersion during movement and on hull traverse.

Italian Branch

Your feedback has confirmed that the Rinoceronte’s role on the battlefield could be a bit more pronounced. Thus, we’ll strengthen its turret armor and increase the velocity of special HEAT shells. The reverse speed will also increase from 12 to 15 km/h.

Mid-Tier Vehicles: Tougher and More Dangerous

After reviewing the statistics, we realized that the following Tier VI–VII vehicles require some firepower, mobility, and survivability buffs to improve their efficiency. We assessed each of these vehicles individually, and we are sure that these changes will make them more attractive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/57d47478aa4f702713d2ee732d7ce58773441449.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b55421574c36e2473c5854b34880ba6cc1825ac0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c7304a7cb477901222f377a67bc9b74123a229ec.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a2bc5abb0a36148560b74960d010e077c66c4936.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5259ad016a81aac401848c8c8323cde8741cda04.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b012c68bb434d663742152870370df28b42c66d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/dc6ed64954ff3a879f528ce91d558e001f4d1481.png

ARL V39

The forward speed will increase from 42 to 45 km/h, and the reload time of its 90 mm AC DCA 45 gun will be improved from 9 to 7.5 s.

Tiger (P)

The frontal armor of the top turret will be strengthened. We’ll also improve the stabilization, reload time, and dispersion on turret traverse for the 8,8 cm Kw.K. 43 L/71 gun. The HP pool will also increase.

Ikv 90 Typ B

We’ll improve the dispersion at 100 m of the 9 cm kan m/F gun from 0.36 to 0.32 m. The aiming time will reduce from 2.3 to 2 s.

Spähpanzer SP I C

The reload time and dispersion on turret traverse of the 90 mm D921 F1 and 90 mm Mecar guns will decrease.

Т-43

The dispersion of the 85 mm D5T-85BM gun on turret traverse will be improved. We’ll also improve its dispersion during movement.

Comet

We’ll reduce the dispersion during movement and on hull traverse.

A-44

The aiming time of the 107 mm ZIS-6 gun will decrease from 3.4 to 2.9 s. Dispersion at 100 m and on turret traverse will be reduced from 0.45 to 0.43 and from 0.16 to 0.12, respectively.

Overperforming High-Tier Vehicles: Carefully Measured Changes

French Branch

In Update 1.18, we rebalanced some of the characteristics of the AMX M4 mle. 54 to enhance it as a frontline brawler. However, having studied the statistics after such a serious improvement to its combat effectiveness, we decided to slightly adjust its performance in Update 1.18.1.

We’ve been monitoring the performance of this menacing heavy in Random Battles for several months, and can clearly see that these adjustments were insufficient. We decided to go even further and slightly change the following parameters of the 130 mm/45 Model 1935 gun:

 Aiming time: from 2.2 to 2.5 s
 Reload time: from 13.4 to 14 s
 Gun dispersion at 100 m: from 0.33 to 0.36
The dispersion during movement and on hull and turret traverse will also be changed. These carefully measured changes will help us correct its effectiveness and bring the vehicle’s parameters in line with other heavy tanks.

The AMX M4 mle. 51 and the AMX 65 t will also receive successive adjustments of their guns.

Italian Vehicles

We understand why the community was so emotional about the performance nerf of the Progetto M40 mod. 65. This vehicle is very popular, and players like it, so you ask why to reduce its effectiveness, since its percentage of wins is about 49%, which is not high value. But in this case, we pay attention to 2 other very important parameters:

 The Progetto M40 Mod. 65 is the most popular Tier X Medium tank in the game over the past six months. And its popularity continues to grow
 This vehicle is in the top-3 in terms of average damage dealt per battle among all Tier X Medium tanks.
Seeing these trends, we want to slightly decrease the vehicle's effectiveness and the growth rate of its popularity. So, we decided to reduce the vehicle's reverse speed from 23 to 20 km/h, as well as increase gun dispersion during movement and hull traverse. We’ll also make its upper glacis plate less durable, so that this Italian predator becomes more vulnerable in combat at any distance. In this regard, the Prototipo Standard B will also receive successive adjustments to its gun.

American Vehicles

The T110E3 is a mighty vehicle that stands out from other Tier X tank destroyers in the game. In a sense, it became an unrivaled adversary on the battlefield. And the main reason for reducing the characteristics of this vehicle is its first position in the top in terms of average damage dealt per battle among all Tier X tank destroyers. It is also in the top-2 for average blocked damage per battle among all Tier X tank destroyers. Even considering that this vehicle is not very popular, even at the current popularity values, it begins to affect Random Battles. That is why we would like to reduce its effectiveness in the following parameters:

 HP pool: from 2,050 to 1,950 HP
 View range: from 390 to 370 s
 Reload time: from 17 to 18 s
 Aiming time: from 2.5 to 2.7 s
[quote=]To maintain the consistency of characteristics in this branch, we’ll also decrease the T95’s view range (360 m instead of 380 m). The reload and aiming times will be increased from 18.3 to 19 s and from 2.5 to 2.7 s, respectively.
Feel free to share your thoughts on these rebalanced vehicles, Commanders!

notes.title: Battle Pass Season X: Event Guide
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0e978206103786daf1806c946f03e4c48aa0e995.jpg

Battle Pass is back for Season X, Commanders!

Starting from March 1 and running until May 31, Season X will feature familiar rules and offer many valuable prizes—all while adding some new treats to your plate! In addition to new progressive styles, an expanded roster of Token rewards (plus two brand-new vehicles), and a new piece of equipment (Bounty Hardening), there will be some things you’ve never seen before. You will be able to uncover the Season's story and earn up to three more Tokens by completing the new Collection feature.

Battle Pass Season X
EU: March 1, 2023 at 07:30 CET (UTC+1) through May 31, 2023
NA: February 28, 2023 at 05:00 PT | 07:00 CT | 08:00 ET through May 30, 2023
ASIA: 28 February 2023 at 07:00 (UTC+8) through 30 May 2023

[previewyoutube=oO3gkQOjEpU;full][/previewyoutube]
New Rewards and Features of Season X

 The Core Vehicles of Season X are the Rinoceronte, the Maus , and the UDES 15/16. The progressive styles you can obtain for them are all desert-themed.
 A desert-covered region is where a brand-new trio of hero tankers is heading—to engage in an armored treasure hunt with many obstacles to overcome.
 The story of the heroes’ exploits unfolds in the descriptions of some of the Season X Stage and Chapter rewards. The styles, decals, medal, and crew members themselves form a Collection (a feature to be introduced later on in the Season). Depending on the number of Collection Elements (“plot items”) gathered, you can earn up to three additional Tokens during Season X.
 A new piece of equipment—Bounty Hardening—will be among the progression and Token rewards.
 The Tier IX reward roster has expanded with two brand-new vehicles: the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK and the BZ-58-2.
 On top of the usual selection, styles and crew members from Seasons VII and IX will now be offered in the Reward section of the in-game Store.
Progressive Styles for New Core Vehicles

Here are the three desert-themed progressive styles of Season X:

 Nyx for the Rinoceronte  
 Wüstenschiff for the Maus  
 Svadilfari for the UDES 15/16  
Take a look at them below!

Bounty Hardening and Other Rewards

The list of Season X Base and Improved Rewards is long and includes days of WoT Premium Account, bonds, credits, Garage slots, Personal Reserves, equipment, and more. One reward is of special note: Bounty Hardening. It can significantly increase the survivability of your vehicle. 

2D Styles, Decals, and a Unique Medal

Rewards for Points

Once you complete all three Chapters, you’ll get access to the Reward section of the in-game Store. You can spend all your Battle Pass Points earned throughout the Season there on bonds and the following goodies:

 Progressive styles for all Battle Pass Core Vehicles from the previous Seasons (except Season VIII)
 Unique crew members from the previous Seasons (except Season VIII)
The Reward section of the in-game Store will be available until May 31, 2023 at 02:30 CEST (UTC+2) on EU servers, until May 30, 2023 at 00:30 PT | 02:30 CT | 03:30 ET on NA servers and until 30 May 2023 at 14:00 (UTC+8) on ASIA servers. You will continue to earn and accumulate Battle Pass Points even after completing the entire Season X Progression.

[quote=]Remember to spend your Points before the end of the Season to redeem your rewards. Otherwise, all unused Battle Pass Points will disappear!
Rewards for Battle Pass Tokens

You can obtain up to 21 Battle Pass Tokens from the Season X Progression (12 from the Base Rewards and 9 from the Improved Rewards), plus up to 3 additional Tokens for gathering Collection Elements. (Collections will be a staple of every Season in 2023.)

You can spend Tokens in the Items for Tokens section of the in-game Store or save them up and spend them later in upcoming Battle Pass Seasons of 2023. Tokens accumulate throughout the year.

The list of rare Tier IX vehicles available for Tokens has grown once again—there are now nine vehicles. The new stars are the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK and the BZ-58-2. Both are equipped with Standard Large Repair Kits (the “limitless” ones).

The KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK is a German sniper TD. It has a Siege mode that is activated manually like on Swedish high-tier TDs, increasing the effective gun depression angle to −12 degrees. Its basic APCR rounds fly very quickly, special HEAT rounds have high penetration for Tier IX, and HE rounds have outstandingly high penetration for this shell type. The vehicle has a low silhouette, and its mobility while in Siege mode easily allows you to roll back after a successful shot without switching to Travel mode.

However, the gun is rather precise for a heavy and has a −8 degree depression angle, which—together with a bouncy upper glacis plate—makes terrain-based play a viable option.

Please note that the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK costs 27 Tokens. Considering that gathering the Collection gets you three Tokens on top of the 21 that come as progression rewards, you can get very close to this vehicle in Season X. By keeping your Tokens, you will be able to snatch the TD soon after the next Season begins. See the thresholds below, plan your progress and get the extra Tokens before Season X ends!

notes.content:

Commanders!

Anyone can participate in World of Tanks tournaments and challenges, whether you're a seasoned veteran or a new player. Enjoy exciting and strategic gameplay with your friends, win battles, and earn in-game rewards—including gold!

Play solo or team up with other players, face off against worthy opponents, and win brilliant victories, Commanders!

Commanders!

Wargaming Publisher Weekend is in full swing, bringing not only a new free DLC, time-limited offers, and cross-product bundles with great discounts, but also a completely new and unique piece of customization: a 2D style designed specifically for World of Tanks Steam players! 
In this article, we will cover all possible ways to obtain this 2D style. 

Steam Powered 2D Style: Made to Stand Out 

This style truly catches the eye! With the Steam Powered 2D style, you can show your fellow teammates that you are a part of the amazing Steam Community and also immediately recognize other Steam tankers if they have the same style. Currently, this style is available to Steam players only, which makes it the first-ever Steam-exclusive piece of customization! 

The Steam Powered style was inspired by Wargaming’s brand colors. Apply it to your favorite vehicle to transform its appearance into a captivating display of red, gray, and white streams on a black background, as if the tank has been enveloped by a mesmerizing dance of colorful smoke—or steam!

notes.title: Wargaming Publisher Weekend Has Started!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f8ca253baae78d02e8016e598b69ffdfef163ffd.png

Commanders!

We are proud to announce that Wargaming has the honor of hosting a Publisher Weekend on Steam to showcase our games to millions of people who share our passion for action-packed combat. Whether you are already familiar with our games or are just starting to discover the Wargaming universe, the following several days have a lot to offer! 

From February 16, 2023, through February 22, 2023, you can grab yourselves a free DLC, complete in-game missions with useful rewards, get your hands on new Steam-exclusive content for World of Tanks, and stock up on special cross-product bundles available at crazy discounts of up to 95%!

Wargaming Publisher Weekend on Steam
February 16, 2023, through February 22, 2023

TO THE EVENT PAGE 

Keep reading to learn about all the surprises that await you during Wargaming Publisher Weekend!

Cross-Product Bundles at Bargain Prices

During Wargaming Publisher Weekend, a total of four cross-product bundles will be available for purchase at huge discounts on Steam. A cross-product bundle includes content for several Wargaming games at once, and it’s a great way to start your exploration of our projects or expand your existing collection if you are an experienced Wargamer already. 

Out of the four mentioned bundles, the following three have World of Tanks content in them:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30278/Wargaming_Publisher_Sale_Bundle/

Get a bunch of items for four Wargaming titles at once at a whopping 95% discount! Purchasing this bundle will let you park the mighty Tier V British Excelsior heavy tank in your World of Tanks Garage. You will also receive an additional three days of WoT Premium Account, a set of equipment, and a 2D style to make your Excelsior battle ready immediately! Apart from that, you will get a bunch of content for World of Warships, World of Tanks Blitz, and World of Warplanes. Click the link above to learn all the details!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30279/Steel_Companions_Bundle/

If heated battles on land are not enough, it’s time to explore the seas, as well! This bundle has both World of Tanks and World of Warships content—perfect for getting to know another popular Wargaming project or expanding your collection if you are a captain already! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30280/Brothers_in_Arms_Bundle/

How can one describe World of Tanks Blitz? Vivid, spectacular... crazy? Well, you can find your own words as this bundle includes both World of Tanks and World of Tanks Blitz content. A great way to try out a new game—or a great bargain if you already play both! 

Keep in mind that all the aforementioned bundles are time-limited offers—they will no longer be available for purchase after February 23 at 17:00 UTC. Jump on this chance!

Steam Powered: A Steam-Exclusive 2D Style

Get ready to steamroller your opponents with style! The Steam Powered style has been designed and developed specifically for World of Tanks Steam players to stand out on the battlefield. Currently, you can obtain this style only if you play World of Tanks on Steam, which makes it an exclusive piece of customization and great a way to show your fellow tankers that you are a part of the amazing Steam Community. 

The Steam Powered style was inspired by Wargaming’s brand colors. It transforms your vehicle into a captivating display of red, gray, and white streams on a black background as if it's been enveloped by a mesmerizing dance of colorful smoke—or steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1b85e25d23caf82039b89772118f382ba4121e18.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b757bdba5856f9340fd39659924c3e032bc70f05.jpg
[/expand]
You can get your hands on this beautiful and unique piece of customization in the following ways:

1. By purchasing the Steam-Roller Pack DLC at a 40% discount. Along with the 2D style, you will receive three days of WoT Premium Account to up your game. Click the link below for more information!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274930/World_of_Tanks__SteamRoller_Pack/
2. By purchasing the event bundles in the in-game Store (more on that below)

3. By completing a special mission in the game until February 20, 2023 (read on to learn more about missions and rewards)

Remember that you can obtain this style only until the end of the event, so don’t miss out on the opportunity to get this Steam-exclusive customization!

New Free DLC up for Grabs!

Wargaming Publisher Weekend introduces a new free DLC with a bunch of useful resources available for everyone! 

The DLC contains three days of WoT Premium Account to speed up your progress in the game, a set of improved consumables that will come in handy during heated battles, and 150,000 credits for your needs.

Click the widget below to add it to your account right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274900/World_of_Tanks__Free_Supplies_Pack/
Publisher Weekend Giveaway

There can never be too many freebies! To celebrate the start of Wargaming Publisher Weekend, we are launching a special Community Giveaway with a guaranteed reward. To participate in the Giveaway, you need to like this article and leave a comment—and that’s it! Everyone who completes these simple steps will get a cool Steam-themed decal to decorate their favorite vehicle. 

Check out the article below for more details.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3673285123504243782
In-Game Missions With Useful Rewards

From February 16, 2023, through February 20, 2023, you can complete a number of special missions and receive a bunch of rewards, including the unique Steam Powered 2D style that we mentioned before! 

To get the 2D style, you just need to earn 14,000 points of Base XP in total over any number of Random or Grand Battles while playing in Tier IV or higher vehicles. Every WoT Steam player can complete the mission once and receive one Steam Powered style completely for free!   

Apart from the spectacular style, for finishing other missions, you can get three days of Wargaming Premium Account, a post-battle ×2 boost to your Combat XP, and a Personal Reserve for +200% to Crew and Free XP for 1 hour. 

[quote=]NOTE: Wargaming Premium Account is not the same as WoT Premium Account. Wargaming Premium Account works in three games at once (World of Tanks, World of Warships, and World of Warplanes), but it gives the following bonuses only:

 50% more XP per battle
 50% more Crew XP per battle 
 50% more credits per battle
Wargaming Premium Account is a great way to check out our other games while having a nice bonus to your post-battle XP and credit earnings.

Keep in mind that two Premium Accounts can be active at the same time, but you will only get the bonuses from the one that is more profitable. 

Click the expand button below for a more detailed explanation.

[expand]
For example, if you have one day of WoT Premium Account and three days of Wargaming Premium Account and you play World of Tanks, then for one day, you will get all the benefits of WoT Premium Account (i.e., increased Crew and Combat XP, increased credits earnings, a Platoon bonus, one more slot for excluded maps, etc.). 

When WoT Premium Account runs out, you will still have two more days of Wargaming Premium Account, and you will continue to get bonuses like increased Crew and Combat XP and increased credits per battle (but no more WoT-special bonuses, such as the Reserve Stock or an extra slot for excluded maps). 
[/expand]
To find the missions in the game, go to the MISSIONS” tab in your Garage and scroll down to the Publisher Weekend section.  

Bundles in the In-Game Store

During Wargaming Publisher Weekend, the in-game Store will have a selection of event-themed offers available to all Steam players. Two of these offers will include the new Steam Powered style (among other items), while the third offer contains some ×5 XP missions and a bunch of Personal Reserves to boost your progress.

You can find these offers in the Featured section of the in-game Store.

Have Fun and Enjoy the Event!

Wargaming Publisher Weekend is the perfect opportunity to become more familiar with our universe. Enjoy the free DLC, get the new exclusive style, treat yourselves to some great deals, and make sure to check out other Wargaming projects—they have prepared lots of surprises for you, as well!

We are honored to be a part of your gaming journey, Commanders. 

Full Steam ahead!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3dbcc2617e4ab16ac1703618b688fae125f288c1.jpg

Commanders,

The auction is returning with five exceptional lots. Each lot will be available for one day only, running from February 15 through February 19, and is not to be missed: In every lot, you’ll find a powerful high-tier vehicle with a unique playstyle and a significant collector value. Expect both brand-new tanks as well as classics, with some based on myths and legends from around the world!

The Auction
February 15 through February 19

EU: Bids accepted from 10:00 CET through 23:00 CET (UTC+1)
NA: Bids accepted from 05:00 PST through 18:00 PST (UTC−8)
ASIA: Bids accepted from 10:00 through 23:00 (UTC+8)

Every lot will be put on an open auction, meaning that, at any moment while it‘s active, you will see the number of bids made and (once the number of bids exceeds the number of items available) the competitive bid. Each lot will have a single designated in-game currency—gold, credits, or Free XP—in which your bids will be accepted.

Watch the video below for more details and some more hints about the lots!

[previewyoutube=g7HfSpYgGSI;full][/previewyoutube]
Accessing the Auction

You can enter the auction via the special page in the in-game Store. Make sure to visit it (at least) daily while the auction is active!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/49f430bfade2eb8fd2fa8557ce662858c6aabeb6.jpg

Auction Mechanics

1. Once you’re on the auction screen, you can bid what you’re willing to pay for the lot. This amount will automatically be deducted from your account.

[quote=]If the cost of a lot is specified in gold, the use of credits or Free XP will not be possible, and vice versa.
2. If you decide to change or cancel your bid, you are free to do so while the lot is active. After that, bids cannot be modified or canceled, and no new bids will be accepted. If you cancel a bid, the spent amount of gold, credits, or Free XP will be returned to your account. Bids will be returned, and lots will be credited to the auction winners within four hours after the deadline for accepting bids.

3. The number of winning players will depend on the number of items available. If multiple players make the lowest winning bid and there are more of these players than items to be distributed, the players who made the bids earliest will be awarded the item.

[quote=]Example: If 700 auction participants made identical lowest winning bids, and if there are only 500 items to be distributed, the 500 earliest bids will win.
4. This time, every lot will be sold at an open auction. This means that in addition to the lot’s contents, the number of available items, the minimum bid, and the deadline for accepting new bids, you will see the number of bids that have already been made and the competitive (median) bid (after the number of bids has exceeded the number of available items).

5. The winners will receive their goods. The remaining auction participants receive their bids back in full.

6. Items won in the auction are non-refundable.

Keep your eyes (and your in-game coffers) open for a chance to obtain very rare and valuable vehicles, Commanders!

Commanders!

World of Tanks is relaunching a special collaboration!

Created by Hasbro, G.I. Joe is one of the most popular action figure lines in the world. Generations of kids in the U.S. and beyond played with them and were captivated by the struggle of the international elite spec ops team against their sworn enemies of Cobra, a multi-faceted and masterfully coordinated global criminal network. Uncounted millions of battles that have been fought with plastic action figures (often commanded by present-day online tankers) have elevated G.I. Joe to the status of a cultural phenomenon.

The famous adversaries from G.I. Joe and Cobra have come to World of Tanks to settle their scores in their impressive vehicles: the B.T.T. (having the same stats as the TS-5), the B.O.A. (having the same stats as the T-54 first prototype), the C.A.T. (having the same stats as the M54 Renegade), and the Wolverine (having the same stats as the Strv S1).

[quote=]The exteriors of the B.T.T., B.O.A., C.A.T., and Wolverine are non-historical; their display can be toggled on or off at any time in your game settings under the General tab.

 The Wolverine 3D style is inspired by the same-name Armored Missile Vehicle that was released in 1983. "Based on the U.S. Army's top-secret weapons system," the toy model came with a Cover Girl figurine and featured twin rocket launchers loaded with a total of 12 stinger missiles.
 The M54 Renegade is reborn as a weapon of Cobra! The C.A.T. (Motorized Crimson Attack Tank) style is inspired by the limited-edition toy model that was released in 1985. notes.title: Account Transfer for CIS Realm Players: Next Stage
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/882371f2902aebc4a6f28fc137891e559046d090.png

Dear players! 
 
In September, CIS servers were turned off for World of Tanks Steam. All CIS realm players got an opportunity to transfer their accounts to the EU server and continue playing World of Tanks via Steam.  
 
Since that time, the majority of our active playerbase have used the account transfer opportunity to stay with Wargaming and play on the EU server. However, there remains a number of so-called “inactive accounts”: players who decided to take a break from the game for a while and thus haven’t made a decision about the transfer.  
 
Our next stage of the transfer process targets specifically these inactive accounts, and in this article, we will cover everything in detail.  
 
[quote=]NOTE: If you’ve already transferred your account from the CIS realm, nothing will change for you. You can share this article with your friends who haven’t transferred their accounts yet so that they can stay up to date. 
[quote=]NOTE: Starting from March 6 it will no longer be possible to manually choose the region for transfer. 

Our Player Support Team will not accept tickets with such questions.
Next Stage of the Transfer: What Will Happen? 
 
The automatic transfer for the inactive accounts will begin soon. All inactive accounts previously registered on the CIS realm via Steam will be automatically transferred to the EU server, retaining the progress, vehicles, purchases, gold, statistics etc.  
 
Keep in mind that it will take some time to transfer all accounts that we consider to be "inactive". Our system will process them gradually over the course of several weeks.   
 
During the automatic transfer process, a couple of so-called “collisions” can happen: 
[olist] 
 You already have another World of Tanks account on the EU server, registered with the same Steam ID as your CIS realm account.  

 You already have another World of Tanks account on the EU server, registered with the same email as your CIS realm account.  

 You already have a WoWP/WoWS/WoT Blitz account on the EU server, registered with the same Steam ID as your CIS realm account. 
[/olist]In these cases, you need to resolve the collision to be able to play on your transferred account on the EU server. To do that, please log in on the special portal and perform the required actions (e.g. unbind your Steam ID from your old account, change your email etc.).  
 
[quote=]NOTE: If you are unable to log in to your account on the web portal for any reason, you need to contact our Player Support Team. Keep in mind that our Player Support Team is currently experiencing an increase in the number of submitted tickets which results in longer waiting times. Don’t worry: your ticket will be processed. 
If no collisions have been detected during the automatic transfer process, all you need to do to hop back into battles on the EU server is update your game on Steam and click “Play”. As easy as that!  

Next Stage of the Transfer: Frequently Asked Questions

[tr]
[th]Question[/th]
[th]Answer[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Do I need to do anything if I already transferred my account earlier? [/th]
[td]No, in this case nothing will change for you.  

If you know someone who used to play World of Tanks via Steam but haven’t logged in since September 2022, you can share this article with them to keep them updated. [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]For how long will the transfer procedure be available? [/th]
[td]The transfer process will be stopped after all inactive accounts have been transferred to the EU server. We will inform you about the exact date later. [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]What will happen to my CIS realm account after my data is transferred to the EU server? [/th]
[td]It will be blocked and deleted after the end of the process of automatic transfer. We will inform you about the exact date later. [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Player Support Center doesn’t reply to my ticket about the transfer. What should I do?[/th]
[td]Our Player Support Center is currently processing a large number of tickets, resulting in longer waiting times. Don’t worry, your ticket will be processed, you just need to wait for some time. [/td]
[/tr]

[th]Do I need to accept new documents or regulations after the transfer? [/th]

[/tr]

[td]Your data will be managed by Wargaming Group Limited as before. You will have an opportunity to check our Privacy Policy again if you wish to.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
If you wish to learn more about the general transfer details (e.g. information about the transfer of items/statistics/clans etc. to the EU server), feel free to check out the FAQ in our previous transfer-related article.  
 
If you have any questions that aren’t covered in either of these articles, do not hesitate to ask them in the comments right below this post. We will be happy to help!
