notes.title: Get Large Boxes With Premium Tanks, Exclusive 3D Styles, and Much More!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4cbfc08cb60d361751ed2e49482c8eacde047971.jpg

Commanders!

We hope you’re excited about Holiday Ops 2023! If you're looking to add more fun and magic to our festive event, unwrap our Large Boxes containing cool presents—you may even unwrap new 3D styles or brand-new Premium tanks! Read on for more details.

[previewyoutube=aMMewD9Aw1U;full][/previewyoutube]
Large Boxes 2023
EU: December 1, 2022 at 07:00 CET through January 9, 2023 at 07:00 CET (UTC+1)
NA: December 1 at 03:20 PT | 05:20 CT | 06:20 ET
through January 9 at 03:20 PT | 05:20 CT | 06:20 ET
ASIA: December 1, 2022 at 11:00 through January 9, 2023 at 11:00 (UTC+8)

Large Boxes: What’s Inside?

All Large Boxes will always guarantee 250 gold as a default gift. As a bonus with each Large Box, you will also get 150 random Holiday Ops resources, plus 50 additional resources—which one depends on the Box’s type.

[quote=]There’s no way you can lose out—all the goods you get are worth more than the box!

[quote=]Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald are used to upgrade the Festive Atmosphere Level, while Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron are needed to complete the Guests’ and Redshire Cat’s Assignments. Keep reading for more details.
In addition to the resources and gold, which will never change, a Box will also drop a surprise item from the list below:

 1, 3, or 7 days of WoT Premium Account
 250, 500 or 1,000 gold (on top of the default 250)
 100,000 or 500,000 Credits.
 A Tier VIII or IX Premium tank
 A Tier II–V Premium vehicle
 A brand-new 3D style, exclusive to a set of selected Tier IX and X vehicles
 A 3D style from last year’s Large Boxes
 Redshire Сat, a special festive character who provides you with additional Assignments to earn even more rewards
[quote=]All Premium vehicles come with a free Garage slot.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4ab894976e565bc95737a6b99bc3e608471ba3c2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2708ae6268e920310014abc6df94f969f9ca27d8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a3f987c8e1a53a3185c21d714b797f2a9669454c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/dcf968899c046fe5d92bb30066f4f00cbcb1efdc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e2cc40edca15e96b33297cfa5cc8e7ad6d35a347.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f4932db3a736180019fd44024b3104ba39aa1625.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1be4387fc399854bf6b2170fb80fa1735716dd87.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d2da0cfa690338198ef0eaba1850f91cb3024e02.png

Redshire Сat's Assignments

Along with cool Premium tanks, amazing 3D styles, and other goodies, you may come across a fluffy but self-assured Redshire Cat. This is a unique Holiday Ops character that you can always see at Headquarters alongside our celebrities.

The Cat provides you with three additional Assignments. For each of them, you will receive one reward upon completion. Use Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron to fulfill them and get your hands on the following:

 1 day of WoT Premium Account
 A funny decal
 A special cat-tastic style
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/860273d2a7ec2446c2874a98e1dc178298c226a7.jpg

Guaranteed Vehicle Mechanics

Large Boxes feature guaranteed vehicle mechanics. It’s simple: If you open 49 boxes but still have not received a Premium vehicle, then, with the 50th opening, you’re guaranteed to receive a random Premium Tier VIII or IX tank that you don’t own from the set list below.

There will be a special guaranteed vehicle counter in the game client on the Large Box opening screen. Each time you get a Tier VIII or IX Premium tank, this counter is reset, and the countdown to the next Tier VIII or IX vehicle drop starts over.

As soon as you have all the Tier VIII and IX vehicles from Large Boxes on your account, you will be compensated in gold for the value of each subsequent dropped tank according to the standard rules. A Garage slot will also be added.

Formidable Tanks for Your Collection

The most valuable and coveted gifts you might find inside Gift Large Boxes are the formidable Tier VIII and IX Premium tanks, including three brand-new vehicles. Each box may contain one Tier VIII or IX Premium tank from the following list:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5df930e3a8321efa927d45c24be6b19856e84769.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0f7244f8a2cce1350f83046f5357d93a481399d7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6925a7cc61828423438e31b1d504dd829a6f5df4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d4aacf491b03d6c65b7eb46665222593818cad0c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b83dc540e71a84d1b36d181f54c74d30fd6d2b7d.png

 NEW! The M47 Iron Arnie: A multi-role Tier VIII American medium tank, and the undisputed star among our brand-new headliners! This is an improved version of the M47 Patton II tank, with an enhanced armament and armor, and is based on the same vehicle that Arnold Schwarzenegger owns! Additional protection is provided by metal screens on the turret and hull, and a 105 mm gun was installed for firepower. Its dynamics and aiming time are not the best at Tier VIII, but they are well made up for by the excellent 230 mm of armor penetration with a standard AP shell and outstanding frontal protection. The multi-role M47 Iron Arnie can play as a powerful assault tank on the most dangerous sectors of the front line and carry its team.

[quote=]The M47 Iron Arnie comes with a special style that emanates celebrity vibes and will remind your opponents who the real battle star on the battlefield is!
 NEW! The BZ-176: A Chinese Tier VIII heavy tank, and a pioneer of the upcoming branch featuring the new jet booster mechanic. This slow but sturdy brawler has excellent armor characteristics, reaching 250 mm in the turret. Another feature of the BZ-176 is its 160 mm gun with good aiming time, and a damage per shot of 650 HP with a standard AP shell. Just beware of its very long reload time. The BZ-176 has a top speed of 30 km/h, but keep in mind that the jet booster mechanic increases the engine power and top forward speed, turning your vehicle into an unstoppable combat typhoon clearing everything in its path.
 NEW! The Char Mle. 75: A French Tier IX light tank, and a truly unique vehicle for your collection. This agile scout with skill-based gameplay features two speed modes: standard mode (the default one) and rapid mode (the fast one). It is armed with a 100 mm gun equipped with a six-shell autoloader. But the most interesting hallmark is that the gun fires bursts of several shells, not single shots. The burst includes three shells, each of which causes 200 HP of damage. The vehicle’s gameplay is based on the timely switching between the two speed modes.
 The Vipera: An Italian Tier VIII tank destroyer with a significant 400 HP of alpha damage and 220 mm of default penetration. It packs a powerful autoloader, firing five shells in 24 seconds, with an unconventional six-second delay between shots. Plenty of frontal armor, a semi-traversable turret, and -10 degrees of gun depression make this viper the ultimate hunter, allowing you to cause a quick 2,000 HP of damage.
 The AMBT: An American Tier VIII medium tank featuring a three-shell autoreloader. As the game’s first American autoreloader, the AMBT is a hybrid between single-shot and autoloading tanks. This, combined with its ricochet-friendly hull design, reliable turret, and appreciable gun depression, makes the AMBT a great tank for hull-down tactics. This gunslinger gives you the tools you need to become a unique support warrior in any battle!
However, you might receive one of these Tier II–V Premium vehicles instead. All of them are real historical projects:

 NEW! The A25 Harry Hopkins I: A Tier IV British light tank. This is a classic British light scout with a chassis from the Tetrarch I tank, plus a reinforced hull and an improved turret. Armed with a fast-firing 2-pdr Gun Mk X-B HH cannon, the A25 Harry Hopkins I is great for all fans of an aggressive and assertive playstyle.
 NEW! The Pz.Kpfw. KW I (r): A Tier V German heavy tank. This is a captured KV-1 tank with a modernized turret and a German 7,5 cm Kw.K. 40 L/48 gun. This tank retained the main features from the KV-1: decent all-around armor and good armament, but poor mobility. Unlike the KV-1, it has a better damage-to-rate of fire ratio—it causes less damage per shot but reloads faster. The Pz.Kpfw. KW I (r) also features a higher view range thanks to the commander’s cupola on the turret.
 NEW! The SU-2-122: A Tier V Soviet tank destroyer, and another one-of-a kind vehicle. This is the first double-barreled TD and the first double-barreled HE-based gameplay vehicle in the game. Externally, it is a chassis from a T-34 tank, on top of which is a cabin with two 122 mm howitzer guns. They can fire HE or HEAT rounds simultaneously or one after the other. For the opportunity to destroy a same-tier vehicle with one double shot, you will have to pay with poor accuracy and aiming time. The SU-2-122 also inherited decent mobility and mediocre hull armor from the T-34.
 The Pz.Kpfw. 38H 735 (f): A Tier II German light tank. During the French Campaign, Germany captured about 600 Hotchkiss 39 vehicles, which were modified and continued to serve in Wehrmacht units. World of Tanks veterans may remember that the "Minimaus" or "Hotchy" was once the most feared tank in Tier II battles. It is basically a Hotchkiss H35 with significantly better top speed, hit points, frontal armor, view range, and penetration. You may use it as a breakthrough tank or a durable sniper.
 The М3 Light: A Tier III Soviet light tank. This legendary vehicle was created in 1938–1941 based on the M2 and entered mass production in 1941. A total of 13,000 vehicles of different modifications were produced and supplied to almost all Allies under Lend-Lease. This vehicle features very good frontal armor for a light tank, immune to most guns. The М3 Light is an effective flanker, and it has a fast-firing gun but low penetration, so shooting at the sides of enemy tanks is a must.
Amazing 3D Styles for Tier IX and X Vehicles

You might also find another item instead: a brand-new 3D style* for one of the following vehicles:

 Jupiter Fulgur for the Super Conqueror
 Sleipnir for the Strv 103B
 Asterius for the Controcarro 3 Minotauro
 Constellation for the Bat.-Châtillon 155 58
 Levante for the Char Futur 4
[quote=]*If you don’t currently own the vehicle, you will still receive the 3D style, and you can apply it once you have the tank. You can only get one 3D style of each kind per account, which means that the styles that you have already obtained will no longer drop.
Finally, you may find one of six stunning 3D styles from last year’s Large Boxes for the following vehicles:

 Thunder Child for the FV4005 Stage II
 Hurricane for the Vz. 55
 Fair Trade for the Object 268 Version 4
 Fortuna for the Rinoceronte
 Saiga for ST-II
 Salamander for the XM551 Sheridan
There are a total of 11 unique 3D styles available this festive season—try to collect them all!

Compensation

notes.title: Holiday Ops 2023: Event Guide
notes.content:
The holidays are just around the corner, which means it’s time for Holiday Ops in World of Tanks. It’s the most anticipated event, featuring tons of rewards and wonderful surprises!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b27fa97a6b343877a0c57c4d9e19273907f580d8.png

Instead of your classic Garage, we’ve prepared for you a festive Village filled with joy and a magical atmosphere. Here, you will instantly find a pleasant gift from us: the brand-new M16/43 Sahariano, a Tier III Premium Italian medium tank. It’s a fast and maneuverable medium for fun and dynamic gameplay. This is also where you’ll meet our guest stars, Arnie and Milla! They will host the event and provide you with special quests and combat missions and make Holiday Ops even more exciting! Join us, and let’s celebrate together!

Holiday Ops 2023
EU: December 1, 2022 at 07:00 CET through January 9, 2023 at 07:00 CET (UTC+1)
NA:  December 1 at 03:20 PT | 05:20 CT | 06:20 ET through January 9 at 03:20 PT | 05:20 CT | 06:20 ET
ASIA: December 1, 2022 at 11:00 through January 9, 2023 at 11:00 (UTC+8)

[previewyoutube=qZZO8_-uHkU;full][/previewyoutube]
Event Summary

 Holiday Ops 2023 kicks off on December 1, 2022, at 07:00 CET and runs until January 9, 2023, at 07:00 CET (UTC+1) (EU server).
 The day the event starts, your Garage will turn into a festive Village with new landmarks: Headquarters with two guest stars, three Decorative Objects, zones to collect Holiday Ops resources, etc.
 Holiday Ops 2023 features a special event currency called Resources. There are four types of resources in the event: Rock Crystal, Pure Emerald, Warm Amber, and Meteoric Iron. All your festive activities will be based on collecting and investing these resources. You can get Holiday Ops resources in the following ways:

[olist]
 Collect them manually in your own Village up to twice a day
 As rewards for completing Daily Missions
 In your Best Friends’ Villages once a day
 When petting your dog friend Chaffee
 As a bonus from Large Boxes
[/olist]
 There are 10 levels of Festive Atmosphere, marking your progress in the event and providing you with rewards. To improve the Festive Atmosphere, upgrade decorative objects from Level 1 to 5 by collecting and investing Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald.
 By improving your Festive Atmosphere and reaching each new Level, you will earn rewards, such as new female crew members, a brand-new festive 2D style with unique Marks of Excellence, and much more.
 The day Holiday Ops 2023 starts, you can assign the status of "Best Friend" to up to two players from your friends list. You can visit their Villages and collect some extra resources once a day to boost your progress in the event. Remember that you don't take any resources from them—you just get additional resources for free! By collecting resources from your Best Friends, you will have the opportunity to receive special friendship-themed customizations.
 Arnold Schwarzenegger is back from last year, but he isn't alone this time: international star Milla Jovovich makes her Holiday Ops debut! She and Arnie will greet you at Headquarters in your Village. Our celebrities will provide you with Assignments, which are special quests that can be completed by collecting a certain amount of Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron.
 Upon completing a certain number of Assignments, you will receive exclusive decals and 2D styles with unique Marks of Excellence. On top of that, each completed Assignment increases economic bonuses to credits and all types of experience in Random Battles (including Grand Battles).

[quote=]If getting rewards for improving the Festive Atmosphere is the highest priority for you, focus on upgrading decorative objects by investing Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald.

If you're more interested in customization rewards from our celebrities and economic bonuses, focus on fulfilling their Assignments using Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron.
 You can also complete a Holiday Ops Challenge consisting of 28 Combat Missions From Milla, all in Random and Grand Battles, and all in Tier IV vehicles and higher.
 All missions are cumulative and can be performed at the same time. Upon completing a certain number of missions, you will receive rewards, including credit discounts on researchable vehicles, a brand-new 2D style with unique Marks of Excellence, Milla Jovovich herself as a tank commander, and much more.
 Upon completing all 28 Missions From Milla, you may unlock up to four additional missions, with each mission rewarding one of Arnie’s rewards that you didn't receive in last year's Holiday Ops Challenge.
 When you reach Festive Atmosphere Level X, you can start shopping in the Holiday Ops Shop using any of the four resources. Here, you will find customization rewards for assembling Collections from previous years (from 2018 through 2022) and Holiday Post 2022 that you did not receive. Depending on how complete your Collections were and how many Holiday Post rewards you received in previous years, you will get discounts.
 There will also be a Gift Terminal in your Village where you can spend Tokens. Tokens are another in-game currency that you can get in several ways. For each Token spent, you will receive one surprise gift from the list below:


 Consumables
 Personal Reserves
 A Training Guide
 Other in-game items

[quote=]But in some special cases, you may even get the Object 283, a brand-new Tier IX Special Soviet medium tank. You may get it for several rental battles, or it may be given to you permanently.
 We support transfer opportunities for players from CIS to the EU realm throughout the Holiday Ops 2023 event.
Discover Your New Festive Village!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f06e069de040efb7b24f7c601ca9f3905d7c6a2c.png

With the start of Holiday Ops 2023 on December 1, your Garage will turn into a snowy Village full of festive magic and fairy lights. It will certainly look charming, but you can improve it even further! This is where your free festive gift—the brand-new M16/43 Sahariano, a Tier III Premium Italian medium tank with a 100% trained crew and a Garage slot—will be waiting for you!

[quote=]When you first log in to the game client, you’ll be able to choose a fun name for your festive Village from the suggested combinations of words. Once confirmed, your Village will keep this name until the end of the event.
You will also find Headquarters here, which is where you can receive special combat missions and Assignments from our incredible celebrities. There will also be three magnificent decorative objects in your Village—the Christmas Tree, Fair, and Installation—that you can adorn with amazing Decorations!

Decorative Objects and Decorations

Each of the three decorative objects has five levels. To boost their level and customize your Village to your liking, you need to spend a certain amount of two Holiday Ops resources: Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald. Decorative objects levels are improved incrementally, meaning one after another.

Each time you reach a new level, you will receive several random Standard Decorations from four festive settings:

 New Year
 Christmas
 Lunar
 Magic
Upon reaching the first level, you will unlock the slots and will be able to place Standard Decorations in them. Improve the levels of your decorative objects, obtain new Decorations, and create your own unique atmosphere!

Additionally, you can outfit your Village with Large Decorations, and each one will be automatically put in its proper place. You will earn Large Decorations both for completing Assignments from our celebrities and for upgrading your decorative objects to Level 5.

[quote=]Standard and Large Decorations do not affect your progress in the event, but they serve as festive and fancy customization items for your Village.
Holiday Ops Resources

These are the four types of Holiday Ops resources, a special in-game currency:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7c4be346a85727b69b660c2578319a6467cf24d2.png

[quote=]Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald are used to improve the Festive Atmosphere, while Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron are needed to complete the Guests’ Assignments.
Collect resources and use them to do the following:

 Upgrade decorative objects
 Complete Guests’ Assignments
 Purchase customization rewards for assembling Collections from previous years (from 2018 through 2022) and Holiday Post 2022 feature rewards
 Purchase Tokens (another in-game currency that can be used in the Gift Terminal)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/40add46c5786d2ebe294805955db29dbc5a1b85f.jpg

You can get resources in different ways, and the first way is to collect them manually right in your Village. You can collect resources in your Village up to twice a day.

[quote=]After collecting resources for the first time in your Village, a 55-minute cooldown occurs. After the second collection, the cooldown lasts until the start of the next game day (05:00 CET).
If you plan to be away from the game for several days, make sure to activate the Resource Autocollector feature in advance. It allows you to automatically collect all the resources in your Village at the same time without logging in. Each time resources are collected in this way, you will be charged 150,000 credits. Automatic collection occurs at the end of each cooldown.

[quote=]You need to manually deactivate the Resource Autocollector. If you don’t, it will deactivate at the end of Holiday Ops or when there are not enough credits on your account.

If you activate the Resource Autocollector and don't log into the game before the end of the event, it will deactivate along with the end of Holiday Ops. Resources for this period won't be collected, and you won't be charged any credits.
You can also get resources in the following ways:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/03e5060cbed2cfbb603cffea3f690c9b0eb2e130.jpg

Resource Converter

If you have a lot of certain resources but fewer of other types, use the Resource Converter. It will allow you to exchange a chosen resource for any other type at the rate of 50:40.

Level Up Your Festive Atmosphere!

There are 10 levels of Festive Atmosphere, which define your progress in the event and provide you with rewards. At the start of Holiday Ops 2023, you’ll be at Festive Atmosphere Level I.

To improve the Festive Atmosphere, upgrade decorative objects from Level 1 to 5 by investing Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald. Each time you level up decorative objects, you earn special Festive Atmosphere Points that improve your Festive Atmosphere.

[quote=]*All new Holiday Ops 2023 2D styles feature special Marks of Excellence that will replace the default marks on the vehicle's gun.

Upon reaching Festive Atmosphere Level II, you will find a true friend in your Village: a cute and cheerful dog named Chaffee! If you pet Chaffee once a day, you will get a certain number of additional random resources.

[quote=]Once you have Chaffee in your Village, you can spend some gold and treat your new pet with various goodies, such as a new collar and even a kennel—very important things for any dog! After the end of the event, once the festive Holiday Ops Garage is disabled, your friend Chaffee will bid you farewell and leave with all his items, which will not be compensated.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1479db9b410034d2348d512245fc8201820cdeb8.jpg

Visit Your Best Friends to Grab Extra Resources and Unique Customizations!

During Holiday Ops 2023, you can visit the Villages of all your friends in World of Tanks to see who has the most creative and festive one of all!

Moreover, from the day the event starts, you can assign the status of "Best Friend" to up to two players from your friends list. You can visit their festive Garages and collect some extra resources once a day to boost your progress in the event.

[quote=]Collecting resources in your Best Friends' Villages does not affect the number of resources that they themselves will gather. You don't take anything from them, don’t worry—you just get additional resources for free!
Every time you collect resources in your Best Friend's Villages, you add one point to a special counter. After earning a certain number of these points, you will have the opportunity to get the following unique friendship-themed customizations:

 A set of 6 cool inscriptions (6 points required)
 A set of 6 stunning decals (12 points required)
 An amazing 2D style featuring unique Marks of Excellence (24 points required)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0c25ce5c3eb17be588a0873241b15eb8d7ecd597.jpg

Guest Stars and Festive Bonuses

This year, two incredible celebrities will help us make this event even cooler and more exciting! They will host Holiday Ops and greet you at Headquarters, an interactive 3D zone in your Village.

The first guest of honor is already familiar to you: the legendary Arnold Schwarzenegger! He enjoyed celebrating with us last year so much that he didn't hesitate when we invited him to our festive party again. But this year, Arnie will share the event with the amazing Milla Jovovich, and she has prepared something truly special for you—keep reading to find out more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a856671ad38be6ce48418f5305f86ca68cd4e346.jpg

Our celebrities will provide you with Assignments, which are special quests that can be completed by spending a certain amount of Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron. Each of the celebs has their own line of unique Assignments, as well as with their own progression and rewards. There are 10 quests from each host, making 20 in total. To complete an Assignment, you need to bring a specific item to the guest star.

Assignments from each celebrity are fulfilled sequentially, meaning one by one. If you haven’t completed your current active Assignment, you won’t be able to move on to the next one. Upon completing a certain number of quests, you will receive exclusive customization items from our celebrities, such as decals and 2D styles with unique Marks of Excellence. Additionally, our guest stars will tell you amazing stories and even help you decorate your Village!

New 2D Style from Milla

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/32f517ba50c131b0217ac1dcf1ca01aded2291ea.png

New 2D Style from Arnie

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d0531ba6d371e55548ae6cb1aa71f510bfb49d90.png

Each completed Assignment from Arnie or Milla simultaneously increases all economic bonuses in the game. When you finish an Assignment, you'll slightly increase the bonus to credits and bonuses to all types of XP—Free, Combat, and Crew—in Random Battles (including Grand Battles).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/36d6ecddbd808673e8b7b2ba045f8591cf901d71.png

[quote=]The bonus to credits applies to all vehicles in the game, including Premium and rental ones, until the end of Holiday Ops on January 9, 2023, at 07:00 CET (UTC+1) (EU server).

Bonuses to XP will also apply until the end of the event, but only one bonus of your choice can be active. By default, the bonus to Combat XP will be selected. You can change the type of active bonus to XP at any time in your Village. Active bonuses to XP apply to all vehicles in the game except Premium and rental ones.
In the event guide, you already learned how to get resources during Holiday Ops and what to spend them on. Let us note once again that you can use them to improve the Festive Atmosphere, as well as to complete Assignments from our super guests, Milla and Arnie.

[quote=]If getting rewards for improving the Festive Atmosphere is the highest priority for you, you’d better focus on upgrading decorative objects by investing Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald.

If you're more interested in customization rewards and economic bonuses from our celebrities, then give your primary attention to fulfilling their Assignments using Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron.
Take On the Holiday Ops Challenge!

Get ready to take on the Holiday Ops Challenge and prove that you can become real heroes, too!

The Challenge includes 28 Combat Missions From Milla to complete in Random and Grand Battles in Tier IV vehicles and higher. Every day, one new mission will be available for you. All missions are cumulative and can be performed at the same time. If you skip several missions, you can complete them all in one go. Upon completing a certain number of missions, you will receive rewards, including a unique medal, cool inscriptions, an amazing decal, and other great stuff.

Plus, completing Missions From Milla will grant you credit discounts on researchable vehicles. You’ll unlock these discounts gradually as you complete missions. The first discount on purchasing a Tier II vehicle will become available after completing two missions. As you progress, the tier of vehicles discounted will also increase. To earn a discount on purchasing a researchable Tier X vehicle, you need to complete all 28 missions.

[quote=]Each credit discount can only be applied once when purchasing one vehicle of the respective tier.
Once you have completed 23 missions, you'll get an incredible 2D style featuring Milla Jovovich herself and unique Marks of Excellence. Take a look:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2056a831ff81db1d316369e4e55ef197d75f9319.png

Once you have completed 27 missions, Milla Jovovich will become the commander of one of your vehicles! She comes fully prepared with Repair and Firefighting skills, as well as Brothers in Arms as a zero perk—plus enough experience to learn a fourth skill or perk of your choice. And no matter what happens on the battlefield, Milla will always energize you to win with her instantly recognizable voice!

Condition Replacements

Don’t like a particular mission condition? No problem! Every day until the end of Holiday Ops (including the first day of the event), you’ll receive one Condition Replacement. It allows you to change the condition of any current or missed mission.

Unused Condition Replacements are cumulative. You can change the condition of any mission (including additional Missions From Arnie, described below) as many times as you have Replacements. Or you might want to change the conditions of each mission only once—it's entirely up to you!

[quote=]The number of Condition Replacements you will obtain during the event is limited, so use them wisely!
Additional Challenge Missions From Arnie

Didn't manage to complete last year’s Missions From Arnie during Holiday Ops 2022? Here's your second chance to collect them! After you complete all 28 Missions From Milla, you will have the opportunity to unlock additional Missions From Arnie. You can unlock up to four missions in total, and completing each one will earn you one of the cool Arnie-themed rewards below:

 Arnold Schwarzenegger himself as a tank commander
 3 striking inscriptions (6 of each)
 An exclusive decal
 A spectacular 2D style with unique Marks of Excellence

[/expand]
[quote=]Only missions with the Arnie-themed rewards you didn't receive in last year's Holiday Ops Challenge will be available to you.

Example:

You have the Arnie inscriptions and decal, but you didn’t get the 2D style and Arnie himself as a tank commander. Accordingly, once you complete all 28 missions of this year’s Holiday Ops Challenge, you will unlock two additional missions to earn these two prizes.
And don't forget about the Condition Replacements you’ve accumulated—they're good to use for these Missions From Arnie, as well!
The Holiday Ops Shop

During the Holiday Ops event, when you reach Festive Atmosphere Level X, you can start shopping in the Holiday Ops Shop, which will become available in the game client.

In this Shop, you can purchase customization rewards for assembling Collections from previous years (from 2018 through 2022) and Holiday Post 2022.

[quote=]You will only be able to get the customizations that you did not receive in previous years.
Rewards for Collections from previous years and Holiday Post 2022 are purchased with any of the four types of resources. Depending on how complete your Collections were, you will receive discounts. And if you already have some Holiday Post customizations, you will also receive discounts on the remaining items.

Gift Terminal

Among the many wonderful objects that you will find in your Village, there will also be a Gift Terminal, in which you can spend special Tokens that you can get in the following ways:

 For improving your Festive Atmosphere levels
 As rewards for completing Missions From Milla
 In exchange for Holiday Ops resources
[quote=]You will be able to purchase Tokens with resources when all three conditions below are met:

 Reach Festive Atmosphere Level X
 Complete 10 Arnie’s Assignments
 Complete 10 Milla’s Assignments

Thus, the Gift Terminal will help you invest unused resources and get your hands on additional rewards before the end of Holiday Ops!

For each Token spent, you will receive one gift. What could it be? It’s always a surprise! You may get various regular in-game gifts or some rare gifts—these two categories of gifts have their own drop rates. Check it out:

Gift Terminal Drop Rates

 NEW! Tank Object 283 for rent

In some special cases, you may even receive the Object 283*, a brand-new Tier IX Special Soviet medium tank — either for several rental battles or permanently!

[quote=]*If you sell the Object 283, this vehicle will no longer drop—either for rent or permanently, but you can restore it using the in-game Recovery tool.

notes.title: Autumn Sale: Ending the Season With Great Bargains!
notes.content:
Commanders!

It is almost time to say farewell to the golden season of falling leaves, chestnuts, and pumpkins. Yes, autumn is coming to an end. It has brought lots of exciting events and activities, and even more are yet to come this winter! notes.title: Frontline Is Back for Its Final 7-Day Run in 2022!
notes.content:
[quote=]Dear players, in case your internet connection is slow, you may experience problems with the UI when respawning in battle: some of the necessary elements may be missing or extra ones may be present, and/or the vehicle chosen by you may be wrongly displayed as destroyed. We have done our best to minimize the number of such issues, but sadly, we haven‘t been able to eliminate them entirely. If you encounter one, relaunching the game client may help.
Commanders!

Epic 30v30 battles are here to rock vast battlefields again! From November 21 through November 28, Frontline will return to World of Tanks for its final launch in 2022. Soon, you’ll be attacking pillboxes and defending them while using a whole array of Combat Reserves to give your side a tactical edge. Barring a few minor changes, the rules, mechanics, and rewards will be the same as in the second Frontline launch, so you’ll feel at home!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/89d09bba28f913bea084c1df84364fbafc817fa0.jpg

Battle Format

There will only be single-tier battles during the third launch of Frontline in 2022. Get your favorite Tier VIII vehicles ready!

Changes to Combat Reserves

During the third launch of Frontline, you will have the tried-and-tested Combat Reserves at your disposal. Their parameters are the same as the last time, except for one change: After you respawn, you will have to wait a bit for the Combat Reserves to be ready for use—for 30% of their nominal cooldown time.

Rental Vehicles

Rental vehicles are the same as those used during the second launch—all “clones” of their respective researchable Tier VIII counterparts with the best modules installed. Crews from vehicles of the same nation and type can be transferred on and off them for free and without penalty. Rental vehicles will be available for the entire duration of Frontline, which is seven days, and they can only be used in this mode.

notes.title: The Challenge Generator: Phase II
notes.content:
[quote=]Final Stage completed! Congratulations, Commanders! You’ve demonstrated that the WoT Steam Community can take on any challenge! Every Steam player who earns or has already earned six Progress Tokens will soon receive the rewards for the Final Stage.
Commanders! 
 
A couple of months ago one of our exploration squads came across a strange and complex machine at an abandoned military base. Upon further investigation, it turned out to be an experimental training device called the Challenge Generator.  
 
Our scientists took great interest in this machine, and the First Phase of the research was conducted, where many of you participated. During the analysis of the gathered data, the scientists have discovered more hidden functions of the machine: it is not only able to follow tankers’ individual progress, but also track the collective progress of thousands of tankers and encourage them to work together by introducing something called Progress Tokens!  
 
What are Progress Tokens and how does it all work? Well, that’s what we are going to find out. It is time to power up the Challenge Generator again for the Phase II! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/215a0eefbffc8922bae9520f3d13059e3731d729.png

Phase II: Key Points 
 
 The event goes on from November 4, 2022, at 05:00 UTC through November 21, 2022, at 05:00 UTC. 
 During the event, The Challenge Generator will create two sets of weekly challenges for you. 

[olist]  
 The first set will be available from the start of the event until November 11, 05:00 UTC.  
 The second one will be available from November 11, 05:00 UTC until the end of the event.  
[/olist] 
 The set of challenges consists of 4 weekly missions: one easy, one medium, one hard, and one additional challenge. Each of these missions can be completed only once. 
 Easy, medium and hard missions are available immediately and can be completed at the same time. It means that by performing well in one battle you can contribute to all three missions’ progress at once!  
 Additional challenge will be available to you after you complete both easy and medium weekly missions.  
 For completing these missions, you will receive a certain amount of Progress Tokens and some Credits.  
 Progress Tokens are used to track the Community Progression of the event. By completing challenges and accumulating Progress Tokens, Steam Community can move through the Progression and receive more valuable rewards. 
 The total number of the Progress tokens earned by the Steam Community and current Progression stage are shown on our special Infographics above, as well as the requirements and rewards. This image is updated once a day. 
 Now, let’s go through all the information in detail. 
 
Weekly Missions: Complete Them to earn Progress Tokens 
 
When the event starts, the Challenge Generator will create a special set of four challenges for all tankers. It will be available for completion until November 11, 05:00 UTC. 
 
After that time all unfinished missions will disappear and a new set of four challenges will be generated, which you will be able to complete until the end of the event.  
 
A weekly set of challenges consists of four missions: 
 
 Easy Challenge 
 Medium Challenge 
 Hard Challenge 
 Bonus Challenge 
 Easy, medium and hard missions are available for all tankers from the start of the event and can be completed at the same time and in any order you like. Keep in mind that these challenges are generated by the mysterious machine, so don’t be surprised if you and your friends get completely different missions!  
 
However, our scientists figured out that there is one thing that all of these missions have in common. They all require you to prove your mastery by obtaining a certain Honorary Rank, Commemorative Token, Battle Hero Medal, or even a Mastery Badge.  
 
If you complete an easy and a medium mission during the week, the Challenge Generator will grant you access to a Bonus Challenge. The tests show that these ones are not generated randomly, and the conditions are quite straightforward.  
 
[quote=]NOTE: To see all the missions and their exact conditions go to the “MISSIONS” tab in your Garage, and then scroll down to the “Challenge Generator” section.  
For finishing these missions, you receive some Credits and a certain amount of Progress Tokens (more on them below):

[tr]
	[th]Mission Type [/th]
	[th]Reward[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Easy Challenge [/td]
	[td]
 40000 Credits 
 1 Progress token 
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Medium Challenge [/td]
	[td]
 60000 Credits 
 2 Progress tokens 
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Hard Challenge [/td]
	[td]
 80000 Credits 
 3 Progress tokens 
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Bonus Challenge: Week 1 [/td]
	[td]
 100000 Credits

[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Bonus Challenge: Week 2 [/td]
	[td]
 100000 Credits 
 3 Progress tokens 
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Progress Tokens and Community Progression 
 
Progress Tokens are your main focus in this event! The Challenge Generator uses them to track the overall Steam Community progress, so every mission you complete contributes to the common goal! 
 
This time, all Steam tankers are united in a pursuit for the best rewards. The Challenge Generator has a special Community Progression, which consists of four Stages.  
 
Each Stage requires a certain number of Progress Tokens earned by the Steam World of Tanks Community. When the Community collects the required number of Progress Tokens to unlock a new Stage, all players who contributed enough will receive a reward!  

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[th]Stage[/th]
	[th]1[/th]
	[th]2[/th]
	[th]3[/th]
	[th]4[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Progress Tokens Required [/td]
	[td]20,000 [/td]
	[td]50,000 [/td]
	[td]80,000 [/td]
	[td]130,000 [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Rewards [/td]
	[td]
 1 day of WoT Premium Account 
 5 Large First Aid Kits 
 5 Large Repair Kits 
 5 Automatic Fire Extinguishers
 [/td]
	[td]
 5 Personal Reserves: +200% to Crew and Free XP earned in battle for 1 hour 
 5 Personal Reserves: +50% to Combat XP earned in battle for 1 hour
 [/td]
	[td]
 10 missions for ×5 XP per battle for any vehicle 
 5 Demounting Kits
 [/td]
	[td]
 3 days of WoT Premium Account 
 Autumn Wind 2D style
 [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Keep in mind that the Challenge Generator rewards only those who actually contribute to the common goal. To receive the Stage rewards, a player must earn a certain minimum number of Progress Tokens: 

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[th]Stage[/th]
	[th]1[/th]
	[th]2[/th]
	[th]3[/th]
	[th]4[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Minimal Personal Contribution Required to Receive the Stage Rewards [/td]
	[td]3 Progress Tokens earned [/td]
	[td]3 Progress Tokens earned [/td]
	[td]6 Progress Tokens earned [/td]
	[td]6 Progress Tokens earned [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
To sum it up, let’s review an example. To get rewards for the first Stage of the Community Progression, two conditions should be met: 
[olist] 
 The total number of Progress Tokens earned by all Steam players across all three regions is equal or higher than 20,000 
 You personally have earned at least 3 Progress Tokens 
[/olist] Complete missions, earn Progress Tokens, get rewards: simple as that!  
 
Progress Tracking 
 
To see how much progress the Steam Community has already made, you can check the special Infographics at the start of this announcement. On the Infographics, you can find the progress bar and the total number of Tokens earned by players.  
 
The Challenge Generator is a complex device that does a lot of processing. Our scientists are still working on figuring out the full power of the device, but for now, the data on the Infographics is updated once a day.  
 
Participate in the Research! 
 
Phase II is sure to provide us with even more information about the Challenge Generator. We still don’t know a lot about this device, but we are certain it has great potential.  
 
Help us to discover the mysteries of the Challenge Generator, complete the missions, earn Progress Tokens and get the best rewards! 
 
Roll out!

notes.title: It’s Pumpkin Bash Time!
notes.content:
Are you ready for some light-hearted but very intense and fun engagements filled with sorcery? From October 20 through November 4, the Pumpkin Bash event will boil and bubble like a magical cauldron. Come one, come all—for heated PvP revelry and some nice prizes, among which is the loyalty of the first crew of coven members in World of Tanks!

Pumpkin Bash

EU: From October 20 at 7:30 CEST (UTC+2) through November 4 at 4:00 CET (UTC+1)
NA: From October 19 at 04:30 PT | 06:30 CT | 07:30 ET through November 3 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET
ASIA: From October 20 at 07:30 UTC+8 through November 4 at 05:00 UTC+8

[previewyoutube=6MwJD0a3xYg;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/83664da83a0f9478346710c1d16927d7f47ce690.jpg

Battle Mechanics

Eligible Vehicles

You can participate in Pumpkin Bash battles in any Tier VI–VIII vehicle. The matchmaker will try to set up a single-tier, 15v15 battle. If that isn’t possible, the matchmaker will consider other options: first, multi-tiered battles, and then the 10v10 and 7v7 formats.

Wheeled vehicles will have separate battles in the Pumpkin Bash mode with the same matchmaker logic. On some occasions, you may have to wait in a queue for your battle to start.

For those who don’t have wheeled vehicles, the following rental ones will be available for the duration of Pumpkin Bash:

 Panhard AMD 178B  
 Hotchkiss EBR  
 Panhard EBR 75 (FL 10)  
Victory Conditions

Unabashed Halloween PvP fun shows in very special victory conditions. In Pumpkin Bash engagements, you can win in either of the following ways:

 Capturing both (yes—BOTH) bases
 Helping your team do more overall damage than the other side before the battle ends
Resurrection

Relentless foe-bashing is more than welcome because, should your vehicle get destroyed, you respawn again in the same vehicle in designated Resurrection Points, with no limits for resurrections. You come back into battle with full ammo, regular consumables, and special consumables (Combat Abilities) that you had at the battle’s start. By the way, repairs and ammo are free and unlimited in Pumpkin Bash. It should be noted that you receive neither credits nor XP in Pumpkin Bash battles, but the prizes more than make up for that!

Combat Abilities

Pumpkin Bash magical Combat Abilities come in addition to regular consumables in event battles. Passive Combat Abilities give your vehicle some juicy bonuses, and Active Combat Abilities bestow some quirky beneficial effects upon your ride. They cost just 3,000 credits each in the in-game Store. Before a Pumpkin Bash battle, you can outfit your tank with up to three different Combat Abilities, mixing and matching them as you wish. It doesn’t matter how many of them are Active or Passive. You can even go all Active or all Passive.

[quote=]Combat Abilities are activated with the 1, 2, and 3 buttons, and the shell types are instead mapped to the 7, 8, and 9 buttons. This is for your convenience, as you most likely will use Combat Abilities more often than you will change your shell type in Pumpkin Bash battles. The regular consumables stay in their place (buttons 4, 5, and 6).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3e20ed6a8092372c86706fdfad669bed74a96a23.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/145fd778075b036fc4220a88025962a0f1ca098c.png

Jack-o’-Lantern

The Jack-o’-Lantern is an arcane source of various super buffs you may pick up during the battle, some of which can potentially alter the battle’s course. Cast a glance at the minimap often (as you always do), and you’ll know when this epically magical drop appears. Keep in mind that the Jack-o’-Lantern bonus is random, so you won’t see what you’ll pick up until you do! Once you have it, you keep the buff until your vehicle is destroyed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8305e9c82516ecc68457fee625640bbc2f6a0dc1.png

Maps

Pumpkin Bash battles take place on four maps. These locations will seem vaguely familiar because they have been “Halloweenified,” becoming mysterious and even mystical. While the maps are darker than usual, a full moon is shining brightly over each of them, so you’ll see where to drive to and what to aim at. 

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]                                    Murovanka[/th]
[th]                                    Studzianki[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a4500beea3242bf2eb4891f034e52674f8d28bfa.png[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7435cebee5afc633f1f2451487dd921b8fdffcdd.png[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]                                      Pilsen[/th]
[th]                                    Ruinberg[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b507e14a133f4889a0e350ced4f538e70a9d454.png[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b71f4b7a65313996c28eb023436fd75a35078a88.png[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Progression

Stages

The Pumpkin Bash progression consists of five Stages. For every Stage, there’s a three-day period to complete its Quests and claim the rewards. After that, the Stage gets locked and the next one starts. Make sure not to miss any of the Stages—some of the prizes’ features work only in a team (more on that in the Rewards section below). And make sure to log in daily for a helping of Combat Abilities!

Halloween Points

Sorcery-infused armored combat gives you Halloween Points after each battle you win. The number of Halloween Points you receive is calculated according to the same rules as the amount of XP in Random Battles.

Stage Missions 

Every Stage has two Stage Missions for you. To complete the first one, you need to earn Halloween Points. You will receive bonds and regular consumables. The second Mission of every Stage requires you to use a specific Combat Ability in multiple Pumpkin Bash battles. The reward is a fabulous female crew member or a sarcastic feline crew member, plus a special personalized 2D style of theirs and some decals.

Rewards

Witch Crew

Bonds and consumables are good, but we dare say the first-ever witch crew is even better! Especially considering it’s a fully voiced crew of sorceress tankers and their token cat. And by “fully voiced,” we mean every crew member has custom lines and reactions to what is happening in a given moment.

notes.title: Halloween 2022: It’s All Fun and Witchcraft
notes.content:
Commanders!

Autumn reigns supreme. Leaves are falling, the wind is howling, the nights are growing longer and colder, and a cozy fire is crackling in the hearth. It sure makes one yearn for a good ghost story and some light-hearted fun, you know? And the Pumpkin Bash event, running from October 20 through November 3, will have it all. Plus witches. And a talking cat. See for yourselves!

[previewyoutube=i8QaNZte20Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Celebrate Halloween 2022 in World of Tanks by taking part in 15v15 PvP battles in Tier VI–VIII vehicles on four familiar maps. These locations have been given a ghoulish Halloween look, so expect mysterious fog, a full moon, and other changes to put you in the spooky spirit. Also, get ready for quirky new rules, including:

 Unusual victory conditions (you’ll love these)
 Superpowers up for grabs on the battlefield
 Special abilities activated before battle
 Unlimited respawns
 Free ammo and repairs
Along with bonds and vehicle customization items, the rewards will include a five-strong crew of charismatic characters with different major qualifications. Each crew member will also have a unique voiceover.

notes.title: Update 1.18.1 Is Here!
notes.content:
Time to check out Update 1.18.1, Commanders! 

This update includes a ton of great features that will boost your game experience and add to the fun. Get ready for the brand-new Onslaught mode, the free Sixth Sense perk for your vehicle crews, modified Personal Reserves, balancing changes to four maps, and more. Dive into the game and check it all out!

[previewyoutube=s6wFsfZWa84;full][/previewyoutube]
Onslaught Mode

What if you could play in teams of seven, with everyone rolling out to the battlefield in Researchable and Collectors’ Tier X vehicles? What if you could use upgradable skills based on your vehicle’s role, capture Points of Interest to get extra Tactical Skills, and band together in Super Platoons of seven players? Well, enough what-ifs! Join Onslaught mode to find out for yourself, and enjoy the new rating-based matchmaking. The rewards include “Wing and Claw,” the first-ever progressive 2D style. Find out more about Onslaught in the dedicated article for the new mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cc658fc3e3ecddab1bfcb572b12b105fa2374131.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3398551594417802749
Free Sixth Sense

The Sixth Sense perk is now free for every existing vehicle commander, as well as those you obtain in the future. If any of your crew members already have the perk, all of the XP you invested into Sixth Sense will be refunded. This XP will first be used to completely train their major qualification to 100%, and then on the last skill or perk that was being trained, and finally, on Crew XP that can be spent on a new skill or perk. If you have questions, refer to the dedicated article.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/41b6f8bab49de9a9cf5b7d80668541db3855088e.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3301726014492689801
Improved Personal Reserves

Personal Reserves have been streamlined. Now, there are just three types of Reserves (one per slot) and two levels of bonuses. Plus, all Personal Reserves will have a duration of 1 hour. This means no more complicated calculations. The modified UI allows you to activate Personal Reserves on the fly, even during battle. Your old Personal Reserves have been converted into the new ones using a conversion rate that works in your favor. Check out the dedicated article for more details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e18334c9105db12a83df705dcf95255c7b7d840e.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/4649425839616028933
Map Balance Adjustments

We have refreshed four more locations: Malinovka, Sand River, Fisherman’s Bay, and Himmelsdorf. While playing on these maps, you can now enjoy the fresh smell of new tactical opportunities, and more balanced and fair team competition. If you would like to familiarize yourself with all of the changes to the locations mentioned above, see the Common Test article, which features a bunch of “before and after” screenshots.

notes.title: The End of the Waffenträger: Legacy
notes.content:
“Where Are You, Papi?”

(An excerpt from the personal diary of Ermelinda Jung)
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]                                                                        {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/19e2309381a67ec81b289c0a16f5b34c3df3287f.png                                                                        [/td]
[td]Finally. Everything is back in its place, just as it was a few days ago. Still, the wind hasn’t yet managed to blow away the already-annoying smell of burnt wires. We returned to the starting point and bought ourselves some time to prepare for another stupid invasion. If there is one, of course. The situation is complicated. On the one hand, we have the Alliance, with its maniacal desire to “solve” a problem that they created themselves. And on the other hand, we have my father, who, with stoic patience, has been forced to respond to their aggression over and over again.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
But he wasn't around for this battle, and that couldn’t have been an accident. A person who always plans their moves several steps ahead of the game, like a good chess player, would surely have known about the upcoming attack. Nevertheless, the Alliance couldn't have known that he was away, unless their dogs were somehow involved in it. And given their ridiculous attempt to assault our fortifications once again, I refuse to believe that they are capable of something like this.

But if my father knew they were coming and left me to defend our land, what was it? A test? Why? To make sure he had trained a worthy replacement? I’ve never given him any reason to doubt my skills, and dad would not have left when there was so much work to do. No, no, it can't be. It’s only natural that I fought off the Harriers so elegantly. We’ve been improving our defense systems around the clock, gaining knowledge, building algorithms and developing methods of counteraction. A victory was the only possible outcome. Then again, we had Villanelle against us (I finally learned her name), and as far as I know, she is the only one of these bloated Alliance officers who could ever get my father to talk. Personally. Face to face. So there's no way they could have known he wasn't here.

Thankfully, no one will ever read this diary of mine. I wouldn’t want anyone to find out how inferior my analytical skills are to my technical talent. The odds are definitely on my side. Even if the Harriers do return, it won’t be for a long time. So I have more important things to worry about. My father is still missing. If this was a test, he would have already scolded me for making such a mess (underlined, with a note in the margin: "Convert one of the Sentinel platoons into ARVs") and praised me for my skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0fcc957780645f23e9b3d0c1eb3e6ddd29fbe40e.jpg

Where are you? The Alliance (rightly) considers me a force to be reckoned with, but you’re the only one who knows how hard it is for me to be alone. Without your support. Without the "Why are the wrenches scattered all over the garage?" I'm not a warrior, and you never raised me to be one. However, when I look back at the fury that overcame me when I destroyed those attackers invading my... OUR home, I see that there are two completely different people living within me. And I don't know which Ermelinda you would prefer to have on your team.

It has been a long time since I let myself vent like this. And that's because the worst thing a person can do is lose control of a situation. Still, I fear that I have. And it's all because of these demons of doubt that have been attacking me for the past several days.

Focus. Enough distractions. I think I should switch gears and just enjoy the moment. After all, my steel friends are still crushing the Alliance, yet I’ve somehow forgotten to enjoy the nice taste of... revenge? I'll make you proud, Papi, I promise. Just come back soon.

Coffee. I need another mug.

notes.title: Sixth Sense: A Special Commander Feature
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

When Update 1.18.1 goes live, the Sixth Sense perk will become a special commander feature. This means that it will always be available for all crew commanders in the game, and you will no longer need to train it. We are sure that this change will make battles more enjoyable for all players, especially new ones. Let’s see how it works and what will happen to your newly available perk slot.

Crew 2.0 Sandbox Test: A Look Back

In 2021, we tested Crew 2.0 in Sandbox. From the very beginning of testing, the Sixth Sense perk was made available as a default perk for all crew commanders. We received a huge number of questions, feedback, and comments. Clearly, players were very interested in these major proposed changes. After completing the tests, we took a break and carefully analyzed the statistics and feedback we obtained with your help. It was obvious that Crew 2.0 required further improvements, and its main changes could not be released in this form. However, we decided to first develop the solutions you would find most useful, including the Sixth Sense perk as a special commander feature.

Since then, we have been gradually moving forward, refining and improving some of the ideas shown on the Sandbox server. The Sixth Sense perk will be the first Crew improvements from these ideas introduced to the game. In the future, other changes to the Crew concept will follow. However, we will get into more detail about that at a later date.

Free Sixth Sense: General Rules and Compensation

Sixth Sense will become a special feature for all current and future crew commanders that you recruit, receive, or retrain. It will be available automatically starting from the crew commander’s first battle, regardless of the major qualification level. The mechanics of the Sixth Sense perk will work the same as before.

If any of your commanders already possess the Sixth Sense perk, the XP you spent to train the perk will be fully compensated upon the release of Update 1.18.1, and then automatically re-distributed in the following order of priority:
[olist]
 To reach 100% of your commander’s major qualification (if it was below 100%).
 To train the last skill of the commander to 100% (if there was any skill that was not fully trained).
 The remaining experience will go to the commander experience pool and can be spent on a new skill/perk of your choice.
[/olist]Example:

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]UPDATE 1.18[/th]
[th]UPDATE 1.18.1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Major qualification — 100%

Sixth Sense — 100%[/td]
[td]Major qualification — 100%

Sixth Sense — special commander feature

New skill/perk of your choice — 100%[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
If the Sixth Sense perk has not been trained to 100%, then the experience spent on it will go towards reaching 100% of your commander's major qualification. The remaining XP will go back to the commander experience pool, so you can select and start training a new skill/perk of your choice. This new skill/perk will automatically be upgraded to the same level as the original Sixth Sense perk (e.g., 70% for 70%).

Example:

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]UPDATE 1.18[/th]
[th]UPDATE 1.18.1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Major qualification — 90%

Sixth Sense — 70%[/td]
[td]Major qualification — 100%

Sixth Sense — special commander feature

New skill/perk of your choice — 41%*[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
*Training the first perk from 0% to 70% requires 51,172 XP. To reach 100% of your commander’s major qualification with 90%, you need 39,153 XP. The remaining 12,019 XP is only enough for 41% of the new skill/perk.

[quote=]After the release of Update 1.18.1, the Increased Focus directive will no longer be available for purchase. Already purchased/received directives of this type will remain in your Depot, and you can continue to use them to strengthen the effect of the Sixth Sense feature until they are all used up.
Interface Improvements

We have also slightly redesigned the crew interface, making it clearer and easier to navigate. Special commander features and zero skills/perks will now be displayed separately. In the screenshots below, you will find these changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2507147def08d3d0eff59b7528a85845c965e5e7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d6bffc06d7227b70d05d0336c75795f73902bf50.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/810c0b3d0cedb0351b71460c2e040a955fe0837c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6bd60368320df7b8286ad7c5f24761b20adbdf63.jpg

Sixth Sense as a Zero Perk

If your commander possesses Sixth Sense as the zero perk, you will be able to choose any of the 4 basic perks and skills (Repair, Firefighting, Concealment, Brothers in Arms), or any of the major qualification perks in its place as a zero perk (this rule also applies to each crew member who possessed Sixth Sense).

If Sixth Sense was a zero perk and you managed to train some other perks, you can still make them the new zero perk.

Example:

You have trained 5 perks, including Sound Detection. You will now be able to set Sound Detection as the zero perk. This perk will no longer be on your list of trained perks, and the XP you spent to train it will be compensated and automatically re-distributed in the same order as the fully trained Sixth Sense perk.

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]UPDATE 1.18[/th]
[th]UPDATE 1.18.1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Sound Detection — 40%

Sixth Sense — zero perk

Major qualification — 100%

Brothers in Arms— 100%

Firefighting — 100%
[/td]
[td]Sound Detection — zero perk

Sixth Sense — special commander feature

Major qualification — 100%

Brothers in Arms — 100%

Firefighting — 100%

New skill/perk of your choice — 40%
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Instead of the Sixth Sense zero perk, you can choose any basic skill/perk (Repair, Firefighting, Concealment, Brothers in Arms), or any skill/perk from your crew member's major qualification. For example, for the Commander (other than the basic skills/perks), you can choose from:
[olist]
 Jack of All Trades
 Mentor
 Recon
 Eagle Eye
[/olist]Accordingly, if you retrain your Commander to Loader, you’ll be able to choose from:
[olist]
 Safe Stowage
 Intuition
 Adrenaline Rush
[/olist][quote=]Remember, you can only choose a new zero perk once and you won’t be able to change it later.
Roll out and stay tuned, Commanders!
