[td]Improved[/td]
[td]+100%[/td]
[td]+300%[/td]
[td]+100%[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
 Standard Reserves will be awarded for taking part in in-game events and activities. Improved Reserves will come from in-game purchases or as part of in-game Store packages.
 With Update 1.18.1, it will be technically possible for Standard Personal Reserves to have an expiration date (after which they disappear from the player’s account). Please note that we will not be using this functionality in the foreseeable future. Here’s what it means for players:  


 Improved Personal Reserves will not have expiration date.
 Converted Personal Reserves will not have expiration date. This applies to both Standard and Improved Personal Reserves.
 Battle Pass, Well-Deserved Reward, Holiday Ops, or any other current and upcoming activities will NOT distribute Personal Reserves with an expiration date anytime soon. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png
The Principles of Personal Reserve Conversion

As the new Personal Reserves all have a duration of 1 hour, and given that there will only be two bonus values per type (Standard and Improved), we will have to convert all existing Personal Reserves. With this conversion, the combined value of new Personal Reserves on your account will be greater than or equal to the combined value of old Personal Reserves on your account.

The value of an old Personal Reserve can be defined as its bonus (in %) multiplied by its duration in hours. The value of a new Personal Reserve is simply its bonus (in %) since the new Personal Reserves all have a duration of 1 hour.

Therefore, during this conversion, the value of your Personal Reserves will stay the same or grow. The quantity of new Personal Reserves will always be rounded up, and you will not lose any value during the conversion.

Personal Reserves with a numeric value that exists in the new system but a long duration (e.g., 2 hours) will be converted into the respective number of 1-hour Reserves.
[quote=]EXAMPLE:

You have seven 2-hour Personal Reserves for +50% to Combat XP. After the conversion, you will get fourteen 1-hour Standard Personal Reserves for +50% to Combat XP.

Personal Reserves with numeric values that do not exist in the new system (e.g., +15% to credits) will have their bonuses “compressed” so that the total value for the player remains the same or increases.

[quote=]EXAMPLE:

You have two 4-hour Personal Reserves for +15% to credits. After the conversion, you will get three 1-hour Personal Reserves for +50% to credits. Why? One 4-hour Personal Reserve with a bonus of 15% has a value of 60% (15% × 4). As the closest new Personal Reserve bonus value is 50%, you should get 2.4 of the new Reserves (1.2 × 2). This rounds up in your favor to three. With the new Reserve, in 1 hour, you will earn approximately the same number of extra credits that you would earn in 4 hours with the old Reserve.
Personal Reserves for Crew XP and Free XP on your account will be converted into the new combined Personal Reserves for Crew and Free XP as follows. First, the converter will assess the quantity, bonuses, and duration of the Reserves (separately for Reserves with Standard and Improved bonuses). Then, the converter will calculate the number of new combined Personal Reserves that would appear after the conversion of Personal Reserves for Crew XP and Personal Reserves for Free XP. After that, the converter will choose the greater value and add the resulting number of new combined Personal Reserves on your account.

[quote=]EXAMPLE:

You have eight 2-hour Personal Reserves for +300% to Crew XP and eleven 2-hour Personal Reserves for +300% to Free XP. After the conversion, you will get twenty-two 1-hour combined Personal Reserves for +300% to Crew and Free XP. Why? One 2-hour Personal Reserve with a bonus of 300% has a value of 600% (300% × 2). The total value of eight 2-hour Personal Reserves is 4,800%, and in case with eleven 2-hour Personal Reserves is 6,600%, which is the greater of the two. By dividing 6,600% by 300%, we get 22.
Commanders, we hope you enjoy the reworked Personal Reserves system and UI. Game on!

notes.title: [UPDATED] Battle Pass Season IX: Event Guide
notes.content:
Commanders! 

Welcome to Battle Pass Season IX, taking place from September 8th through November 30th.

Start off with a Chapter of your choosing, then complete the Stages one by one to enter a world of excellent rewards. This Season, these include progressive 3D styles for the Season IX Core Vehicles: the 60TP Lewandowskiego, the Progetto M40 mod. 65, and the AMX 13 105 (the first-ever light tank in a Battle Pass lineup). Keep in mind that this will be the last season of Battle Pass in 2022, which means you have to spend all your Battle Pass Tokens before they are reset. Luckily, there are plenty of valuable rewards on offer. Do you have a Cobra yet? Want some more rare Tier IX vehicles for your Garage? Well, this is your chance!

Battle Pass Season IX

EU: September 8 at 07:00 CEST (UTC+2) through November 30 at 01:30 CET (UTC+1)
NA: September 8 at 03:00 PT | 05:00 CT | 06:00 ET through November 29 at 23:30 PT | November 30 at 01:30 CT | 02:30 ET.
ASIA: September 8 at 03:00 UTC+8 through November 29 at 02:00 UTC+8

[previewyoutube=qo90_SV3sKA;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote=][UPDATED] 07/09/2022
 
Taking the discussion on the matter into consideration, we’ve decided NOT to make Personal Reserves from Season IX Base rewards time-limited after Update 1.18.1. Therefore, ALL Personal Reserves you obtain as Battle Pass Season IX rewards will have no expiration date, whether you collect them before or after 1.18.1 hits.
 
Regarding time-limited Personal Reserves in general, we will introduce them as an in-game entity with Update 1.18.1. Yet we have no plans to use them in in-game activities in foreseeable future.
 
Once the new mechanics are introduced, all Personal Reserves on your account will be converted into the new reserves at no loss of value. Expect a dedicated article on the new Personal Reserves in the coming days.
The Rewards

If you played the previous two Battle Pass Seasons of 2022, you know the drill: Earn Battle Pass Points and complete Stages to receive rewards. Start with any Chapter and switch between Chapters as often as you wish without losing your progress. If you would like more comprehensive instructions or just want to know every single detail about Season IX, check out the full guide.

TO THE FULL GUIDE

The mountain of Battle Pass Season IX prizes is already towering high, but you can make it even taller by obtaining an Improved Pass. 

Soon, we will announce all of the improvements we’re going to make to the mechanics and UI of Personal Reserves. But for now, here are the key changes:

 All Personal Reserves will have a duration of one hour.
 Personal Reserves for Crew XP and Free XP will be merged into a single combined type. (This also applies to Season IX progression rewards.)
 Along with the three types of Personal Reserves, there will be two grades of bonuses: Standard (+50% to XP / +50% to credits / +200% to Crew and Free XP) and Improved (+100% to XP / +100% to credits / +300% to Crew and Free XP).
 [strike]Newly-issued Standard Personal Reserves, including those from Season IX Base Rewards, will have an expiration date (one month after Season IX ends), but Improved Personal Reserves will not.[/strike]
Once the new mechanics are introduced, all Personal Reserves on your account will be converted into the new reserves at no loss of value. Personal Reserves that are collected as Season IX Base Rewards before the implementation of the new mechanics will not have expiration dates after being converted. Moreover, Personal Reserves that come as Improved Rewards will never have expiration dates.

You can expect a dedicated article on the new Personal Reserves mechanics in the coming days.

The 3D Styles

The Season IX 3D styles give the Core Vehicles a cutting-edge appearance, bristling with innovation.

 The Bernard 3D style for the 60TP Lewandowskiego  turns this tough tank into a truly stylish moving stronghold.
 The Cesare 3D style for the Progetto M40 mod. 65  makes this sharpshooter look even sharper.
 The Le Vizir 3D style for the AMX 13 105  gives this nimble-yet-dangerous reconnaissance vehicle a hi-tech visual upgrade.

notes.title: The Outpost Hits Random Battles!
notes.content:
The Outpost is the latest location to appear in the game. Although this map is brand new, it may already be familiar to many curious tankers who took part in Recon Mission 2021, in which Outpost became a fan favorite. Now it's here to stay with improved visuals, fine-tuned gameplay, and a powerful soundtrack. Let’s look, learn, and listen!

[previewyoutube=1exxFQVwhKA;full][/previewyoutube]
Enjoy the Views

During Recon Mission 2021, the focus was mainly on the gameplay of Outpost. However, over this last year, our art team has done their best to scale up the appearance of the map and give it more character. Thanks to all of the new special details, we were able to give Outpost a look that fits more closely with its approximate location in Central Europe (with maybe a slight turn to the East). Check out the map’s vistas below.

[/expand]
Play in Various Ways

Outpost is a summer map with lots of open space. It has multiple gameplay zones, allowing every vehicle type to shine and every tactical approach to be tried out. Each zone has its own unique landscape and special objects so you always know where you are on the map. The main landmark is the castle on a hill, which dominates the entire location. 

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]                     {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3b0f06d9c883cca85416210a8df7cc585f024879.png                                                [/td]
[td]      [/td]
[td]I would suggest you play carefully and avoid doing risky rushes, as your teammates might not be ready to support such ventures on an unfamiliar map. Besides, it has a lot of open space where you can attract some unwanted attention of the enemy TDs. Start out defensive, secure the urban area with your heavies and make sure you are working as a team!

PeacefulSoldier, WoT Steam Community Manager
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Hear the Story

The Outpost soundtrack really highlights its location somewhere in “Central-to-Eastern” Europe. The theme is based on a traditional song called “Ederlezi” and it starts with solo vocals—in our vision, those of a young girl who holds an old music box and reminisces about her grandmother. The symphonic orchestra (especially the percussion section) and the folk choir spin this story into a powerful and moving tale.

Go check out everything this new map has to offer, Commanders!

notes.title: Check Out the Biggest Update of 2022!
notes.content:
Commanders! 

Update 1.18 for World of Tanks is here, and it is our biggest update of 2022. This update introduces brand-new Italian tank destroyers with a non-standard autoloader and a fresh Random Battles map called Outpost. We have also updated the vehicle performance of a number of tanks and improved a large pool of locations for Random Battles. But that's not all! Get ready for important matchmaking changes for light vehicles and SPGs, reworked visuals for destroyed vehicle tracks, and other cool features. Enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2d5c45fc9c0ef13b39258bec003afd20e213c706.jpg

New Branch: Here Come the Italian Tank Destroyers!

The Italian tank destroyers are ready to storm World of Tanks! This new branch will consist of six researchable vehicles, from Tier V to Tier X. All of these vehicles feature decent frontal armor and great gun depression angles, perfect for mid-range or close combat. Most importantly, the Tier VII–X vehicles are equipped with a rather unusual autoloader. These unpredictable warriors are sure to spice up your gameplay, so check them out below!

READ ARTICLE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/444343f07d18d4da8682a60a2637261ef5f20a4b.jpg

Massive Vehicle Rebalancing

We have updated the characteristics of a number of vehicles from different nations, tiers, and types, including two Tier X tanks: the Kranvagn and the AMX M4 mle. 54. We have also adjusted the battle characteristics of the Emil II, AMX 65 t, T29, M44, TVP VTU Koncept, CS-44, and many other vehicles. Depending on how these vehicles were performing against other vehicles in their tier, we have improved or reduced their effectiveness in battle.

LEARN MORE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/50441ea2ceb8d77c84e468b087814e2eddd29814.jpg

New Map: Outpost

A new map is making its debut in Random Battles. This is Outpost! Take a look at this picturesque summer map, which combines open green areas with city ruins and trenches, as well as an impressive fortress with an outpost of its own. This winning location of the first Season of Recon Mission boasts diverse visuals and exciting gameplay. Enjoy the views from this new location and explore its battle directions!

Map Balance Improvements

We are continuing to work on improving Random Battles maps and adjusting a total of 14 locations. The most extensive changes have been made to the following six maps: Berlin, Himmelsdorf, Pearl River, Murovanka, Redshire, and Glacier. In addition, we have made minor improvements to 8 other maps. Learn more about the gameplay changes in our dedicated article!

DETAILS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8a9fd7edbfdf8f8223150966424d4dd742872efb.jpg

Matchmaking Changes

To improve your battle experience, we have decided to introduce new rules for balancing light and wheeled tanks. The matchmaker will now be stricter when assigning light tanks to teams and will always try to ensure that both teams have an identical number of light tanks in each battle. There will also be a limit of 1 wheeled tank per team. To help enforce these changes, we are also introducing a limit of no more than one Tier VII–X light/wheeled tank in a Platoon.

There are also important changes regarding the number of SPGs per team. Now, the majority of battles will have between 0–2 SPGs on each team. With that, the matchmaker will keep the number of battles with 3 SPGs per team to an absolute minimum.

MORE INFO

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fbce0ff6f6d9d540a9bdcad2172a3b35aaef804a.jpg

Improved Visuals for Destroyed Vehicle Tracks

We have also improved the visuals for destroyed tracks on every vehicle in the game. Tracks will now interact with objects as an independent physics model. To get an idea of how this will work, just picture how the tracks of American Yoh tanks look when they get knocked down. This setting does affect the performance of your device, however, so it will only be enabled by default if your graphics quality is set to high or better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/20ec7f4f022c3a26c21339bbdf1acd77672b7705.jpg

Battle Pass Season IX Is Coming!

Commanders! Battle Pass Season IX is coming back soon with tons of useful Base Rewards and even more valuable Improved Rewards! As always, you will also receive Battle Pass Tokens for completing certain Progression Stages. You can exchange these Tokens for various items and rare vehicles in the Items for Tokens section of the in-game Store. notes.title: Veni, Vidi, Vici: Italian Tank Destroyers Are Coming!
notes.content:
We’re ready to add an entire Italian tank destroyer branch to the game, Commanders! 

This branch will consist of six researchable vehicles, from Tier V through Tier X. Starting from Tier VII, all new TDs will have strong frontal armor, excellent gun depression angles, and an autoloader with unusual implementation as a unique gameplay feature. Read on to find out more!

Italian Tank Destroyers: Well-Armored, Dangerous, and Unusual   

Researching the new branch of Italian tank destroyers starts from the Tier IV P26/40 medium tank. You will need approximately 12,650 XP to unlock the branch-opening vehicle, the Semovente M41. Almost all of these Italian TDs existed as design projects, and some of them even had physical prototypes. Thanks to surviving blueprints and archive materials, we've taken these forgotten concepts to the next level and recreated six historical in-game machines as they might have existed in real life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bfcd3f53af9c5d3428b32a53f83ddd39d243e451.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bf954146957a22d75cb1627f2b2f489a5de6cdb0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4555646e8a3695d62775dbf57a08c39e8dcf9bef.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4da5c03b3108943d1d9eb5892ccbe0fff2bb66d4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a02f1b19b53e11518ccbc316690192cd11f2bd26.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0a308a946cc925204750db23f242591f22018639.png

This new branch features decent frontal armor and excellent gun depression angles. You would probably expect these vehicles to be equipped with an autoreloading system, as well, like Italian medium or heavy tanks. But here’s the big surprise: High-tier Italian tank destroyers come with a magazine loading system that offers up a completely new playstyle! We’ll give you more information about this mechanic using a Tier X vehicle as an example. But let's first take a look at the lineup!

The Semovente M41 and the Semovente M43 Bassotto

The new branch kicks off with the Semovente M41, which is a Tier V transitional vehicle. It is equipped with a non-rotating cabin instead of a turret, as well as a 75 mm gun. With a 350 m view range and great concealment values, this vehicle is a born Tier V master of camouflage and offers exciting stealthy gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7fa9b6f56c473e86640ead291b6c03f0e9d737da.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/55c659d1dab3c03bed63f714e784198fdee449ae.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7f762d4cf03aea7e48064166ec0294b89807055d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0d31ebca1d1b6e6a826a964844639fe6d4bc9d67.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fcd93323a7a71be5c90869711603ee819fe60acb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/842d05a265f36ce846f604036103143b9b553df8.jpg
[/expand]
Sitting at Tier VI, the Semovente M43 Bassotto is somewhat of an improved version of the previous vehicle. It can brag about a more powerful 102 mm gun with good accuracy and penetration values. Alternatively, you can equip the 105 mm Tier VII gun with HE gameplay. The vehicle’s frontal armor is also more solid. Both vehicles are rather slow and rely on a stealthy playstyle using their great concealment values.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5f0fb088de407347fae619ebf6f04df9b800aa2d.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f7695979f824f28d781cde5071e2e337f44fb717.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/945dfb8454b3acbaa2f20f11a8b67a48eedced5d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/57d201b0bd66943d7ccf04a6856d756bd5e976f6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/df18970bf462c3cd300a5e7552e5abb51ecb42f8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b6d7ecb3bc08b78d89cb850b8e028e8742cdeb2.jpg
[/expand]
The SMV CC-56

The next Italian newcomer is the SMV CC-56, which is noticeably different from its predecessors. Starting with this TD, the branch begins to take on its main features, offering you an idea of what the gameplay of the high-tier vehicles will be.

The SMV CC-56 is equipped with a rotating turret but limited turret traverse angles (30 degrees to either side, 60 degrees in total). The turret and frontal armor are quite solid, so you can rely on them in close-range combat. However, what makes this vehicle so dangerous is its 105 mm gun that features an autoloader with a non-standard configuration (more on that below), as well as good depression and elevation angles (–10/+20 degrees).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/339aaba3da94c641e591e6c5ac4e069ad4894fca.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/652c3cec0918d34808f2faa0dd24e2da5d744c61.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/607275e224a3627db98610e13db2b3e9391a37a3.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b2f0e418afd48247e959b12b0a5ab3ad00cff287.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/20515b1ef82a87090d111cecac2ca0a3ef187c75.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/141ac637fa5c7e32cdf06c9b943353fc7343172d.jpg
[/expand]
The SMV CC-67

Now for the high-tier tanks! Let’s start with the menacing SMV CC-67, which embodies all the finest qualities of Italian tank destroyers. This vehicle also has a rotating turret, but its turret traverse angles is an impressive 70 degrees (35 degrees to either side).

The vehicle’s other characteristics are also evolving. The frontal hull and turret armor is even stronger, and the vehicle’s mobility is increasing, as well. The Tier VIII vehicle has a higher top speed, reverse speed, engine power, power-to-weight, and even traverse values. Although the SMV CC-67 can move from one flank to another, it will take you some time, so you’ll need to choose the right direction in battle. Its 120 mm gun with an autoloader and –10 degrees of gun depression make it easier to go hull-down, take a shot, and withdraw into cover for a few seconds so that enemies can’t hit your weak spots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b3e7680e4153990ea01157d3a7b2b46ee6f57bf4.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/31efc1f795ce3306fb318c86899348cf156c209a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/38b45669da70bfbece74766ebaabb1bcb15ee7e7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bd6329e58387558c3cec5ee306a657b459269de6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/795dec66f293374c7c31dafa62861478267b8676.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ae39fc5d6ec4bc13700f4af71b38a5dd2420f298.jpg
[/expand]
The Controcarro 1 Mk. 2

All of the above-mentioned gameplay features continue to evolve, making the Controcarro 1 Mk. 2 an incredibly dangerous opponent in close- and mid-range combat. The vehicle’s partial turret traverse and average mobility are counterbalanced by its excellent frontal armor and good gun handling. Its menacing and high-DPM 127 mm gun boasts 80 degrees of turret traverse angles (40 degrees to either side) and an autoloader that causes 490 HP of alpha damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d66f9610296320d400795f331f6ff1eaeed6a7f0.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c314991c930451f7982fedac0d1db513a0415d42.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b180891d78c94b4651639e70d759c1edb9bffd80.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9782f70ba15f79f8c589984876978871f40317bd.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4e8f78d91aecc2c14a248a062d510b934357515c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bb0b57ebe76fada159540db476097510abf5ce7d.jpg
[/expand]
The Controcarro 3 Minotauro

As the crown jewel of the new line, this Italian minotaur has key battle parameters similar to those of other high-tier TDs, but this is where they reach their maximum. Like its brothers-in-arms, this vehicle has excellent frontal hull armor and few weak spots, meaning that it can easily repel enemy shells and save your precious HP in a one-on-one duel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/457c6a66d9fea6741f97cb7ae120747c28f74d2e.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cf24a2e108c14959277105dd31b6fdfcd4d4df60.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7a8d1ae6467b2e5fe3c6e03033c66a2c9cc9bfbe.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3d8ae926f213f74a152fb4888301ad48440deb64.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3fc6c6822c4c2a83001c87960b222d12f6ee0cbd.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c8c6bed2d3c536b468918bbc7ae299070a08c440.jpg
[/expand]
The rotating turret tops out at 90 degrees of total turret traverse angles, with 45 degrees to either side! The gun depression angles of –10 degrees are also good. The accuracy of the 130 mm gun is not too impressive, but its aiming time is very decent for this caliber, especially compared to other heavy tanks and tank destroyers with comparable guns. The penetration values are also more similar to those of heavy tanks rather than tank destroyers. This does not make firing from a long distance very comfortable, so the Minotauro will feel right at home on the front line as a powerful breakthrough vehicle. With its respectable 530 HP of alpha damage, it will perform brilliantly in both frontal assaults and positional hull-down duels, assisting heavies and putting pressure on the enemy in close combat.

The vehicle’s top speed of 30 km/h and its acceleration remain competitive compared to heavy tanks. It can confidently follow other allies to support them on the flanks.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f0ee1a1173e934d161e6ca16652fd91a82cc9de2.png

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/57d5ed1589cf80b3731e0ff8a592c14a47dc07ea.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8b4dddb8096c0415a0b25aac778be4da64ccd585.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/657da52d0abb3192c6acb2d9384898c3eff5b0f3.png
[/expand]
And now, meet the branch’s real superpower: its unique autoloader!

Not Your Classic Autoloader: How It Works

Unlike high-tier medium and heavy Italian tanks, Tier VII–X tank destroyers are equipped with a drum-type autoloader. However, this is not the classic autoloader that you might play on some popular French vehicles. Let's see how it works using the Controcarro 3 Minotauro as an example.

The autoloader has five shells with 530 HP of alpha damage. The full reload time is 24 seconds, and between shots—surprise! — a whopping eight seconds! This may seem strange on paper, but in practice, an autoloader with these unique parameters is perfect for trying out new tactics and keeping your opponents on their toes.

Always remember that you should treat this vehicle like a standard tank with a normal cyclic gun. Its alpha damage is equal to that of alpha heavies, but with a reload time of eight seconds, it’s faster than many brawlers, such as the IS-7 or the 60TP Lewandowskiego. This means that you can jump into a 1v1 duel and come out victorious, thanks to your huge in-clip DPM—up to 2650 HP!—and excellent frontal armor. One drum is enough to outshoot most of your opponents, even those with large HP pools.

Of course, you will have to pay for all of those shots with a reload that takes 24 seconds. Consider it a kind of delayed penalty for unleashing your devastating in-clip DPM. On the other hand, 24 seconds isn’t that bad. After all, the cooldown won’t take you out of the game for a very long time. Also, don’t forget that you have excellent frontal armor. While reloading, try to face your opponents frontally while hiding your lower plate so they have a harder time punishing you.

If you have a few shells left and the combat situation is favorable (meaning you can potentially do more damage), simply skip your drum to fully reload it. In just 24 seconds, you will have five shells with nice alpha at your disposal. Your rate of fire will probably be higher than that of your opponents, and they won't even know how many shots you have left! Whether or not to reload your full clip will be an easier decision in this vehicle than it would be in other autoloaders, so you will be perfectly capable of quickly adapting as the battle progresses.

This autoloader concept makes the Controcarro 3 Minotauro a unique and versatile vehicle that is sure to challenge its commander. You’ll need to get used to the Minotauro’s temper, but if you succeed, you will have a real king of the hill on any map.

If you are ready to take on this challenge, go ahead! It all depends on you!

notes.title: Transfer Opportunities for Players from CIS to the EU Realm
notes.content:
Dear players! 

On April 4, we announced that Wargaming projects including World of Tanks, will be operated by Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus. This was the first step, followed by months of hard work. The result is the complete structural and financial division of the two companies. Today, World of Tanks and other products are operated by two independent companies: by Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus, and by Wargaming in all other countries.  

The next big step is to launch a special CIS → EU transfer campaign for CIS players who wish to stay with Wargaming and continue playing on Steam. 

Transfer is a crucial activity where every player from CIS realm will need to decide on how to continue playing the game. Below you can find the key points about this procedure: 
[olist]
 In September, CIS servers will be turned off for Steam players. Additionally, new players from Russia and Belarus will not be able to register a new World of Tanks account via Steam. 
 New CIS players from outside Russia and Belarus will still be able to install World of Tanks in Steam and create an account. Such players will be automatically redirected to EU region during registration. 
 If you already have an account on CIS region, you will have an opportunity to transfer your CIS account to EU region and continue playing on Steam. 
 If you don’t want to transfer your account to EU region, unfortunately, you will not be able to continue playing on Steam. 
[/olist]Providing high quality service and ensuring the comfort of our players will always remain our priority. We will keep your account progress and all applicable terms and conditions, including pricing principles, as well as the core set of services you are used to, no matter where you continue playing. 

We understand that this is a big and serious decision for our players, and we will do our best to make it a smooth and easy experience for everyone.  

Additional Questions 

[expand type=details]
[olist]
 Q: Do I need to perform any actions now? 
A: If you wish to transfer your account, make sure that you have completed your registration by adding an email and a password. Other than that, you do not have to do anything now, this is just an announcement to make sure you stay up to date with our latest plans. We will make an additional publication when the transfer is ready with all details about the procedure. 

 Q: How long will the transfer option be available?  
A: The transfer campaign doesn’t have any planned end date. We want to make sure that all our players get a chance to move to EU region, including those who decided to take a break from the game at the moment. If this changes sometime in the future, we will let you know in advance. 

 Q: Will my progress, stats, purchases and resources be transferred as well? 
A: Yes, of course. Your progress, stats, purchases, resources etc. will be transferred to a new account on EU region with only a couple of exceptions. We will give you all the details closer to the transfer start. 

 Q: I play from Belarus or Russia and I want to transfer my account to EU region. Will I be able to make purchases in the game after the transfer? 
A: You will not be able to pay directly to Wargaming. In order to know if you are able to make purchases directly to Steam please look at the payment methods that are available in your country on Steam or contact Steam Support. 

 Q: Will the prices in the in-game Store become higher after the transfer? 
A: For the transferred players, the pricing principles on EU region will remain at the same level with CIS region. 

 Q: Will my ping become worse after the transfer?  
A: This is a very specific question which depends on a variety of factors, mainly on your service provider and your location. In some cases it might become lower, in other cases it might become higher.  
 
To ensure a comfortable gaming experience for transferred players we will add two new servers to the EU realm: EU 3 and EU 4.  
EU 3 will be in Luxembourg and is recommended for players located in Ukraine and Western Europe. The ping values on EU3 will be similar to the current RU3 server. 
EU 4 will be in Kazakhstan and is recommended for players located in Central Asia. The ping values on EU4 will be similar to the current RU10 server. 

 Q: Can I transfer my EU, NA, ASIA account to another server during this transfer campaign? 
A: No, this transfer campaign will be aimed specifically at CIS-region players. Other regions remain without any changes.  

 Q: What if I don’t want to transfer my account to EU region? 
A: Unfortunately, in that case you will not be able to play World of Tanks via Steam on your CIS-region account.  

 Q: Will you add Russian, Ukrainian etc. localizations in the game for the EU server? 
A: We will add Russian, Ukrainian and Kazakh localizations to the EU game client.  
[/olist][/expand]
We understand that you might have more questions about the transfer procedure. We will share the full transfer conditions and technical details for Steam players closer to the transfer launch which is currently planned for the middle of September. Stay tuned!

notes.title: New Launch of Frontline 2022: Back for 9 Days!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Once again, the time has come for massive battles on giant maps, featuring respawns, artillery strikes, smoke screens, and a good dose of strategizing. Of course, we’re talking about the upcoming second launch of Frontline 2022. We have extended the mode from August 20 through 29 meaning it will be available for nine days instead of the usual seven. Let’s see what's in store this time around!

Frontline 2022: Second Launch
EU: August 20, 2022, at 06:00 CEST through August 29, 2022, at 03:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: August 20, 2022, at 04:00 PT | 06:00 CT | 07:00 ET through August 29, 2022, at at 01:00 PT | 03:00 CT | 04:00 ET
ASIA: August 20, 2022, at 07:00 UTC+8 through August 29, 2022, at 04:00 UTC+8

Single-Tier Battles

Last time, a lot of players enjoyed playing Frontline exclusively in Tier VIII vehicles. In this second launch, we are keeping the good old formula of single-tiered battles, so get your favorite Tier VIIIs ready! If you do not have one of your own, try a rental Tier VIII vehicle. You can even get your hands on the Tiger II FL and M41 Bulldog FL, now available for rent.

More Rewards, Including Unique Ones

After the first launch of Frontline 2022, we realized that we should up the rewards for the epic 30v30 battles on extra-large maps. We’ve reworked the Frontline rewards, tied them to the mode progression, increased their number, and even added some unique ones.

 The progression itself now consists of 20 Stages (instead of 15). Upon reaching every Stage, you will earn valuable goodies.
 You can earn bonds (up to 975 in total) for completing certain progression Stages.
 When receiving directives as a reward, you will be able to choose your favorite type from an expanded list that now includes Pre-Battle Maintenance, Optical Calibration, and Aim Tuning.
 A Training Manual (the Crew Book providing 250K Crew XP) has been added to the reward pool.
 Retraining Orders are a new in-game item that can only be obtained as a Frontline mode reward. Use yours to change the skills and/or perks of a crew without a penalty.
Quick Combat Reserves

For the second launch of Frontline 2022, we have decided to make Combat Reserves easier to use. We are curious to try this out and see how it affects the gameplay!

 Once the battle starts, the time before you can use a Combat Reserve has been halved.
 Combat Reserves can be used immediately after you respawn (the minimum time before the respawn is 5 seconds).
 Combat Reserves can be used immediately after you unlock them for reaching a new rank.
We are excited for your feedback on quick Combat Reserves!

Revised Rental Vehicle Roster

As usual, rental vehicles will be available for the duration of Frontline (which is now 9 days) and they can only be used in this mode. These vehicles are all “clones” of their respective researchable Tier VIII counterparts and come with the best modules installed. Crews from vehicles of the same nation and type can be transferred on and off them for free and without penalty.

 Tiger II FL  
 T-44 FL  
 AMX AC mle. 48 FL  
 M41 Walker Bulldog FL  
At the beginning of the mode launch, you will be able to obtain Frontline rental vehicles for 250,000 credits each in the Frontline section of the in-game Store. This price will go down as the event progresses.

notes.title: [FINISHED] The Auction has ended
notes.content:
Commanders!

There has been a lot going on in the game lately, including Battle Pass Season VIII approaching its timely end. But now, we have one more event to add to your calendar. Do not miss out on the upcoming auction! From August 18 through August 21, prepare to bid on rare vehicles, exquisite styles, and an exclusive Warhammer 40,000-themed offer. So, get your credits, gold, and Free XP ready!

The Auction
EU: August 18 11:00 CEST through August 21 23:59 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: August 18 06:00 PT | 08:00 CT | 09:00 ET through August 21 13:59 PT | 15:59 CT | 16:59 ET
ASIA: August 18 10:00 UTC+8 through August 21 23:00 UTC+8

[previewyoutube=aLqpDPOWd7w;full][/previewyoutube]

Auction Lots

Each day of the auction, a new lot will appear at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2). On certain days, you will even have the chance to bid on two separate lots. Most of the lots will be entirely new offers, but there also will be a few familiar ones that are sure to be in high demand. And, of course, stay tuned for the Warhammer 40,000 lot, as you can never have enough Warhammer 40,000-inspired stuff!

Accessing the Auction

There are two ways to enter the auction: via the banner in the lower-right corner of your Garage screen or the special page in the in-game Store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f33399c353cf3b4c8310e7eb1b3c37b9c261351e.jpg

Auction Mechanics

[expand type=details]
1. Once you’re on the auction screen, you can bid what you’re willing to pay for the lot. This amount will automatically be deducted from your account.

[quote=]Please remember: If the cost of a lot is specified in gold, the use of credits or Free XP will not be possible, and vice versa.
2. If you decide to change or cancel your bid, you are free to do so until the lot is active. After that time, bids cannot be modified or canceled, and no new bids will be accepted. If you cancel a bid, the spent amount of gold, credits, or Free XP will be returned to your account. Bids will be returned, and lots will be credited to the auction winners within four hours after the deadline for accepting bids.

3. The number of winning players will depend on the number of items available. If multiple players make the lowest winning bid and there are more of these players than items to be distributed, the players who made the bids earliest will be awarded the item.

EXAMPLE
If 500 auction participants made identical lowest winning bids and there are only 400 items to be distributed, the 400 earliest bids will win.

4. Every lot will be sold at either a closed or open auction. If the auction is a closed one, players will know the lot’s contents, the number of available items, the minimum bid, and the deadline for accepting new bids. If the auction is an open one, players will also know the number of bids that have already been made. Once the number of bids exceeds the number of available items in an open auction, players will also be able to see the competitive (median) bid.

5. The winners receive their goods. The remaining auction participants receive their bids back in full.

6. Items won in the auction are non-refundable.
[/expand]
Place your bids and win, Commanders!

notes.title: Stream Drops Week is Back!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Stream Drops Week is returning, giving you another opportunity to earn some days of WoT Premium Account! If you regularly follow World of Tanks streams on Steam, this is your chance to earn an extra reward for your dedication. If you have never watched them before, well, this is the perfect time to start! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/90c96d31922865076dcfa11eb04bf151e6463402.png

Stream Drops Week
From August 16, 2022, through August 21, 2022

How Does it Work?

During the Steam Drops Week, players will have the chance to earn rewards for watching World of Tanks streams on Steam.

Every day, a certain number of special bonus codes will be shared in the stream chat by our Community managers. During the stream, a code might appear in the chat. The quickest viewer to grab and activate it will receive a useful reward! Watch out for these codes in the chat, but if you miss one, don’t worry—just keep watching the stream and eventually another one will pop up!

[quote=]NOTE: During the Stream Drops Week, you can activate up to three different bonus codes on one account.
We recommend revisiting the stream frequently during the event, as it will give you more opportunities to grab a Bonus code. 

What Can I Get?

All bonus codes will contain the same reward: 1 day of WoT Premium Account. 

                                                                  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ef00b84c00166dd3d38f2ac0400b3ab1ec106d44.png

If you try to activate a code and get an error message, that means someone was quicker than you and the bonus code is no longer active. Keep up the hunt!

Watch our streams, enjoy World of Tanks content, and grab some goodies for your account!

Good luck!

notes.title: Add Your Email and Enjoy All Possibilities of World of Tanks!
notes.content:
Commanders!

The registration process on Steam is easy—download the game, click “Play,” choose the nickname you’d like for your account, and you’re ready to roll out! However, after this process, your new account is not fully integrated into our WG ID system yet and has a few limitations. 

To remove them, you can complete the registration by adding an email address and a password to your account. At first, this step might seem insignificant and not worth the effort (even though there hardly is any effort at all!). But, in fact, completing your account registration can add a lot to your regular game experience. 

Let’s find out all the details together in this article!

More Opportunities

Adding an email and a password to your account gives you a range of additional benefits to enjoy:

1. Activate Invite and Bonus codes 

Invite codes are a great way to boost your progress when you’ve just created an account: You can activate an invite code during the first seven days after account creation, which will give you a bunch of goodies that can be quite useful early in the game. For example, our current active invite code GOWOTSTEAM rewards you with 7 days of WoT Premium Account, a Tier III Premium tank with a trained crew, two Garage slots, 400,000 credits, and two rental Tier VI and VII Premium tanks for 10 battles. Go ahead and activate it now if you are just starting your journey in the game!

Bonus codes provide different rewards and can be activated on the player’s account at any time, and they also vary in their validity periods and activation requirements. One bonus code can be activated only once per account, but you can activate multiple different bonus codes on the same account!

After completing your account registration, you can activate them directly in the Wargaming Game Center Steam. And we have prepared a special bonus code STEAMPREM for you to test out: Activate it and get 1 day of WoT Premium Account! 
[olist]
 Go to Wargaming Game Center Steam.   
 Click on your nickname in the upper left corner and choose “ACTIVATE WARGAMING CODE.” 
 Type in the code STEAMPREM and click “Activate.”
 Log in to the game and enjoy your rewards!
[/olist]2. Take part in Tournaments

Tournaments represent the competitive side of World of Tanks and are a great source of fun, excitement, and valuable rewards. 

Adding your email lets you participate in tournaments, boost your skill by going against other determined players like yourself, and, of course, win gold or other great rewards by taking the prize places! 

3. Participate in the Referral Program

Invite your friends to become your Recruits, play together, and earn heaps of rewards, ranging from bonds and customization to Premium vehicles! 

Alternatively, you can find a more experienced Commander to guide you on your Tanker path and become a Recruit yourself. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/720f8b573ccae1ec72695497ff51c26df0a18cb2.jpg

4. Access the Game Portal and Forum

Keep your account management easy and straightforward by logging in to your Personal Profile with your email and password. Changing the password, adding a phone number or a two-factor verification for extra security, managing your subscriptions, and other important functions will be easily accessible from your Profile. 

Also, after adding your email, you can use our Forum to discuss important topics or find a team for a tournament. 

5. Log in on the Clan Portal and compete on the Global Map

Join a group of fellow tankers as passionate about the game as you are. Explore new tactics and strategies with your clanmates and master your skills in training rooms, or land on the Global Map to challenge other clans and battle together for fame, valuable in-game resources, exclusive tanks, and unique medals!    

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f26918ff20d8399e963b695823ea1a1597c30d98.jpg

6. Get a bunch of goodies for binding your email!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/418baa272df15dee750452435f15b8889395e0fa.png

And keep in mind that bonus codes pop up quite frequently in various community activities and events, so complete the account registration if you don’t want to miss out on any of the free stuff! 

A Few Steps and You’re Ready for the Fun!

So, how does one complete the registration? It is extremely easy: All you need is an email that is not used for any other Wargaming account on the same server and a few seconds of your time.

[/olist]As you see, we didn’t exaggerate at the beginning of the article when we said that there was hardly any effort involved. On the contrary, the process is quick and easy, and it only results in you getting extra goodies as well as access to many additional benefits. So, what are you waiting for?

Enjoy the game to its fullest and have fun!

notes.title: Tame the Object 780
notes.content:
Commanders!

Let’s take a closer look at this top-tier addition and discover its strengths and weaknesses.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/aea4bb00769a9b6ef416ec4c965ed29ff7d75c7d.png

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f5ff38c48e757d2f37d8a226ad6c212fa34999aa.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/26a9c76024e4caa24abb474cc504fe73fb8be22e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/74f8949d2c422ecceb3dac610a3cdacc157785c0.png
[/expand]
Firepower

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a1747643fe91454c18a027cedf994909651eff13.jpg

The Object 780 is a maneuverable assault heavy tank with a powerful 130 mm cannon. It has remarkable gun handling stats for a heavy tank, including 530 HP alpha damage, an aiming time of 1.9 s, 0.35 m dispersion at 100m, and over 2,200 DPM. Combined with decent gun depression and elevation angles—especially for a Soviet tank—the Object 780 is a threat from almost any distance.

Survivability

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fdd18319da44781b34d563bd54c191386e766fff.jpg

300 mm thick turret armor, small lower and upper glacis plates, and well-sloped frontal armor make it hard for opponents to crack the Object 780 head-on. Take advantage of terrain irregularities and safely fire from cover, or team up with reliable allies and hold the front line. But keep in mind that the HP pool is not very impressive, and the rate of fire is not the highest, so don’t get into duels unless you're sure you can come out victorious.

Mobility

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5fea15ab7d3059594cf4118d558dcf00de8045b0.jpg

The Object 780 has an excellent power-to-weight ratio, accelerates quickly, and can maintain its top speed. However, with a top speed of 45 km/h, it won't win many cross-map races, so it's better to choose one direction at the start, hold a flank, and shield your allies from light and medium tanks.

Destructibility

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7da74e07926191953b34bd75c64cf1eb9f18be34.jpg

While the Object 780 seems like an intimidating beast, it's not without its weaknesses. Whether you're at the helm of the Soviet heavy tank or have to face it on the field, it's good to be aware of its shortcomings.

The tank is very compact, so the internal modules are located close to one another. This makes it easy to receive critical damage. Consider spending one equipment slot on Modified Configuration.

The underplate is a good way to punish an Object 780 commander that peeks too far over a ridgeline. Hit the fuel tank located near the front of the tank, and you might even set it on fire. Conversely, if you're looking down at an Object 780, aim for the cupola to score a penetrating shot. Try to approach enemies from the front and on relatively even terrain.

Equipment

Check out the setup below to ensure the maximum performance of your tank.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b2edac20be4339cd319dec82aa4a4dc77316524a.png

Try the brawler setup with Improved Hardening, Vertical Stabilizer, and Gun Rammer if you prefer a more hands-on playstyle. The boost to the HP pool will be more than welcome in close enemy encounters.

The alternative setup uses Improved Ventilation, Gun Turbocharger, and Modified Configuration to boost the strength of the vehicle. Combined with Field Modification, you can increase the DPM, reduce the aiming time, and improve gun accuracy to make the Object 780 an even better support heavy tank.

Crew Skills

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/84664b2cbf47523dc1cca92440f07a1df9025fc1.png

The three-person crew layout means that the commander and gunner have to double as the radio operator and loader. But despite the atypical configuration, the first skills remain fairly standard with Sixth Sense, Brothers in Arms, and Repair. Use the fourth skill to boost the vehicle’s strength and balance out some of its shortcomings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/788c5c5541ecc5d88e120cb483ddbb1d98d22abd.jpg

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e369c247cc8b84a1bb6732c3b41b81589c04036e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/754b73d5c1fdf8ab215671c00c1d15d0447c7128.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e4bde622e4af7e798dcbe8858212a4b4a24e7628.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/dc1fdc981ef7e73866b203be8c4605cfda25257b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/181fc450c76c31410355ad37443cd4bf8ea59fff.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fe2a804d78a7a3a5adf4dd747fec46685e503517.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/237a6c06a84536b49d55ab3fc3bd42559c2b48b8.jpg

notes.title: The Survivors: Block, Bounce, Survive, and Win!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Are you capable of destroying several enemy tanks and surviving the battle, negating the opponents’ shots with your mighty armor? Find out the answer to this question during our special event “The Survivors” that launches today as a part of Steam Survival Sale! You will complete missions that are focused on two simple things: help your team win and survive the battle yourself. Remember: survival is crucial, so think wisely, but keep in mind that you need to show a nice performance in the battle as well, so hiding behind your allies is not a good option. 

Speaking of hiding, there is a famous tank in the game that you can probably hide half of your team behind. Of course, we are talking about the one and only TOG II*! During the event, this outstanding feat of British engineering will be available in the in-game Store for 7 days of rental for free! Long, slow, and bulky, but with a great gun and lots of HP, the TOG II* is a unique tank in many ways, and now you have a chance to try it out!

Apart from the missions with valuable rewards and the TOG II* for a free rental, this event introduces several packages with rental Premium tanks in the in-game Store at bargain prices as well as an option to get a guaranteed reward in the Survival Giveaway and a TOG II* screenshot competition. That seems like a lot of fun stuff to get into, doesn’t it? Well, let’s check out the details!

The Survivors
July 18, 2022, through August 7, 2022

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e615675a1db1cb3747a35560b1f464ef37f76cb7.png

Complete the Survival Missions!

During this event, players will receive three different sets of missions: one per each week of the event. You will have exactly one week to complete the weekly missions and get the rewards. Once the week is over, another set of missions will become available and any unfinished ones from the previous set will expire. During the week, missions are completed one by one, which means that you need to finish the first weekly mission to move on to the second one.

To find them in the game, go to the “MISSIONS” tab in your Garage and scroll down to the section named “The Survivors”. There you will find this week’s missions, your progress and the rewards for completion. 

The missions are designed to encourage players to be efficient and helpful to their team, all while keeping your vehicle functional until the very end of the battle. To put it simply, you need to win and survive! 

The rewards for missions include personal reserves, credits, directives and days of WoT Premium Account: definitely worth the effort!

Check out the additional information below to learn more about the first week’s missions, and watch out for more articles in which we’ll cover the second and the third week of the event.

Conditions:

 Win a battle

 Once per account

Restrictions:

 Only in Tier VI–X vehicles
 Only in Random Battles and Grand Battles

 1 day of WoT Premium Account
 200,000 credits
[/expand]
Take the Legendary TOG II* for a 7-Day Drive!

The TOG II* is very famous in the World of Tanks community for being a bizarre and unusual vehicle. The jokes about this monstrous project of British engineers will never go out of fashion, but the tank itself is no joke! Giant and slow it may be, but its gun is accurate and fast-firing, and it has the largest HP pool among its tier! Overall, the experience of roaming the battlefield on this colossal vehicle is hard to describe: one should try it out for themselves! 

And you have such an opportunity, as during “The Survivors” event the TOG II* will be available for 7 days of rental in the in-game Store for free! Grab it and see if you can survive being the longest tank on the battlefield!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8423ad544ea47c7a96c45db743227696466ed162.jpg

If you really enjoy your experience in the TOG II*, you can buy it out. By completing a simple mission in that tank, you can earn a 30% discount on your purchase! 

[quote=]Obtain the discount by completing a special vehicle mission that you receive together with the tank:
Personal Mission: Crucial Contribution
Conditions:

 Play 20 battles
 Be among the top 10 on your team by base XP earned in each battle
Restrictions:

 Only in the TOG II*
 Only in Random Battles
 Once per account
Rewards:

30% discount on the TOG II* package

Get a Rental Tank at a Good Price and Earn a Huge Discount on Your Purchase! 

Apart from the TOG II*, there will be three other Premiums in the in-game Store that you can take for 7 days of rental for a nice price: the IS-6, the T26E4 SuperPershing, and Kanonenjagdpanzer 105.

[quote=]NOTE: Packages are available only for players that don’t have these vehicles in the Garage.
You can get one or several of them to complete the event missions, or just to try out a new vehicle for a week. Similar to the TOG II*, you get one extra mission with each tank, that lets you accumulate a huge discount of even more than 30% to buy the vehicle out if you really like it!

Take Part in the Survival Giveaway!

Do you want to get some extra rewards? And what about reading various tips and getting advice from fellow players? Actually, let’s do both at the same time! 

Head on to our Survival Giveaway, complete a few simple steps that include leaving your advice for the other players in the comments, and get a guaranteed reward! 

Show Your Best TOG II* Battles in our Screenshot Competition!

The TOG II* is probably the best tank ever made. Well, maybe not, but we just really like it for being the fun machine it is. So, we want to see if you like it as well! 

If you are having a great time playing in the TOG II* and want to share your success with us, upload a screenshot of your post-battle stats in a TOG II*, with at least 600 base XP, and receive a guaranteed reward!

To participate, you need to follow these simple steps:
[olist]
Play in the TOG II* and earn at least 600 base XP in the battle to participate.
 Take two screenshots of the post-battle stats on the “Personal Score” and “Team Score” tabs.
 Make sure that your nickname is visible on the screenshots.
 Upload your screenshots to our Steam Community Hub. 
 Please don’t upload other people’s screenshots. We will verify that the nickname on the screenshots matches your Steam WoT account name.
[/olist]
If you do all of the steps correctly, you will receive a guaranteed reward of 1 day of WoT Premium Account! We will also select the three best TOG II* players, and they will get an entire week of WoT Premium Account. So, grab the rental TOG II* from the in-game Store for free and show us how its done!

[quote=]NOTE: If you already have the TOG II* on your account, you can participate as well!
[quote=]NOTE: We will send the goodies to the World of Tanks account associated with your Steam account.
Enjoy the event!

As usual, this is the most important point. After all, our first and main goal will always remain to make sure that our players stay entertained and have lots of opportunities to have fun in the game. Complete missions, earn rewards, roll out on the battlefield in the gigantic TOG II* and enjoy your time in World of Tanks!

Let everybody see how tough you are!

[hr][/hr]
We would love to hear your feedback about the event in the comments under this post. Or just go ahead and tell us some funny stories about TOG II*!

notes.title: Arcade Cabinet: Try Out an Experimental Mode With Unusual Rules!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Let's imagine for a moment that the battle characteristics of every vehicle in the game were changed beyond recognition. Now, we’re not just talking about Field Modification with some 3–5% fluctuation up or down—we’re talking about a truly impressive transformation!

For example, what if we doubled the Leopard 1's aiming speed? Or suddenly increased the proximity spotting distance of all vehicles in battle to 445 meters? What would it be like to play with a damage spread of +/–75% of the standard value?

Sound crazy? We know! This is your opportunity to try out something unusual and extraordinary—something that’s never been seen before in regular Random Battles.

Get ready to experience the classic game mechanics from a different perspective with no risk, no pressure, and no strings attached! Starting July 15, we’re launching Arcade Cabinet, a new experimental platform. Battles will take place according to the standard rules but with unusual battle modifiers that change the classic technical characteristics. There will be a total of three launches taking place over the course of several weeks, each with its own unique theme and gameplay.

Read on to find out more!

[previewyoutube=knBcPWPchI4;full][/previewyoutube]
How to Find Arcade Cabinet

In the Garage, select the Arcade Cabinet mode from the menu to the right of the “Battle!” button. When hovering over the mode button, you’ll see the combat modifiers that will be applied in battle. Check them out and prepare to be surprised!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/92f854e81200f60d5d16d680bc750ae3d27cefb9.jpg

Launch One: Railgun

[quote=]EU: From July 15 at 06:00 CEST through July 17 at 05:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: From July 15 at 07:00 PT | 09:00 CT | 10:00 ET through July 17 at 21:59 PT | 23:59 CT | July 18 at 00:59 ET
ASIA: From July 15 at 13:00 (UTC+8) through July 18 at 04:00 (UTC+8)
The time has come to grab a railgun and show your opponents who's truly the boss as you battle it out in an exciting railgun match! The aiming time, gun dispersion, engine power, and other characteristics of your vehicles will be immediately improved by 50–100%. Even players who are new to the game may suddenly demonstrate impressive skills and Robin Hood-like accuracy!

Moreover, proximity spotting distance will increase to 445 meters. Your opponents will be in plain sight, meaning that all you’ll have to do is track them down and cause accurate damage from afar! This is your opportunity to feel like a sniper.

Battle Modifiers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fc8d91c2f1a74cd4ddb40def50f24f9ab264c891.png

Launch Two: Element of Surprise

[quote=]EU: From July 29 at 06:00 CEST through July 31 at 05:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: From July 29 at 07:00 PT | 09:00 CT | 10:00 ET through July 31 at 21:59 PT | 23:59 CT | August 1 at 00:59 ET
ASIA: From July 29 at 13:00 (UTC+8) through August 1 at 04:00 (UTC+8)
This is your chance to find out just how random our Random Battles can get and discover the power of the element of surprise! In this launch, expect plenty of jaw-dropping twists and turns. You may get lucky and destroy an IS-7 with Improved Hardening with a single shot, while someone else may cause pitifully low damage and crawl back to their Garage, hoping to be more fortunate next time. As World of Tanks players like to say, "Skill is skill, but RNG is RNG!"

[quote=]We will announce the exact combat modifiers for this mode shortly before its launch.
Launch Three: Tranquility

[quote=]EU: From August 12 at 06:00 CEST through August 14 at 05:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: From August 12 at 07:00 PT | 09:00 CT | 10:00 ET through August 14 at 21:59 PT | 23:59 CT | August 15 at 00:59 ET
ASIA: From August 12 at 13:00 (UTC+8) through August 15 at 04:00 (UTC+8)
Once again, a total change in combat modifiers means a total change in gameplay! In the third launch, you’ll immerse yourself in calm and peaceful tranquility. There’s no need to hurry, so take your time when loading shells, and treat non-penetrating shots as a worldly vanity. In a sense, this launch will feel like a return to “the good old WoT” of leisurely-paced gameplay and unhurried battles. Enjoy this little dash of nostalgia!

[quote=]We will share more detailed information about the modifiers for this mode before its launch.
Standard Rules for All Launches

All launches in Arcade Cabinet will be played according to the standard rules of Random Battles:

 Same-tier battles will be in the 15v15 format.* Only Tier VIII and X vehicles are allowed.
 Matchmaking is by vehicle type.
 Objective: Capture the base or destroy all enemy vehicles.
 Platoons are allowed.
 Battle results in this mode do not count towards your statistics. You have nothing to prove, so just play and enjoy!
 Credits and Combat XP earning rates, as well as the costs of repairs and consumables, are the same as in Random Battles.
 Bonds and Battle Pass Points cannot be earned in this mode.
 Combat missions for credits will be available in Tier X battles.
 The principles of fair play (EU, NA, ASIA) should be followed in all battles.

*Each of the Arcade Cabinet submodes will have separate queues for Tier VIII and X vehicles. If there is an insufficient number of players in the queue, the matchmaker may launch a battle with fewer participants.
Battles in the Arcade Cabinet submodes will be fought on the following maps:

Railgun

notes.title: 2022 Summer Plans: Update 1.17.1, Events, and Surprises!
notes.content:
Update 1.17.1 is coming your way, Commanders!

Frontline, our most epic game mode, is returning to World of Tanks with an updated progression and other balance adjustments. We'll be sharing a separate article with you in the coming months that will go into more detail about all the exciting changes we’ve made to your favorite mode, so stay tuned!

You can find the full Update 1.17.1 patch notes via this link:

FULL PATCHNOTES

A Feast of Great Events Awaits!

A host of great activities with exciting gameplay and cool rewards are yet to come, Commanders! Here's what awaits you this summer:

SUMMER GLOBAL MAP EVENT 
Iron Age, a new Global Map event, is coming to World of Tanks! Once again, the most powerful clans will lock horns to prove their superiority and earn a bunch of valuable rewards, including mighty Tier X vehicles. Get ready for heated battles, and may the strongest win!

The next iteration of our WoT7 tournament series will take place in August, featuring exciting matches with Tier X vehicles, magnificent tank commanders, and fantastic rewards. Gather your friends and compete against others, or sit back, relax, and follow the action during our livestream. 

FIRST MAN ON THE MOON (NA servers)
Come celebrate the first man on the moon! On July 15th, we will celebrate this historic moment with in-game missions and space-themed rewards.

Call your clanmates, because Clan Showdown is coming around in August! Take part in this exciting tournament and fight it out to earn gold, bonds, and special customizations. May the best clan win!

This August, World of Tanks will celebrate its 12th anniversary. And to get you in the festive mood, we've prepared an awesome celebration with a beach party, gifts, and exciting adventures! We invite all players, old and new, to come join us! 

FRONTLINE 
The second launch of Frontline 2022 will take place in August. All in all, this epic mode will keep its main principles from the first launch. However, to make things even more exciting, we've adjusted the progression system and changed some of the balance parameters. And most importantly, we've added more rewards, including new ones that you've never seen before! 

BATTLE PASS SEASON VIII 
Battle Pass Season VIII is here for the entire summer! As always, there's a whole bunch of valuable Base and Improved Rewards up for grabs, including unique Warhammer 40,000-themed 3D styles. Don't miss this opportunity to get your hands on them while you still can! 

UPDATE 1.18 
After a hot summer full of events, Update 1.18 will land in World of Tanks! This update will introduce some exciting new content, so stay tuned for more details!

notes.title: Recon Mission 2022: The Results
notes.content:
Commanders!

After two weeks of intense battles on six map candidates, the Recon Mission event is over. We appreciate your solid input into shaping the future of World of Tanks. Over 205,019 players in Europe tested out the proposed map prototypes, and 172,547 of them found time to complete the questionnaires. In total, more than 4,784,850 Recon Mission battles were played in Europe. And we’re happy to report that everything went smoothly: we received valuable feedback, gathered loads of battle statistics, and can now officially name the two most successful locations: Aquila and Anykeyyevka.

Anykeyyevka
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/29e316272c80afb16cc6a6fe00735deca1e56554.jpg

Aquila
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/18af03bcccc48fc56e1eb060cd698edd8162bfd1.jpg

During the event, players could test out six map candidates, three of which were modified prototypes from last year, while the other three were brand new. After playing at least six battles on a map, you could complete a detailed questionnaire, pointing out that map’s strengths and weaknesses.

Stay tuned for updates on the best maps from this event. We’ll share more news closer to their planned releases, including the finalized looks of these locations. We understand that you want to start playing on your new favorite maps ASAP. However, know that we want these locations to truly look their best and be well-balanced, so you can continue having fun on them for as long as possible. It takes a significant amount of time to bring a map to release quality, but we are working at top speed. In the meantime, we kindly ask for your patience and assure you it will be well rewarded. As a reminder, the first “graduate” of Recon Mission, the Outpost map, will enter Random Battles in September 2022 and the second, Oyster Bay, will arrive in early 2023.

Thank you once again for taking part in Recon Mission!

Learn more...

notes.title: The Challenge Generator: Are You Up to the Task?
notes.content:
[quote=]Report #21
Our group has discovered an unknown object in sector F33. The object is not marked on any of our maps. Moving in for initial inspection.
[quote=]Report #22 
Description: several concrete buildings of unknown purpose with an open area resembling a testing ground, all surrounded by a partially destroyed fence. The object looks like a military base, but our radars have not detected any signs of surrounding activity. Continuing inspection.
Commanders!

During a regular recon mission, one of our exploration squads came across a group of mysterious buildings that were not marked on our maps.

After a thorough inspection, it was concluded that the object was used as a secret military training base for tankers. According to archive documentation obtained during the examination of the area, the base was used for developing and testing a complex device called the Challenge Generator. 

This device was designed as part of a secret project for a new experimental training technique for tankers. Unfortunately, there is no information about the results of the experiment or the reason for abandoning the project. Still, our research group is determined to find out as much as possible about this mysterious device. During the next three weeks, we are launching a series of tests on this unusual machine, and we need your help!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d1d09c4fb1bf1961c07039ad2ca72def000cbc8c.png

The Challenge Generator
From June 20, 2022 at 06:00 UTC through July 11, 2022 at 06:00 UTC

Our scientists are doing their best to learn everything about the Challenge Generator, but the humongous device still holds a lot of mysteries. Nevertheless, we have managed to uncover a few important details!

Key Points 

 At the start of each week during the event, the Challenge Generator will randomly create one special challenge for you. To find it, go to “MISSIONS” tab in your Garage and scroll down to the “New Challenge” section. There you will be able to see the exact conditions and the rewards for completion. 
 You will have a week to complete the generated challenge – right until the next mission is generated for you. If you fail to finish the mission in time, it will disappear, and you will not receive the rewards.

 If you complete more than one weekly challenge during the event, you will receive extra rewards as a special thanks from our research team. Those who complete all three weekly challenges will earn the biggest prize!  Rewards
