notes.title: Return of the Waffenträger: Event Guide
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

From September 27 through October 11, World of Tanks will host the Return of the Waffenträger event. Battles will be fought in the 7-vs-1 format on a select of maps. The Harriers will face the extremely powerful Blitzträger auf E 110, the creation of the formidable Max von Krieger. Let’s dig into the details.

Event Dates
EU: September 27 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2) through October 11 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: September 27 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET through October 11 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET
SEA: September 27 at 17:00 (UTC+8) through October 11 at 17:00 (UTC+8)

Prime Times (First Event Day)
EU: from 14:00 CEST (UTC+2) to 00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: 06:00-23:00 PT | 08:00-01:00 CT | 09:00-02:00 ET
SEA: from 18:00 (UTC+8) to 00:00 (UTC+8)

Prime Times (All Other Event Days)
EU: from 12:00 CEST (UTC+2) to 00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: 11:00-23:00 PT | 13:00-01:00 CT | 14:00-02:00 ET 
SEA: from 14:00 (UTC+8) to 00:00 (UTC+8)

[previewyoutube=7CC33l-LDSE;full][/previewyoutube]
Return of the Waffenträger: Event Summary

 Battles take place in the 7v1 format on one of three lightly redesigned maps: Murovanka, Siegfried Line, and Steppes.

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6f035f1681a24274665b049ebf55431e8d5cd167.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fe6b3b82594bc3ed43c45c97c5558dcfd758aca6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8bd99a6f7c5b92edd7c3027ed7adeee5ffe927eb.png
[/expand] Before the battle starts, you can choose one of the sides in the conflict.

 The Harrier Squad (either a team of seven random players or a Platoon of up to three players—Dynamic Platoons are allowed) will rush into battle in extensively modified special vehicles: the Object 140, Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, and M48A5 Patton.
 The Engineer faces them in the Blitzträger auf E 110, an incredibly powerful tank destroyer manned by a single player. He will be flanked by AI-controlled guards called Sentinels, which will be the third type of vehicle you will spot in the mode.
 Each team has its own objective. The Harrier Squad must disable the Blitzträger auf E 110’s protective energy shield and destroy this menacing vehicle within the allotted time. The Blitzträger auf E 110 must eliminate the Harrier Squad or hold out until time expires.
 To enter the battle in the Blitzträger auf E 110, you need to have a Key. You can earn it in battles while playing the game mode or receive it as a part of special bundles in the in-game Store. Keep reading to find out about one more way to get one Key for the Blitzträger auf E 110! 
 The Return of the Waffenträger progression involves assembling the Harriers' Collection and the Engineer's Collection with different elements and consists of four Stages. Upon collecting a certain number of elements and reaching each Stage, you will receive valuable rewards. To fill the event progression meter and grab all rewards available in the event, you need to complete both Collections.
 The event’s main reward is the ASTRON Rex 105 mm, a brand-new Tier VIII Premium American medium tank, which can be obtained from the Vehicle Gate (more about this below) with a certain drop chance.
 You can also purchase it with the Engineer's Starters, special in-game keys you can earn during the event to activate the Engineer’s Gate which contains valuable loot. The Engineer's Starters will also be available as part of bundles in the in-game Store. 
 You can also use the Harriers' Starters to activate the Harriers’ Gate, which might drop useful in-game items—sometimes even the Engineer's Starters!
How to Start Playing

1. In your Garage, choose the “Return of the Waffenträger” mode in the drop-down menu to the right of the “Battle!” button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a1233435315f3139370c961ff7926341224fb05f.jpg

2. Click the event banner in the lower-right corner of the screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bb3d2f0eb1e687d90bdfa7903a16cb5fb75c1f5e.jpg

3. Click the interactive 3D portal in your Garage.

The Harriers

On September 27, you will find three special vehicles to choose from in the event Garage - the Resistor, Thunderbolt, and Foudre. Choose one of the tanks and click the “Battle!” button to take on von Krieger's empowered vehicle!

Each Harrier Squad's battle hounds features its own battle role and general and several combat abilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ad30b8bfc0eb09d1dfb5715fea5e9cfa28e580fe.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e8ba70cdecf68d5023282f6ad93b78b662876e15.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4cd555d1238e405d11406441b4907ddd2fc9b040.png

The Harriers have three Lives (including the starting one), which means they can respawn just twice in a single battle.

How to Play

When the battle starts, the Blitzträger auf E 110 will be protected by an almost impenetrable energy shield, so it doesn’t make sense to shoot at it while this shield is active. From time to time, AI-controlled vehicles called Sentinels will spawn at certain points on the battlefield to assist the Engineer. When destroyed, Sentinels leave a load of Plasma that you need to pick up and deliver to Generators, indestructible power structures that appear in different parts of the map, changing location each time. They also create a protective shield for the Engineer.

The Harriers collect and use Plasma to overload Generators, thereby disabling the Engineer's shield for some time. Overloading a Generator with the Harriers works just like capturing the base in Random Battles. The more tanks in the cap circle, the faster it happens.

[quote=]Generators have two states: active and inactive. When Generators spawn on the map, they are always inactive and have one common activation time. The Harriers can only overload a Generator when it becomes active.
When you first pick up a load of Plasma, a certain amount of HP is restored for the entire team. Plus, having Plasma on board your vehicles increases the damage caused to von Krieger, so try not to miss any loads.

Once the Blitzträger auf E 110 is temporarily left without its protective shield, you have some time to deal full damage to it—don't forget to use your unique combat abilities! After that, the shield will be restored, and you’ll need to overload and destroy the next Generator. The damage you cause through the shield is greatly reduced, but it increases with each destroyed Generator.

After overloading and destroying the fourth and last Generator, the shield on von Krieger's machine will be permanently disabled, so take this opportunity to finish it off. But if the timer runs out with the Blitzträger still operational, von Krieger will win, so push yourself to the limit in the final stage of the battle!

Keep in mind that the Blitzträger auf E 110 has a new ability: Teleportation. It allows the Engineer to teleport to a selected point on the map with some delay. But when the protective shield disappears, Teleportation becomes unavailable, and after the destruction of the fourth Generator, this ability is blocked.

To succeed, the Harriers’ battle hounds must work together and act as a close-knit team. Fight in packs of three or four vehicles, destroy the Sentinels assisting the Blitzträger auf E 110, collect Plasma, and pay attention to the timer. Coordinate your efforts, as the chances of a single Harrier vehicle defeating the Engineer are close to nonexistent!

The Harriers’ Mission

Completing the Harriers’ mission will reward you with Keys that allow you to play as the Blitzträger auf E 110. Some of them will also reward you with Harriers' Starters (more on them below).

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2994b7ec2d26931ef2e29d8b8efd2ea2db62cf60.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7d5704b16c303cfbf37d8ac3af4922e1c4b2bb41.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c8dc21bd0260742ae8514546aa1fa0438184a3a1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3adc0b61bc372b61dbbb14250b8178e22b074ea6.png
[/expand]
The Blitzträger auf E 110

To fight in the mighty and powerful Blitzträger auf E 110, you need a Key. There are four ways to get it:

1. Complete a special mission in Random Battles to earn one Key. The mission will be available on September 27 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2) and will remain active until October 4 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2). You need to win five Random Battles in Tier IV–X vehicles and be among the top 10 on your team by experience earned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cdf0e989974acf569f3d626a41eebeef2e6bf03d.png

2. You can also earn Keys by completing special Harriers’ missions in the event.

3. Keys will also be available as a part of bundles starting from September 27 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2) in the in-game Store during the event.

There will be no compensation for unused Keys when the event ends on October 11 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2).

The Blitzträger auf E 110 is a formidable tank destroyer with overwhelming firepower. Designed by Max von Krieger, this incredible feat of engineering is equipped with a gun with an autoloading mechanism. One penetrating shot can easily take away well over half of a Harrier vehicle’s entire HP pool. Plus, the Blitzträger auf E 110 features four additional (three active and one passive) combat abilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/71ce69b9e91b342a6dfe924d3f65c40042bd74ae.png

[expand type=details]

 Gungnir - A shot that causes considerable damage to enemy vehicles.
 EMP Arrow - A shot with a high-voltage charge that slows down and stuns enemies. Resets Generator Overload points of damaged vehicles.
 EMP Burst - A charge of energy that covers the entire area around the vehicle. Stuns all enemies in the impact area and causes damage to those closest. Passes through all obstacles and resets Generator Overload points of damaged vehicles.
 Teleportation - Allows the vehicle to teleport to a selected point on the map after some delay. Operating the vehicle is impossible during preparation. Cannot be used while the shield is deactivated.
 Absorption - By being near a clump of Plasma on the ground, the vehicle accelerates its evaporation. If, at the moment of evaporation of Plasma, the vehicle is within a 50 m radius of it, it will recover a certain number of hit points and accelerate the Teleportation cooldown.
[/expand]
AI-controlled Sentinels are autonomous guards that spawn across the map. Their role is to deal damage to the Harriers and act as spotters for the Blitzträger.

How to Play

Although the Blitzträger auf E 110 is incredibly powerful and your shield reflects most of the damage you take, always keep in mind that you will be facing seven dangerous Harriers at once. If, at the end of the battle, the opposing team remains at full strength, you’ll be in trouble.

Try to confuse enemies, pick off stragglers, and support your Sentinels—don't let opponents collect loads of Plasma that can disable the Generators. Make full use of your combat abilities, constantly move around the battlefield, and take advantage of the new Teleportation ability. Protect the Generators at all costs, because if the Harriers destroy all four of them, the shield will disappear permanently and you will become vulnerable.

[quote=]Time is on your side, so it’s not necessary to destroy all the Harriers to win. If they fail to destroy you within the allotted time, you will triumph!
The Engineer’s Mission

Completing the Engineer’s mission will earn you Engineer’s Starters and the Engineer’s Collection Items (more on them below), including the von Krieger crew member.

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3c339f11433d33e541f3d47d4f896497f1a95bd1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ae6610b8ae95102eb7951c9cffca32541a1096dc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d59a52aa3cefb1a23d5ad7ab337bbfedb3e9162f.png
[/expand]
Overtime Mechanics

The initial battle time is 6 minutes, but this can be increased to up to 15 minutes, thanks to the overtime mechanics, which can only trigger once per match. If at least one Harrier vehicle has a load of Plasma on board their vehicle, then the battle time will increase by the time remaining until it disappears (provided that the overtime mechanic has not yet been triggered).

If there are several loads of Plasma in the battle, then the load with the most time left will have its time added to the battle timer. The minimum amount of time that will be added to the battle timer when any of the Harrier vehicles is carrying Plasma is 30 seconds.

What happens if a Harrier vehicle with Plasma on board is within the Generator's capture radius?

 If overtime mechanics have not been triggered, then additional battle time will be added according to the rules above.
 If overtime mechanics have already been triggered, then the timer will remain at zero, but the battle will not end.
 If the Generator is captured, the battle will increase by the same amount of time as during a normal capture.
 If the player leaves the Generator's capture zone and the battle time expires, the Harrier Squad will lose and the match will end.
The Blitzträger auf E 220

If Lady Luck is on your side, you may encounter a special version of the Blitzträger in some battles: the E 220. This is a vehicle that only certain Wargaming employees and famous content creators can unlock. It features a unique camouflage pattern so you can easily identify it, should you meet it during the special Prime Times.

The Blitzträger auf E 220 has the same stats as the E 110. If you and your team manage to destroy the E 220, everyone on your team will receive a special medal and one Engineer’s Starter. Check out the dedicated article for additional information about the big E 220 hunt, including a list of participating content creators and prime hunting times!

The Medals

Achieve at least one victory over the Blitzträger auf E 110 or the Harrier Squad, and you will be decorated with the corresponding medal. There’s a third one, but getting it requires a bit of luck, as you need to defeat the Blitzträger auf E 220.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/33ed6e4cba813565a3631fbda17424830ac46279.png

Lightning Rod

Defeat the Blitzträger auf E 110
when fighting in the Harrier Squad.[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d5b8b8cfc0075cc6b7c79dc05d9e0655f46d7f33.png

Voltage Surge

Defeat the Harrier Squad when
fighting in the Blitzträger auf E 110/220.[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d57a28431a1b393cd263e744090485ce6ffca161.png

Power Outage

Defeat the Blitzträger auf E 220
when fighting in the Harrier Squad.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
The Collections

The Return of the Waffenträger progression consists of four Stages and involves assembling the Harriers' Collection and the Engineer's Collection with different elements. Upon collecting a certain number of elements and reaching each Stage, you will receive valuable rewards. Join the event and gather event-themed vehicle customization elements from both the Harriers' and Engineer's Collections! To fill the event progression meter and grab all the event rewards, you need to complete both Collections.

Every customization Item in both Collections is unique—each one will drop just once. The Collections include styles, camos, emblems, inscriptions, decals, and, of course, the Harriers and Max von Krieger himself. These characters will become your crew members and come with exclusive voiceovers and 100% trained Sixth Sense as a zero perk. 

[quote=]All crew members have a predetermined nation affiliation. You can only assign Max von Krieger to German vehicles, while the Harriers are affiliated with the nation to which their special tank prototypes belong—either France, U.S.A., or U.S.S.R.
Each Harriers’ or Engineer’s Collection Item adds 1 Point to the event’s main progression meter. Completing each Stage of the main progression will yield you prizes, with the final reward being 3,000 Bonds.

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ffb373dbcc24111f9d365d16697ad462e6681f5b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c486f194fe08e1860bf11fc1cc433bddd9fa3a76.png
[/expand]
Dimension Gates and Rewards

For completing event missions, as well as for defeating the rare Blitzträger auf E 220, you will receive Starters, which are special keys for activating Dimension Gates. Through activated Dimension Gates, you’ll be able to get valuable loot, including Collection Items.

You can earn the Harriers' Starters for completing event missions while playing in Harrier Squad vehicles. These keys will allow you to activate the Harriers' Gate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/79704341105a4dd11066290c63fb2df9d3f51f89.jpg

It will drop a unique Harriers’ Collection Item or a guaranteed prize from the list below:

 Credits
 Personal Reserves
 Days of WoT Premium Account
 Consumables
 Demounting Kits
 Garage slots

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ed4b8459011160fc877425be777e0bd562c259a.jpg

By completing the missions, you earn Engineer’s Starters. These keys are used to activate the Engineer's Gate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/035ecadf12a0e650c555f32f0d6a9dce5eb6e300.jpg

You can also get Engineer's Starters upon completing certain progression milestones, as well as from special bundles in the in-game Store or when activating the Engineer's Gate (with a 5% drop rate) or the Harriers' Gate (a 1% drop rate).

Upon each activation, the Engineer's Gate may bring you in-game items from four different categories, each of which has its own drop rate. First, you will receive a guaranteed item from the following list:

 Gold

 Special custom looks and decals not included in either the Harriers’ or Engineer’s Collections
But if the stars align for you, you have a 5% chance to get an Engineer’s Starter or a striking Harrier-themed 3D style for the Object 140, Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, or M48A5 Patton. Each 3D style can only drop once.

To activate the ASTRON Rex Gate and get this menacing hunter, you need to collect 60 Engineer’s Starters. But if you get this tank from the Engineer's Gate before that, the Vehicle Gate will become inactive.

After the end of the event on October 11 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2), all unused Keys to play in the Blitzträger auf E 110 will disappear, and the corresponding number of Dimension Gates will be activated automatically. All items from them will be automatically credited to your account. All event vehicles will be deducted and XP earned in them will be moved to the MS-1. All Collection Items, rewards, and loot from Dimension Gates remain with you permanently.

[quote=]When the event is over (October 11 at 11:00 CEST), all remaining Starters will automatically activate the Harriers' and Engineer's Gates. The Engineer's Starters, which might drop with a certain chance, will no longer drop after 3 Gates activations.
Special Bundles

These bundles include Keys that are required to play as the Blitzträger auf E 110. Plus, each bundle contains a certain number of event-themed decals to customize your vehicles, as well as Engineer’s Starters to activate the Engineer’s Gate for valuable loot. Additionally, three of the four available bundles include days of WoT Premium Account.

You may experience some visual glitches and sudden game client crashes during the start / course / end of the battle. Players who may potentially encounter these issues will see an appropriate warning.

In some cases, the remaining time to overload the Generator, displayed on the capture bar and on the player's timer with a load of Plasma may differ by 1 second.

notes.title: Brace Yourselves for the Return of the Waffenträger!
notes.content:
A grand return to World of Tanks! From September 27 through October 11, the special Return of the Waffenträger event will take place in World of Tanks.

This autumn, the Harrier Squad will once again face Max von Krieger's engineering marvel in a formidable and uncompromising battle for domination. Last year, the outstanding Engineer made a tactical retreat. Now he’s back, and this time, von Krieger will be revealing to the world his improved war machine, the menacing Blitzträger auf E 110. It’s even more dangerous and unpredictable than before, so get ready for fiercer, intensified battles!

On the other side of this epic confrontation, the Harriers haven’t wasted any time, either. Joining their ranks are three different vehicles, each with its own combat role and unique abilities. It's up to you to decide which side to fight on—and may the strongest win!

[previewyoutube=4jqNw34OxOc;full][/previewyoutube]
Event Dates
EU: September 27 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2) through October 11 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: September 27 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET through October 11 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET
SEA: September 27 at 17:00 (UTC+8) through October 11 at 17:00 (UTC+8)

Return of the Waffenträger: General Setup

 Battles take place in the 7v1 format on one of three lightly redesigned maps: Murovanka, Siegfried Line, and Steppes.

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6f035f1681a24274665b049ebf55431e8d5cd167.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fe6b3b82594bc3ed43c45c97c5558dcfd758aca6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8bd99a6f7c5b92edd7c3027ed7adeee5ffe927eb.png
[/expand] Before the battle starts, you can choose one of the sides in the conflict.

 A team of seven random players or a Platoon of up to three players (the Harrier Squad) rush into battle in extensively modified special vehicles: the Object 140, Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, and M48A5 Patton. Dynamic Platoons are allowed.
 The Engineer faces them in the Blitzträger auf E 110, an incredibly powerful tank destroyer manned by a single player. He’ll be flanked by guards in the form of AI-controlled Sentinels, the third type of vehicle you will spot in the mode.
 Each team has its own objective. The Harrier Squad must disable the Blitzträger auf E 110’s protective energy shield and destroy this menacing vehicle within the allotted time. The Blitzträger auf E 110 must eliminate the Harrier Squad or hold out until time expires.
 To enter the battle in the Blitzträger auf E 110, you need to have a Key. You can earn it in battles while playing the game mode or receive it as a part of special bundles in the in-game Store. Keep reading to find out about one more way to get one Key for the Blitzträger auf E 110! 
 The Return of the Waffenträger progression involves assembling the Harriers' Collection and the Engineer's Collection with different elements and consists of four Stages. Upon collecting a certain number of elements and reaching each Stage, you will receive valuable rewards. To fill the event progression meter and grab all rewards available in the event, you need to complete both Collections.
 The event’s main reward is the ASTRON Rex 105 mm, a brand-new Tier VIII Premium American medium tank, which can be obtained from the Vehicle Gate (more about this below) with a certain drop chance.
 You can also purchase it with the Engineer's Starters, special in-game keys you can earn during the event to activate the Engineer’s Gate which contains valuable loot. The Engineer's Starters will also be available as part of bundles in the in-game Store. 
 You can also use the Harriers' Starters to activate the Harriers’ Gate, which might drop useful in-game items—sometimes even the Engineer's Starters!
The Harriers’ Battle Hounds

On September 27, you will find three special vehicles to choose from in the event Garage. Choose one of the tanks and click the “Battle!” button to start your exciting combat journey!

Each Harriers’ battle hound features its own battle purpose and general and unique abilities:

 Resistor (the Object 140) is a versatile tank with mid-range characteristics that can perform any role on the battlefield. 
 Thunderbolt (the M48A5 Patton) is a slow but sturdy assault tank with impressive firepower and thick armor. 
 Foudre (the Bat.-Châtillon 25 t) is a highly mobile vehicle featuring a powerful gun with an autoloader, but it pays for these positive traits with its poor survivability.   
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ad30b8bfc0eb09d1dfb5715fea5e9cfa28e580fe.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e8ba70cdecf68d5023282f6ad93b78b662876e15.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4cd555d1238e405d11406441b4907ddd2fc9b040.png

The Harriers have three Lives (including the one you start with), which means they can respawn twice in a single battle.

How to Play

When the battle starts, the Blitzträger auf E 110 will be protected by an almost impenetrable energy shield, so it doesn’t make sense to shoot at it while this shield is active. From time to time, AI-controlled vehicles called Sentinels will spawn at certain points on the battlefield to assist the Engineer. When destroyed, Sentinels leave a load of Plasma that you need to pick up and deliver to Generators, indestructible power structures that appear in different parts of the map, changing location each time. They also create a protective shield for the Engineer.

The Harriers collect and use Plasma to overload Generators, thereby disabling the Engineer's shield for some time. Overloading a Generator with the Harriers works just like capturing the base in Random Battles. The more tanks in the cap circle, the faster it happens.

[quote=]Generators have two states: active and inactive. When Generators spawn on the map, they are always inactive and have one common activation time. The Harriers can only overload a Generator when it becomes active.
When you first pick up a load of Plasma, a certain amount of HP is restored to your entire team. Plus, having Plasma on board your vehicles increases the damage caused to von Krieger, so try not to miss any loads.

Once the Blitzträger auf E 110 is temporarily left without its protective shield, you have some time to cause full damage to it—don't forget to use your unique combat abilities! After that, the shield will be restored, and you’ll need to overload and destroy the next Generator. The damage you cause through the shield is greatly reduced, but it increases with each destroyed Generator.

After overloading and destroying the fourth and last Generator, the shield on von Krieger's machine will be permanently disabled, so take this opportunity to finish it off. But if the timer runs out with the Blitzträger still operational, von Krieger will win, so push yourself to the limit in the final stage of the battle!

Keep in mind that the Blitzträger auf E 110 has a new ability: Teleportation. It allows the Engineer to teleport to a selected point on the map with some delay. But when the protective shield disappears, Teleportation becomes unavailable, and after the destruction of the fourth Generator, this ability is blocked.

[quote=]To succeed, the Harriers’ battle hounds must work together and act as a close-knit team. Fight in packs of three to four vehicles, destroy the Sentinels assisting the Blitzträger auf E 110, collect Plasma, and pay attention to the timer. Coordinate your efforts, as the chances of a single Harrier vehicle defeating the Engineer are close to zero!
The Blitzträger auf E 110

To fight in the mighty and powerful Blitzträger auf E 110, you need a Key. There are three ways to get it:
[olist]
 Complete a special mission in Random Battles to earn one Key. The mission will be available at the start of the event on September 27 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2) and will remain active until October 4 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2).
 You can also earn Keys by completing special Harriers’ missions in the event.
 Keys will also be available as part of bundles in the in-game Store during the event. 
[/olist]There will be no compensation for unused Keys when the event ends on October 11 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2).

The Blitzträger auf E 110 is a formidable tank destroyer with overwhelming firepower. Designed by Max von Krieger, this incredible feat of engineering is equipped with a gun with an autoloading mechanism. One penetrating shot can easily take away well over half of a Harrier vehicle’s entire HP pool. Plus, the Blitzträger auf E 110 features four additional (three active and one passive) combat abilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/71ce69b9e91b342a6dfe924d3f65c40042bd74ae.png

[expand type=details]

 Gungnir - A shot that causes considerable damage to enemy vehicles.
 EMP Arrow - A shot with a high-voltage charge that slows down and stuns enemies. Resets Generator Overload points of damaged vehicles.
 EMP Burst - A charge of energy that covers the entire area around the vehicle. Stuns all enemies in the impact area and causes damage to those closest. Passes through all obstacles and resets Generator Overload points of damaged vehicles.
 Teleportation - Allows the vehicle to teleport to a selected point on the map after some delay. Operating the vehicle is impossible during preparation. Cannot be used while the shield is deactivated.
 Absorption - By being near a clump of Plasma on the ground, the vehicle accelerates its evaporation. If, at the moment of evaporation of Plasma, the vehicle is within a 50 m radius of it, it will recover a certain number of hit points and accelerate the Teleportation cooldown.
[/expand]
AI-controlled Sentinels are autonomous guards that spawn across the map. Their role is to deal damage to the Harriers and act as spotters for the Blitzträger.

How to Play

Although the Blitzträger auf E 110 is incredibly powerful and your shield reflects most of the damage you take, always keep in mind that you will be facing seven dangerous Harriers at once. If, at the end of the battle, the opposing team remains at full strength, you’ll be in trouble.

Try to confuse enemies, pick off stragglers, and support your Sentinels—don't let opponents collect loads of Plasma that can disable the Generators. Make full use of your combat abilities, constantly move around the battlefield, and take advantage of the new Teleportation ability. Protect the Generators at all costs, because if the Harriers destroy all four of them, the shield will disappear permanently and you will become vulnerable.

[quote=]Time is on your side, so it’s not necessary to destroy all the Harriers to win. If they fail to destroy you within the allotted time, you will triumph!
The Collections

The Return of the Waffenträger progression involves assembling the Harriers' Collection and the Engineer's Collection with different elements, and it consists of four Stages. Upon collecting a certain number of elements and reaching each Stage, you will receive valuable rewards. Join the event and gather event-themed vehicle customization elements from the Harriers' and Engineer's Collections! To fill the event progression meter and grab all the event rewards, you need to complete both Collections.

Every customization item in both Collections is unique—each one will drop just once. The Collections include styles, camos, emblems, inscriptions, decals, and, of course, the Harriers and Max von Krieger himself. These characters will become your crew members and come with exclusive voiceovers.

Each Harriers’ or Engineer’s Collection Item adds 1 Point to the event’s main progression meter. Completing each Stage of the main progression will yield you prizes, with the final reward being 3,000 bonds.

[expand type=details]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ffb373dbcc24111f9d365d16697ad462e6681f5b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c486f194fe08e1860bf11fc1cc433bddd9fa3a76.png
[/expand]
Dimension Gates and Rewards

For completing event missions, as well as for defeating the rare Blitzträger auf E 220 (more about this in a future article—keep your eyes peeled!), you will receive Starters, special keys for activating Dimension Gates. Through activated Dimension Gates, you’ll be able to get valuable loot, including Collection Items.

You can earn the Harriers' Starters for completing event missions while playing in Harrier Squad vehicles. These keys will allow you to activate the Harriers' Gate.

                                         {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cee67496e9927c5630b508f991d71e98dc01c511.jpg

There’s a chance it will drop a unique Harriers’ Collection Item or a guaranteed prize from the list below:

 Credits
 Personal Reserves
 Days of WoT Premium Account
 Consumables
 Demounting Kits
 Garage slots
By completing the Engineer’s combat missions, you earn the Engineer’s Starters. These keys are used to activate the Engineer's Gate.

                                         {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4715f5af4369d5402df9820f86ed6d636086f4a0.jpg

You can also get the Engineer's Starters upon completing certain progression milestones, as well as from special bundles in the in-game Store—and, if you're lucky, when activating the Engineer's Gate or the Harriers' Gate. 

Upon activation, the Engineer's Gate will bring you a guaranteed item from the following list:

 Gold
 Credits
 Personal Reserves
 Days of WoT Premium Account
 Demounting Kits
 Crew Books
But if the stars are aligned, you might get even greater prizes, including:

 Special custom looks and decals not included in the event Collections
 Striking Harrier-themed 3D styles for the Object 140, Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, or M48A5 Patton

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1abf1c7f3793d5152c04b9380f045e146ae3a99c.png[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b734561c039a7fd11f2c3f8d33a1cbf39be0d00f.png[/td]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c0eaf5e2eb7b9093ac33753daa2b5fdc130c2530.png[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
But the sweetest prizes are the impressive Tier VIII Premium tanks, including the brand-new ASTRON Rex 105 mm. Apart from this predator, you may receive a Premium vehicle from the following list:

 T77 
 Lansen C 
 ISU-152K 
 Turtle Mk. I 
 EMIL 1951 
 M41D 
 Centurion Mk. 5/1 RAAC 
 Е 75 TS 
 T26E4 SuperPershing   
 LT-432 
 CS-52 LIS 
Vehicle Gate

Last but not least, there’s also a special Vehicle Gate that requires an Engineer's Starter to activate.

                   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f63104bc7cc8884a09221cc6eedae725a7e61c7c.jpg

You can receive a particular reward from it: the ASTRON Rex 105 mm, a brand-new Tier VIII Premium American medium tank.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/17f5647ea4d6799fff2d3e16d9d2ed08dd1398dc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/29016f7c54967995cdbcbe02cfa77c48242222c9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1f7097444d619fcb370112ab0b4641313316b6a3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/aa808831cdadfb3d9c93bdb4f002ce027f9f6f52.png

To activate the Vehicle Gate and grab this intimidating hunter, you need to have 60 Engineer’s Starters. But if you get this tank from the Engineer's Gate before that, the Vehicle Gate will become inactive.

Stay tuned, Commanders! More details and precise specifications will be available in our dedicated event guide coming soon.

notes.title: Tanker Day 2021—Join the Celebration!
notes.content:
Commanders! 

One of the most important holidays for World of Tanks players is coming. Every year, we celebrate Tanker Day together with you, and this year will be no exception! Due to the pandemic, we will be unable to host a large live event, so just like last year, the celebration will happen online.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4a44cbdae4279889de3d72a16198f28d3509584d.png

We are holding a special stream on September 12 where you can look forward to all kinds of great activities: 

 Quests with awesome rewards
 A tournament between bloggers 
 Battles between the best tankers of RU and EU regions
 And more!
Let’s explore some of these activities in more detail.

Blogger Tournament

This will certainly be something exciting to watch, as the most skilled, popular, and charismatic players will compete for their share of a prize pool of 1,500,000 RUB. There will be four teams, each consisting of seven bloggers. Each team will be led by one of the following popular blogger-commanders:

 Sh0tnik
 Near_You 
 LeBwa
 Evil_Granny
The battles will be hard-fought and intense, as it will be a double-elimination competition, meaning that if a team loses twice, they’re out. There are only two prize places: The team that takes second place will receive 500,000 RUB, and the one that is crowned champion will scoop the grand prize of 1,000,000 RUB!

Clan Supercup 2021

The best teams of the RU and EU regions will clash in spectacular battles, striving to be the Supercup winner. The competition will be held in a best-of-nine format, meaning that either team needs to win five matches to make them the winner. Teams consist of 15 players, and the battle time is limited to 10 minutes.

The prizes are well worth fighting for:

1st place: 25,000 USD for the team + 500,000 gold for their clan’s Treasury
2nd place: 15,000 USD for the team + 250,000 gold for their clan’s Treasury

Be sure to tune in to the stream so you don’t miss any of the fun!

The event will start at 14:00 UTC. You can watch it here on Steam or on wgwatch.tv if you wish to take part in the quests that will appear during the stream. 

[quote=]Note: To watch the stream on wgwatch.tv, you will need to log in to the site. If you do not have an email address linked to your account, you’ll need to do that first to be able to log in.
We’re looking forward to seeing you there!

notes.content:

Thanks to everyone who participated—on to Episode 2!

Recon Mission Stage 2
EU: September 8, 14:00 CEST through September 15, 00:59 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: September 8, 10:00 PT | 12:00 CT | 13:00 ET through September 14, 23:00 PT | September 15, 01:00 CT | 02:00 ET
ASIA: September 8, 18:00 UTC+8 through September 15, 00:00 UTC+8 (HK server only)

3 New Maps To Try! 

Place of Power

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/08c3cb22b0dda4921fbb44473752ab288a731fda.png

Foothills

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/05bbc5004a196840334f333523b7fdb9537c1e88.png

Volga

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/830f4ce789b7475ad84b53c90765781d7c54622e.png

Matchmaking in the Mode 

Much of your feedback on Recon Mission concerned matchmaking, and we’ve taken measures to improve it. This new mode features separate matchmaking which is slightly different from Random Battles. Check out its basic rules:  

 There are three types of battles in Recon Mission: one-, two- and three-tier. 
 For two-tier battles, the number of higher tier vehicles is between 5 and 7. 
 For three-tier battles, the number of Tier X tanks is from 3 to 5, and the number of Tier IX vehicles is equal to or exceeds the number of Tier X tanks. The number of Tier VIII vehicles is equal to or exceeds the number of Tier IX tanks. 
 For three-tier battles with several SPGs there will be no more than 1 Tier X SPG. 
 The number of light tanks, wheeled vehicles, and SPGs in both teams is always the same, but their tiers may be different.   
 Premium Tier VIII tanks with preferential matchmaking will be sent into battles with adversaries of the same tier or one tier higher. 
Reserve Stock and Clan Reserves  

Reserve Stock, an exclusive option for WoT Premium Account, is now available in Recon Mission. Players with a WoT Premium Account will get an additional 10% bonus to Credits on top of what they earn in battles. For example, if you earned 10,000 credits in a battle, your vault will receive 1,000 thanks to the 10% bonus. Every 7 days, regardless of whether your WoT PA has expired that week, the vault will open, and all credits accumulated in it will be automatically moved to your account. 

Clan Reserves can now be used in battles.  

3 Stages, 9 New Maps  

To enter the mode, select Recon Mission via the mode selector in your Garage and click the Battle! button.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9b3895ca3238a0d10ece9317602ef9465c73a931.jpg

This year, we will launch three Recon Mission Stages, each lasting 7 days. In each Stage, you can explore 3 maps in the late stages of development. After playing 20 battles in Recon Mission (your result will only count if you finish in the top 12 by XP earned), you’ll be able to vote for the map you like the most and the least in each Stage.   

You can leave detailed feedback about each map in the special questionnaire shown below, and this will greatly help us improve and finalize these locales. Before you can share your opinions in the questionnaire about a specific map, you’ll need to play at least 6 battles on it and reach the top 12 by XP earned. You can only give feedback about the maps of the current Stage, but you’ll have the opportunity to change your mind and share a different opinion in the questionnaire before the end of each Stage.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cc0ba6821c3fc68d2111e55eee2865f3345c59e6.jpg

Your Feedback Is Crucial!   

All maps in Recon Mission are pre-release prototypes designed for Random Battles. The gameplay experience on these maps is almost finalized, but the visuals may undergo further changes before release. Your feedback and the statistics we obtain will help us understand what balance adjustments and other final refinements are needed. The maps that are the most popular with the community will be prioritized for addition to the Random Battles map pool in future updates. 

General Rules   

Battles in Recon Mission will follow the rules of Standard Battles with several changes.   

 Battles will take place in Tier VIII–X vehicles.   
 Personal and clan missions will not be available, but you can complete other battle missions, including Daily Missions.  
 The battle economy will be the same as in Random Battles.   
 You will be able to earn bonds, progressive customization decals, Mastery Badges, and Marks of Excellence.  
 The statistics of all Recon Mission battles will be counted in the statistics of Random Battles. Session statistics will not include Recon Mission battles.   
You will be able to earn Battle Pass Points in the following ways:     

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]

notes.title: The New Ranked Battles 2021–2022 Season Begins!
notes.content:
Thanks for your feedback on Season X, Commanders! This experiment has proven to be very useful and informative, so we decided to keep the 10v10 Ranked Battles format!  

One of the most competitive modes in which the most skillful players decide who’s the strongest returns to World of Tanks with three new Seasons and some important changes. It brings with it heaps of rewards for good performance in combat, including fresh 2D styles, bonds, gold, and more! But the ultimate prize for all three Seasons is the brand-new Tier X Chinese 114 SP2 tank destroyer, which is exclusive to Ranked Battles. Read up on all the latest features and changes for the upcoming Season!  

Learn more about Ranked Battles on a separate page in the game client with information about the core rules and rewards.

The first Season of Ranked Battles 2021–2022 will run for two weeks: from September 6 through September 20. notes.title: The Strv K: A Tank With a Spirit
notes.content:
Commanders! 

Yesterday, we presented to you, all at once, the new Sabaton video called “Steel Commanders”, the Spirit of War event, and—as a sort of a teaser—the brand-new Strv K tank, the first-ever Tier IX Premium vehicle with a set of distinctive features and the Spirit of War 3D style on top. Let’s take a closer look at the main prize of the event, the Strv K! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2a20aeeeed94c2183dc5a7da8c55d8820ab8b7f9.jpg
Metal Machine: The Strv K 

The Strv K is a Tier IX Swedish heavy tank and a force to be reckoned with. In battle, it excels at hull-down play with its tough turret and excellent gun depression angle. Other gun parameters, including great armor penetration, allow for convenient gunplay. 

[previewyoutube=Kp2syn-q5mI;full][/previewyoutube]
 The frontal armor of the turret is up to 254 mm thick. This is the nominal value, with the efficient ones being much higher: If we look the Strv K in the face, beyond the curved gun mantlet, everything’s sloped. 
 Its tough turret, together with a gun depression angle of –10 degrees, means that once your hull is behind a terrain fold, you will feel snug. 
 With decent stabilization, a base aiming time of 2.49 s, and a base accuracy of 0.33, the “How did I miss that?” situations are kept to a minimum. 
 Armor penetration is 252 mm for the basic AP shell, and 310 mm for the special APCR shell, which travels at 1,350 m/s. 
 With a base top speed of 40 km/h, you will arrive at key firing positions faster than most heavies, and with a base view range of 400 m, you’ll be likely to spot your enemies before they spot you, too. 
[expand type=details]
[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks and skills, as well as special in-game items.

In addition to its looks and effects, the Spirit of War 3D style provides the standard concealment bonus of 2%. 

Wolfpack: The Crew 

Sabaton created the battle metal genre, and the band members are the best candidates for rolling out your Strv K onto every battlefield. They all have the unique “Band of Brothers” as their zero perk (which works just like Brothers in Arms). The band’s leader, Joakim Brodén, also provided his voice for the tank. 

Thunderstorm: The Soundtrack 

The heavy metal tank is going to have a soundtrack of its own. While you’re in your Strv K, you’ll do battle to the remixes of “Steel Commanders”. The tank’s custom soundtrack can be turned off in the game’s Settings menu. 

Now that you’ve learned how the Strv K plays, looks, sounds, and earns, it’s about time you got down to the missions! Check the article on the Spirit of War event to find out how you can obtain the tank and the 3D style (or at least a solid discount for your mastery or dedication during the missions). And once you’ve obtained the Strv K, consider joining the action in the Frontline mode in it: Being a Tier IX, this new Premium tank is eligible this year. 

Good luck in your battles, Commanders, and may the Spirit of War be on your side!

notes.title: Tier IX Premium Powered by Sabaton! Get a Unique Tank and Jam to the New Video
notes.content:
Commanders! 

Together with our great friends from Sabaton—the Swedish masters of heavy metal—we proudly present “Steel Commanders”, a brand-new video and song dedicated to those who took armor to battle throughout the history of humankind. The video also marks the beginning of our new special collaboration with Sabaton that includes an event with a one-of-a-kind prize for you to seize. Look and listen! 

[previewyoutube=peTCePu1jMs;full][/previewyoutube]
Wait, what IS that tank in the video? 

If you weren’t so carried away by the song that you closed your eyes, you must’ve seen the Spirit of War empowering an imposing tank. And you’re probably asking, “Is it coming to the game? Should I want it?“ 

Yes. That Sabaton-crewed steed, the Strv K, is METAL in every sense. And while it was forged in the tank spirit realm, it will come back down to World of Tanks to materialize as the one-of-a-kind Tier IX Premium, bearing the Spirit of War 3D style. 

So, you absolutely want it! And you will have a chance to prove you deserve it by taking on the Spirit of War challenge, following the way of either virtue of metal: mastery or commitment.  

Why should I want the Strv K? 

Along with being the first-ever Tier IX Premium with all the bonuses that apply (like bonus to credits and Crew XP per battle), the Strv K is a well-rounded heavy with a sturdy turret and precise gun with an excellent depression angle. On top of that, the Strv K allows you to earn bonds, which previously used to be a Tier X-only feature.

The Spirit of War 3D style, developed together with the band, adds a custom Sabaton soundtrack and features unique dynamic effects—the Spirit of War enters the tank after the countdown ends and shimmers from the inside out over the course of the battle, just like it does in the music video.

The Spirit of War will reign in World of Tanks from August 27 at 10:00 CEST through September 6 at 10:00 CEST (UTC+2). Besides helping you reach milestones on your way towards the unique vehicle, each mission will reward you with various in-game goodies. 

The Spirit of War challenge will consist of two Chapters. By completing Chapter I—following the way of mastery or commitment—you will obtain the Strv K. notes.title: Recon Mission: Explore New Maps and Earn Rewards!
notes.content:
It's going to get even hotter in World of Tanks, Commanders! August Heat is bringing back Recon Mission, our new experimental mode where we’ll work together with you to refine new maps that may be added to Random Battles. 

In response to your feedback, we improved the mode’s matchmaking and some other aspects to make Recon Mission more enjoyable. This experimental mode introduced in Update 1.13 will be relaunched in three separate Stages and with the same maps, with the first Stage kicking off on August 20. Your game progress during the previous Recon Mission launch will be saved, so you can continue from where you left off. Check out all the new improvements Recon Mission has received! 

[previewyoutube=dnBD07D9D4Q;full]VIDEO [/previewyoutube]
Recon Mission Stage 1  
August 20 at 11:00 UTC through August 26 at 23:59 UTC  

Matchmaking in the Mode 

Much of your feedback on Recon Mission concerned matchmaking, and we’ve taken measures to improve it. This new mode features separate matchmaking which is slightly different from Random Battles. Check out its basic rules:  

 There are three types of battles in Recon Mission: one-, two- and three-tier. 
 For two-tier battles, the number of higher tier vehicles is between 5 and 7. 
 For three-tier battles, the number of Tier X tanks is from 3 to 5, and the number of Tier IX vehicles is equal to or exceeds the number of Tier X tanks. The number of Tier VIII vehicles is equal to or exceeds the number of Tier IX tanks. 
 For three-tier battles with several SPGs there will be no more than 1 Tier X SPG. 
 The number of light tanks, wheeled vehicles, and SPGs in both teams is always the same, but their tiers may be different.   
 Premium Tier VIII tanks with preferential matchmaking will be sent into battles with adversaries of the same tier or one tier higher. 
Reserve Stock and Clan Reserves  

Reserve Stock, an exclusive option for WoT Premium Account, is now available in Recon Mission. Players with a WoT Premium Account will get an additional 10% bonus to Credits on top of what they earn in battles. For example, if you earned 10,000 credits in a battle, your vault will receive 1,000 thanks to the 10% bonus. Every 7 days, regardless of whether your WoT PA has expired that week, the vault will open, and all credits accumulated in it will be automatically moved to your account. 

Clan Reserves can now be used in battles.  

3 Stages, 9 New Maps  

To enter the mode, select Recon Mission via the mode selector in your Garage and click the Battle! button.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9b3895ca3238a0d10ece9317602ef9465c73a931.jpg

This year, we will launch three Recon Mission Stages, each lasting 7 days. In each Stage, you can explore 3 maps in the late stages of development. After playing 20 battles in Recon Mission (your result will only count if you finish in the top 12 by XP earned), you’ll be able to vote for the map you like the most and the least in each Stage.   

You can leave detailed feedback about each map in the special questionnaire shown below, and this will greatly help us improve and finalize these locales. Before you can share your opinions in the questionnaire about a specific map, you’ll need to play at least 6 battles on it and reach the top 12 by XP earned. You can only give feedback about the maps of the current Stage, but you’ll have the opportunity to change your mind and share a different opinion in the questionnaire before the end of each Stage.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cc0ba6821c3fc68d2111e55eee2865f3345c59e6.jpg

Your Feedback Is Crucial!   

All maps in Recon Mission are pre-release prototypes designed for Random Battles. The gameplay experience on these maps is almost finalized, but the visuals may undergo further changes before release. Your feedback and the statistics we obtain will help us understand what balance adjustments and other final refinements are needed. The maps that are the most popular with the community will be prioritized for addition to the Random Battles map pool in future updates. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ac10ebcee7a2736967591389d1a0de8f23364c1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3773684f10af0d8748d892a2fb9d2d7997ddd5e2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1fd194b9ebaf98edbcb90bc8054b1acf8f456c95.png

General Rules   

Battles in Recon Mission will follow the rules of Standard Battles with several changes.   

 Battles will take place in Tier VIII–X vehicles.   
 Personal and clan missions will not be available, but you can complete other battle missions, including Daily Missions.  
 The battle economy will be the same as in Random Battles.   
 You will be able to earn bonds, progressive customization decals, Mastery Badges, and Marks of Excellence.  
 The statistics of all Recon Mission battles will be counted in the statistics of Random Battles. Session statistics will not include Recon Mission battles.   
You will be able to earn Battle Pass Points in the following ways:

notes.title: Referral Program: A New Season With Fresh Rewards!
notes.content:
August is heating up and we’re turning up the gas for the grill! Get ready to recruit your friends and earn a Premium vehicle in the upcoming season of the Referral Program, Commanders!  

August Heat is full of surprises as it brings Season 8 of the Referral Program, which kicks off on August 26 and runs until December. Before the new season launches, we updated the recruit reward pool to make it more valuable for both novices and returning veterans. We also reworked the "Receive a Medal" missions and replaced some medals with more achievable ones, so that you'll be able to earn them with less effort. Get the lowdown on the changes below! 

Referral Program: Recruit Reward Rebalancing 

In the new Season of Referral Program, we will replace Bonds in the Recruit reward pool with different valuable prizes more useful for beginners and helping them boost their progress in the game: Personal Reserves, Demounting Kits, days of WoT Premium Account, Crew Books, and Credits. These prizes are also coveted by veterans returning to World of Tanks and willing to continue researching vehicle branches. The full reward breakdown can be found below. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2c1589c1cf7f9ff1f4f80eda5810d703c1603264.jpg

[quote=]In Season 7, you can still receive bonds as a reward for completing Stages. But for completing all subsequent Stages of the upcoming season, you will receive prizes from the updated recruit reward pool.   
Reworking the "Receive a Medal" Missions 

We also reworked some of the most challenging "Receive a Medal" missions in order to make them more accessible. Now, there will be less time and effort required to complete these tasks. This resulted in the replacement of some Epic Medals and Battle Heroes achievements with other awards, in accordance with the simplified conditions. Check it out.

notes.title: The 11th Anniversary of World of Tanks: Redeem Your Summer Presents!
notes.content:
The hottest time of the year is a great occasion to receive hot presents, Commanders! 

August Heat is in full swing and continues with the celebration of a great milestone: our 11th anniversary. Over the years, World of Tanks has come an impressive way, so we invite all of you to join the party and celebrate with us! To express our deepest gratitude for your passion and dedication, we’ll be giving away Summer Presents to all players. Don’t miss out and be sure to log in to World of Tanks from August 12–22* to get a historical Tier IV Premium tank and other gifts!

*August 22 will be the last full day to log-in. August 23 at 08:00 CEST is your last opportunity to receive gifts. Further information in the table below. 

Summer Presents 

August 12 at 08:00 CEST (UTC+2) through August 23* at 08:00 CEST (UTC+2) 

[previewyoutube=cSig0oF-DEo;full][/previewyoutube]
*A special section of the in-game Store where you can exchange your Gift Tickets will be available one day longer. 

How It Works  

You’ll be able to redeem your Summer Presents during all 11 days of the event. To do this, just log in seven times to the game on any of the days between August 12 and 22. Every time you log in for the first time each day, you’ll receive gifts—one day of WoT Premium Account and one Gift Ticket, a special in-game currency you can exchange until August 24 at 08:00 CEST (UTC+2) in a special section of the in-game Store for valuable items. Accordingly, for the entire Summer Presents period, you can get seven days of WoT Premium Account and seven Gift Tickets (for your seven first logins).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3aaa540c14afed176dc6b152cdf8f63ed8b63385.jpg

When you log in to the game for the first time on any day during the Summer Presents event, you’ll notice a special gift from us—the T-34 mod. 1941, a Tier IV Premium Soviet medium tank featuring a default concealment bonus (it works permanently, as if the camo has already been applied). The tank comes with a 100% trained crew and a Garage slot.  

This historical* vehicle, equipped with a 76 mm L-11 gun from around 1938–1939, was developed at Kharkov Factory No. 183. The tank incorporated an optimal combination of the main combat characteristics: firepower, protection, and dynamics. It had a great influence on the development of Soviet—and global—tank building.

notes.title: August Heat: Update 1.14, New Heavies, and More!
notes.content:
August is the hot season, and it brings with it a feast of specials and surprises! Join our birthday bash as we celebrate our 11th anniversary, and take part in a host of exciting activities! Plus, Update 1.14 introduces brand-new Czechoslovakian heavy tanks with unusual gameplay and a fresh Random Battle map called Safe Haven. We're also updating the combat parameters of some iconic vehicles and introducing Field Modification, a totally new feature for fine-tuning your favorite tanks. Finally, we’re adding a new training mode, Topography, and changing some Personal Missions for artillery.

[previewyoutube=tkls15kStYQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Czechoslovakian Heavy Tanks Have Arrived!

Brand-new Czechoslovakian brawlers are ready to storm the battlefield, Commanders! The new branch consists of four researchable heavies from Tier VII to Tier X. Starting from Tier VIII, all Czechoslovakian warriors will give you the possibility to choose from two top guns to match your preferred gameplay style. One gun fires in regular mode, while the other is a two-shell autoloader with a short reload time between shells. Pick the one you like the most and annihilate your enemies!

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/5526463837488116356
Recon Mission: Stay Tuned for Updates! 

Recon Mission, our new game mode, is about to hit the live servers! We are currently working on improving it and will share more details as soon as we can.

Premium Vehicle Rebalancing 

We’re continuing to work on rebalancing popular Premium and reward tanks and updating their combat effectiveness. This time, we're improving the characteristics of some your favorite tanks from different nations, including: T34 and T34 B, AMX Chasseur de chars, KV-5, IS-6 and IS-6B, 112, WZ-111 and WZ-111 Alpine Tiger, T-34-3, M48A2 Räumpanzer, M46 Patton KR, T95E2, 59-Patton.

We’re enhancing their strengths to emphasize their gameplay and make them more competitive on the battlefield.

Learn more: EU, NA, ASIA

Changes to Personal Missions for Artillery 

We're updating some Personal Missions for artillery to make them more achievable. We tried to rework the missions for a certain amount of stun and damage because these parameters were affected in Update 1.13. The rest of the less complex missions remain unchanged. The missions' changes are not very significant, because SPGs can still effectively stun enemy vehicles with the first HE shell and deal damage with the second one.

Learn more: EU, NA, ASIA

Field Modification 

Want to fine-tune your favorite vehicles to make them better suit your needs and personal playstyle? Take advantage of Field Modification, a brand-new feature for tweaking specific characteristics of Tier VI–X tanks (including Collectors', special, and Premium vehicles). Field Modification consists of three types of special adjustments you can make to a vehicle's parameters or setup. Try it out and take a fresh look at the strengths of your favorite tanks!

[previewyoutube=dFfIzhcIm1w;full][/previewyoutube]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/2999944978195372253
Welcome to Safe Haven! 

A brand-new Random Battles map is here! Welcome to Safe Haven, a spacious 1000x1000-meter summer map set in 1960s Japan. It is designed as a demilitarized civilian port adjacent to a traditional fishing village.

Safe Haven is divided into two large gameplay zones. The first is the harbor area with plenty of cover and a huge bunker where heavily armored vehicles will feel right at home. The second is a picturesque green zone, which is good for faster and less-armored tanks. Ambush TDs and SPGs will also find some advantageous positions here. Explore Safe Haven and get ready for intense clashes on a new battlefield!

[previewyoutube=7u5KgPeP4N0;full][/previewyoutube]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/2999944978196112674
Improve Your Map Knowledge in Topography!  

To help newcomers better navigate maps in World of Tanks, we're introducing a new training mode: Topography. The training in this mode takes place in a single-player mission format, where you’ll be able to master the basics of playing on maps of different difficulties. Completing missions and exploring maps will improve your navigation skills and help increase your survivability. Plus, you will get rewards, including credits, free XP, and consumables.

[previewyoutube=KieKxtYZUv8;full][/previewyoutube]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/2999945883212281072
Join World of Tanks’ 11th Anniversary! 

Time to party hearty, Commanders! Join our anniversary bash as we celebrate 11 glorious years of World of Tanks. A feast of fun events, valuable rewards, and cool gifts await, so keep your eyes peeled and get ready to celebrate with us—August Heat is already here!

Frontline Is Back! 

The most epic mode in World of Tanks is returning to the game with four intense Stages, the first of which kicks off in August. Frontline 2021 will feature a reworked Combat Reserves system and will be closely integrated with Battle Pass. But most importantly, Tier IX vehicles will be allowed in this mode at a later part of the battle. Learn all the details in our dedicated article below.

notes.title: Topography: A New Mode to Boost Your Map Knowledge
notes.content:
Commanders! 

Of all the things that contribute to players’ performance in World of Tanks, map knowledge is one of the most indispensable.  

Many a player will recall those fatal situations where taking one wrong direction caused them to return to the Garage before they knew it, spoiling both their mood and statistics. Having observed these struggles from new and veteran players alike when getting to grips with maps, we’ve decided to introduce a new training mode: Topography. To get a quick idea of what it is and how it will benefit you, check out the overview below.  

[previewyoutube=KieKxtYZUv8;full][/previewyoutube]

What is Topography? 

Topography is a single-player training mode where commanders are shown the ropes of map navigation in World of Tanks. The idea behind Topography is simple: You’ll play four different scenarios while learning the “traffic patterns” that are typical for certain maps, depending on the base you start at and the vehicle type you play. You’ll be shown the main routes, key places to seek cover, and many other positions to understand how to avoid being destroyed, as well as how (and where) to use your vehicle to the fullest. All scenarios, including suggested routes, firing lines, and enemy behavior, are based on heatmaps from real battles. 

And the best part? For your training achievements, you’ll be generously rewarded!   

How Does It Work? 

 Find the mode in the client.  
 Choose a map and one of four scenarios. 
 Enter the battle.  
 Move through the map, following all the hints. 
 Destroy AI-controlled opponents.  
 Get skilled and rewarded!   
 And now for the details.  

Scenarios 

Each map has four scenarios available to explore the locations in detail and from different perspectives. Depending on the chosen scenario, you’ll enter the battle either from Base 1 or Base 2 in either a maneuverable or armored tank. Both vehicles are exclusive to Topography, the former functioning as a support tank and the latter an assault tank. 

Each scenario consists of several missions. Essentially, all missions are about moving in certain directions and destroying certain targets, the AI-controlled opponents representing average vehicles of relevant tiers. They can only move their turrets, but beware—they can shoot!  

All scenarios are time limited. With each completed mission, the time provided for the scenario will be extended. And for playing all four scenarios on a given map, you’ll be granted a special reward.  

Hints  

Throughout your training battles, guidance signs will be popping out along the way to help you through. They are: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/019ab1974bbfa65c2b6fe0bc07d6c04997b61c17.png

 Base — the point on the map where you will start the battle, depending on the chosen scenario.  
 Navigation markers — white markers showing the optimal direction to the target. 
 Targets — AI-controlled opponents shown as red dots on the minimap. 
 Priority targets — enemy vehicles with a special icon above them. They should be destroyed to complete local missions. 
 Firing lines — upon entering these special zones, you’ll be assigned a “local mission” to destroy a priority target. For completing the task, you’ll be granted additional time.   
 Spotting system — this forewarns you when you’ve crossed the enemy detection area. In this case, the Sixth Sense icon will be displayed along with the corresponding audio signal, and an eye symbol will appear on the minimap.    
 Maps  

Currently, Topography is available on 15 Standard Battle maps, with the scenarios varying in difficulty.   

Easier scenarios will be available for Tier IV and V vehicles and will be played on:    
[olist]
 Mines
 Ruinberg

 Lakeville
[/olist] [expand type=details]

In the future, the map pool will be expanded, and one more difficulty level will be added.   

Who Can Participate? 

Everyone is welcome! However, since new players need the navigation training the most, preference will be given to them. This means that if too many players are looking to play the Topography mode at the same time, a queue will be activated, and newcomers will be the first to enter.  

How Will You Benefit from Topography? 

Apart from boosting your navigation skills and in-game performance, you’ll get rewards, including credits, Free XP, and consumables—the latter on the condition that all missions are completed. Plus, it’s so much fun playing World of Tanks when you know the battlefields like the back of your hand!  

Please note: The traffic pattens you’ll be shown in the Topography mode are just recommendations. A real battlefield will require you to adapt your route to the situation and play according to your team's strategy.

notes.title: August Heat: Things Are Getting Hot!
notes.content:
The hottest season of battles is already here, Commanders!  

Summer has arrived, but it's going to get even hotter in World of Tanks. Get ready to take part in a whole series of exciting activities, August Heat, which will delight you with cool events, long-awaited game modes, and other specials. Plus, 2021 marks the 11th anniversary of World of Tanks, and we invite all of you to join our birthday bash! Jump in—August will be full of surprises! 

[previewyoutube=0BIhkihzyks;full][/previewyoutube]

Czechoslovakian Heavy Tanks Are Coming! 

Asphalt will melt under the tracks of the brand-new Czechoslovakian heavy tanks storming onto the battlefields of our game. We’re adding an entire branch with four researchable Tier VII–X brawlers, so get ready to Czech it out this August!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d6eaacd41e29651b213c83a8fdbf64f7075685d6.jpg

The 11th Anniversary of World of Tanks 

World of Tanks was born on August 12 in Minsk, the heart of Wargaming. 2021 marks the 11th anniversary of our game, and we're planning a grand celebration to honor this milestone! We've prepared a festive Garage and exciting gifts for all of you as a token of our sincere gratitude and appreciation. Let’s party together! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/83a80dee0a2cb46a038f4cce0aaaa184a44398a8.jpg

Field Modification  

This brand-new feature allows you to fine-tune your favorite Tier VI–X vehicles to enhance their strengths and adjust them to better suit your personal playstyle. Discover new facets of your gameplay and make your tanks more competitive in battles!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons, and Backgrounds Are Here!
notes.content:
Commanders!
Today we are adding 12 rare and precious trading cards and 6 badges for World of Tanks. There are also 3 backgrounds to adorn your profile with, and 5 emoticons to help you express yourself.

Trading Cards
11 cards represent 11 nations from the game and the last one symbolizes love of World of Tanks. Each of the 11 tanks shown on the cards is a Tier X vehicle, the apex of its research branch. Before putting a tank like these into your Garage, you need to go through hundreds of battles on Tier I to IX vehicles. 
This long journey is a big part of World of Tanks gameplay. You learn the basics throughout Tiers I to IV, find your favorite vehicles on Tiers V to VII, and refine your playstyle on Tiers VIII to X.

Play World of Tanks and have some Tier X tanks in the game and on the Steam cards!

Let's take a look at some of the cards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/12873377381a109cab0333daede19353ef2d9fdf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2d5beb48d3aadeddd55f5a28be957fcc300c1771.png

How to get some cards?
For all F2P games on Steam each $9 spent grant one card drop, but it's just a bonus; don't forget you can also craft booster packs using gems, which is cheaper. For turning a pack of cards into a game badge, you'll receive random rewards from a set of game-related items—unique emoticons and backgrounds. If you want a specific item only, you can trade or buy it on the market directly.
NOTE: If you've spent some funds in World of Tanks on Steam, check the inventory notifications—there already might be some cards waiting for you! 

What else can I do with cards?
After receiving one of the trading cards, you can see the full image and use it as a wallpaper.
You can always sell them over to the connoisseurs at the Steam Market.

More info on:
